व: व The twenty-ninth consonant of the Nagari alphabet, or more pro-perly the semi vowel V; it is often confounded with the labial consonant or ब, with which it is also optionally interchangeable.

व m. (-वः) 	 1. Air, wind. 	 2. The arm. 	 3. A name of VARUṆA. 	 4. Ad-dressing. 	 5. Auspiciousness. 	 6. Strong, powerful. 	 7. A dwelling. 8. The residence of VARUṆA. 	 9. The ocean. 	 10. Water. 	 11. Shaving. 	 12. Like, as, (rarely used.) 	 13. An epithet of RĀHU. 	 14. A tiger. 	 15. Cloth. 	 f. (-वा) 	 1. Going. 	 2. Hurting, injury. 	 3. An arrow. 	 4. Weaving. 	 5. A weaver. 	 n. (-वं) A sort of incantation or Mantra, of which the object is the deity VARUṆA.  E. वा to go, to injure, &c., aff. ड ।
वंश: वंश m. (-शः) 	 1. Race, lineage, family. 	 2. Assemblage, multitude. 	 3. A bamboo, (Bambusa arundinacea.) 	 4. The back-bone, the spine. 5. A staff. 	 6. A joint. 	 7. The Sāl tree. 	 8. A sort of sugar-cane. 	 9. A particular measure of length equal to ten hastas. mf. (-शः-शी) 	 1. A pipe, a fife, a flute. 	 2. Bamboo-manna.  E. वंश् to shine, घ aff., and नुम् augment; or वन् to sound, to serve, aff. श । According the Vāchaspatya:--वमति उद्गिरात वम-श तस्य नेत्त्वम् ।
वंशक: वंशक m. (-कः) 	 1. A small fish, (Cynoglossus lingua, HAM.) 	 2. A large kind of sugar-cane. “शामशाडा ।” nf. (शकं-शिका) Aloe-wood. 	 f. (-का) A kind of pipe or flute.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
वंशकठिन: वंशकठिन m. (-नः) A thicket of bamboos.
वंशकफ: वंशकफ n. (-फं) Flocks of cotton or cottony pods floating in the air. E. वंश a bamboo, and कफ phlegm.
वंशकर: वंशकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Making or perpetuating a family.  E. वंश, and कर what makes.
वंशकीर्ति: वंशकीर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Famous, celebrated.  E. वंश, कीर्त्ति fame.
वंशकीर्त्ति: वंशकीर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Famous, celebrated.  E. वंश, कीर्त्ति fame.
वंशक्षय: वंशक्षय m. (-यः) Decay of a family.  E. वंश, and क्षय decline.
वंशक्षीरी: वंशक्षीरी f. (-री) The manna of the bamboo.  E. वंश the bamboo, and क्षीर milk; being of a milky colour.
वंशचरित्र: वंशचरित्र n. (-त्रं) A genealogical table or list, the history of a race or dynasty, &c.  E. वंश, and चरित्र an account.
वंशज: वंशज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Sprung from a good family. 	 2. Produced by the bamboo. 	 nf. (-ज-जा) Bamboo-manna.  E. वश a bamboo, or lineage, &c., and ज born, produced.
वंशधर: वंशधर mfn. (-रः-रा-र) 	 1. Who or what supports a family. 	 2. Carrying or holding a bamboo, &c.  E. वंश, and धर what holds.
वंशनालिका: वंशनालिका f. (-का) A pipe, a reed or flute.  E. वंश a bamboo, नाल a tube, कन् aff., fem. form.
वंशनेत्र: वंशनेत्र n. (-त्रं) The root of sugarcane.
वंशपत्रक: वंशपत्रक n. (-कं) Yellow orpiment. 	 m. (-कः) A sort of fish, (Cynoglossus lingua, HAM.)  E. वंश a bamboo, and पत्र a leaf, the shape of the fish resembling to that of the leaf of the bamboo.
वंशपत्रपतित: वंशपत्रपतित n. (-तं) A species of the Atyashtī metre.
वंशपरम्परा: वंशपरम्परा f. (-रा) Family, lineage, descent.  E. वंश, and परम्पर successive.
वंशपूरक: वंशपूरक n. (-कं) The root of a sugarcane.
वंशभोज्य: वंशभोज्य n. (-ज्यं) Hereditary estate.  E. वंश, and भोज्य to be possessed.
वंशलोचना: वंशलोचना f. (-ना) The manna of the bamboo: see the last.
वंशवर्द्धन: वंशवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Increasing or exalting a family.  E. वंश, वर्द्धन augmenting.
वंशवितति: वंशवितति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A clump of bamboos. 	 2. A Family, descent. E. वंश a bamboo or lineage, and वितति extent.
वंशविशुद्ध: वंशविशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Of a goad family. 	 2. Of a good bamboo, (made, constructed.)  E. वंश, and विशुद्ध pure.
वंशवृद्धि: वंशवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Prosperity of a family.  E. वंश and वृद्धि, increase.
वंशशलाका: वंशशलाका f. (-का) 	 1. The bamboo pipe that forms the body of the Vinā or lute. 	 2. Any small bamboo pin or stake, as the bar of a cage, &c.  E. वंश a bamboo and शलाका a pin or bolt.
वंशसमाचार: वंशसमाचार m. (-रः) Family usage.  E. वंश and समाचार practice.
वंशस्थविल: वंशस्थविल n. (-लं) A species of the Jagatī metre.
वंशस्थिति: वंशस्थिति f. (-तिः) The perpetuation of a family.
वंशहीन: वंशहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having no kindred or family.  E. वंश and हीन deprived of.
वंशाग्र: वंशाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The shoot of a bamboo.  E. वंश and अग्र point.
वंशाङ्कुर: वंशाङ्कुर m. (-रः) The shoot of a bamboo.  E. वंश, and अङ्कुर a shoot.
वंशानुचरित: वंशानुचरित n. (-तं) A pedigree, a genealogical list, or history.  E. वंश a family, अनु implying succession, and चरित proceeded.
वंशावली: वंशावली f. (-ली) A pedigree, a genealogy.  E. वंश, and आवली a line.
वंशिक: वंशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to a family or bamboo, &c. 	 nf. (-कं-का) 	 1. Aloe-wood. 	 2. A Kind of flute.  E. वंश, ठक् aff.
वंशी: वंशी f. (-शी) 	 1. A flute, a pipe. 	 2. An artery. 	 3. Bamboo-manna. 	 4. A particular weight.
वंशीधर: वंशीधर m. (-रः) 	 1. A piper. 	 2. A name of KRISHṆA.  E. वंशी, धर who holds.
वंश्य: वंश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 	 1. Of a good family. 	 2. Of the same family. 	 3. Relating to the back-bone. 	 m. (-श्यः) 	 1. A son. 	 2. A pupil, a scho-lar. 	 3. A kinsman, from seven generations above and seven below. 4. A bone in the leg or arm.  E. वंश a family, and यत् aff.
वंहिष्ठ: वंहिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Most, very much or great.  E. वंह substituted for वृन्दारक great, and इष्ठन् aff.
वंहीयस्: वंहीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very much or very large.  E. वंह for वृन्दारक, ईयसुन् aff.
वक्: वक्(इ)वकि r. 1st cl. (वङ्कते) 	 1. To be crooked, (literally or figuratively,) to be curved or bent, to be depraved or wicked. 	 2. To bend, to make crooked. 	 3. To go.
वक: वक m. (-कः) 	 1. A crane, (Ardea nivea.) 	 2. A tree, (Sesbana gran-diflora.) 	 3. KUVERA. 	 4. The name of a demon. 	 5. A small appara-tus for calcining or subliming metals or minerals consisting of two crucibles, one inverted over the other, luted together and placed over a fire.  E. वच् to speak, or वकि to be crooked, aff. घञ् or अच्; in the latter case the nasal augment is not inserted.
वकचिञ्चिका: वकचिञ्चिका f. (-का) A sort of fish.
वकजित्: वकजित् m. (-जित्) A name of BHĪMA.  E. वक a demon, and जित् the conqueror.
वकधूप: वकधूप m. (-पः) Compound perfume: see वृकघूप ।
वकनिसूदन: वकनिसूदन m. (-नः) BHĪMA.  E. वक the demon, and निसूदन destroyer.
वकपुष्प: वकपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora.)  E. वक curving, from वकि to be crooked, पुष्प a flower.
वकवृत्ति: वकवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A false or hypocritical devotee: see वकव्रतिन्  E. वक, वृत्ति livelihood.
वकवैरिन्: वकवैरिन् m. (-री) BHĪMA.  E. वक the demon, and वैरिन् a foe.
वकव्रतिन्: वकव्रतिन् m. (-ती) A false devotee, a religious hypocrite, or one who as-sumes the appearance of devotion or meditation, for interested pur-poses.  E. वक a crane, व्रत observance, and इनि aff.; compared to the crane, who stands by a pool demure and sly, and apparently absorbed in contemplation, till be sees a fish on which to dart; also with ठक् aff. वकव्रतिक, and derived from वक, and चर who goes, वकचर; or वकव्रतचर m. (-रः) &c.: see वैडालव्रतिक ।
वकाची: वकाची f. (-ची) A sort of fish.
वकुल: वकुल m. (-लः) A plant, (Mimusops elengi.) 	 f. (-ली) A sort of drug, commonly Kākoli.  E. वक् to be crooked, aff. उलच् ।
वकेरुका: वकेरुका f. (-का) 	 1. A small crane. 	 2. The branch of a tree bent by the wind.  E. वक a crane, or वक् to be crooked, ईर् to go or be, aff. उकन् ।
वकोट: वकोट n. (-टः) A crane.  E. वक् to be crooked, ओटच् aff.
वक्तव्य: वक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. Fit or proper to be said or spoken, to be spoken or uttered. 	 2. To be spoken about or against. 	 3. Vile, bad, reprehensible. 	 4. Subject, dependent. 	 5. Low, base. 	 n. (-व्यं) 	 1. A rule, a dictum, a sentence. 	 2. Speech. 	 3. Reproach.  E. वच् to speak, and तव्य aff., of the future participle.
वक्तव्यता: वक्तव्यता f. (-ता) 	 1. Blame, reprehension. 	 2. The nature or property of what is to be said, or the occasion for it.  E. तल् added to the last.
वक्तुकाम: वक्तुकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desirous of speaking.  E. वक्तु for वक्तुम् to speak, काम desire.
वक्तृ: वक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) 	 1. Speaking, a speaker. 	 2. Loquacious, talkative. 3. Speaking well or sensibly, eloquent. 	 4. Wise, learned. 	 5. Speak-ing truly or truth, honest, sincere. 	 m. (-क्ता) 	 1. An expounder, a teacher. 	 2. An orator, a speaker.  E. वच् to speak, तृच् participial aff.
वक्त्र: वक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A hog. 	 n. (-क्त्रं) 	 1. The mouth or face. 	 2. A sort of gar-ment. 	 3. Metre, verse, especially of the Vedas. 	 4. A plant: see तगरमूल. 	 5. The sprout of a jug.  E. वच् to speak, Unādi aff. ष्ट्रन् ।
वक्त्रखुर: वक्त्रखुर m. (-रः) A tooth.  E. वक्त्र the mouth, and खुर a hoof.
वक्त्रज: वक्त्रज m. (-जः) A Brāhman.  E. वक्त्र the mouth, (of BRAHMĀ,) ज born.
वक्त्रताल: वक्त्रताल mn. (-लः-लं) A musical instrument, played on with the mouth. E. वक्त्र the mouth, ताल tune; it may also signify, making a noise with the mouth, by striking it with the hand at the moment of uttering sound.
वक्त्रतुण्ड: वक्त्रतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A name of GANESA.  E. वक्त्र and तुण्ड beak or nose, having the proboscis of an elephant.
वक्त्रपट्ट: वक्त्रपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A bag containing corn tied round a horse's head. E. वक्त्र the mouth, पट्ट a cloth.
वक्त्रभेदिन्: वक्त्रभेदिन् m. (-दी) Pungency, pungent or acrid flavour.  E. वक्त्र mouth, भेदिन् what cuts.
वक्त्ररन्ध्र: वक्त्ररन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) The aperture of the mouth.
वक्त्रशोधिन्: वक्त्रशोधिन् m. (-धी) The citron tree.  E. वक्त्र, शोधिन् what cleanses; also वक्त्रशोधन m. (-नः) ।
वक्त्रासव: वक्त्रासव m. (-वः) Saliva.  E. वक्त्र the mouth, and आसव wine.
वक्र: वक्र mfn. (-क्रः-क्रा-क्रं) 	 1. Crooked, curved, bowed or bent. 	 2. Cruel, malignant. 	 3. Dishonest, fraudulent. 	 4. Indirect, evasive. 	 5. Long, (in prosody.) 	 n. (-क्रं) 	 1. The winding course of a river or waterfall, the arm or bend of a stream. 	 2. The retrograde motion of a pla-net. 	 3. A species of the Anushṭubh metre. 	 m. (-क्रः) 	 1. A name of SATURN. 	 2. The planet MARS. 	 3. RUDRA or ŚIVA. 	 4. The demon TRIPURĀ.  E. वकि to go crookedly, रक् Unādi aff.
वक्रकण्ट: वक्रकण्ट m. (-ण्टः) 	 1. The jujube tree. 	 2. The khadira tree.
वक्रखङ्क: वक्रखङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A sabre or scimitar.  E. वक्र crooked, and खङ्क a sword; also with कन् added, वक्रखङ्कक m. (-कः) ।
वक्रगामिन्: वक्रगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि) 	 1. Who or what goes tortuously. 	 2. Fraudulent, dishonest.  E. वक्र and गामिन् who goes.
वक्रग्रीव: वक्रग्रीव m. (-वः) A camel.  E. वक्र crooked, ग्रीवा the neck.
वक्रचञ्चु: वक्रचञ्चु m. (-ञ्चुः) A parrot.  E. वक्र crooked, and चञ्चु the beak.
वक्रता: वक्रता f. (-ता) 	 1. Crookedness. 	 2. Wickedness. 	 3. Craft, cunning. 	 4. Evasive or indirect speech.  E. वक्र, तल् added; also with त्व वक्तत्वं ।
वक्रतुण्ड: वक्रतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. An epithet of GANESA. 	 2. A parrot.  E. वक्र, तुण्ड a face.
वक्रदंष्ट्र: वक्रदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A boar.  E. वक्र crooked, and दंष्ट्र a tusk.
वक्रदृष्टि: वक्रदृष्टि Adj. 	 1. Envious. 	 2. Having an evil eye. 	 3. Squinting. 	 f. (-ष्टिः) An oblique look.
वक्रनक्र: वक्रनक्र m. (-क्रः) 	 1. A low or depraved man. 	 2. A parrot.  E. वक्र crooked, नक्र the nose, &c.
वक्रनासिक: वक्रनासिक m. (-कः) An owl.  E. वक्र crooked, and नासिका the nose.
वक्रपुच्छ: वक्रपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A dog.  E. वक्र crooked, and पुच्छ a tail; also वक्रपुच्छिक ।
वक्रपुष्प: वक्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The Sesbana grandiflora.  E. वक्र crooked, पुष्प the flower.
वक्रबालधि: वक्रबालधि m. (-धिः) A dog.  E. वक्र crooked, बालधि a tail.
वक्रभणित: वक्रभणित n. (-तं) Indirect speech, equivoque, evasion.  E. वक्र crooked, भणित spoken.
वक्रम: वक्रम m. (-मः) Flight, retreat.  E. अव reverse, क्रम् to go, aff. अच्, and the initial rejected.
वक्रवक्त्र: वक्रवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A hog.  E. वक्र crooked, and वक्त्र a face.
वक्राग्र: वक्राग्र n. (-ग्रं) A plant, commonly Bentua.
वक्राङ्ग: वक्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A goose. 	 2. The ruddy goose. 	 3. A snake.  E. वक्र bending, अङ्ग body.
वक्रि: वक्रि mfn. (-क्रिः-क्रिः-क्रि) Speaking falsely, uttering untruths, prevarica-ting, lying.  E. वक्र to be crooked, (metaphorically,) क्रिन् aff.
वक्रिन्: वक्रिन् mfn. (-क्री-क्रिणी-क्रि) 	 1. Crooked. 	 2. Dishonest, fraudulent. 	 m. (-क्री) A Jaina or Bauddha.  E. वक्र crooked, fraudulent, इनि aff.
वक्रिम: वक्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Bent, curved.  E. वकि to go crookedly, क्रिमच् aff.
वक्रिमन्: वक्रिमन् m. (-मा) 	 1. Crookedness, curvature. 	 2. Craftiness, cunning. 	 3. Indirectness.  E. वक्र, and इमनिच् aff.
वक्रीकरण: वक्रीकरण n. (-णं) Curving, bending, distorting.  E. वक्र, and करण making, च्वि augment.
वक्रीकृत: वक्रीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, made crooked.  E. वक्र, and कृत made, च्वि aug.
वक्रीभाव: वक्रीभाव m. (-वः) 	 1. Curvature, curve. 	 2. Fraudulent or dishonest dis-position.  E. वक्री, भाव property, च्वि aug.
वक्रीभूत: वक्रीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bent, crooked. 	 2. Dishonest.  E. वक्र, भूत become, च्वि aug.
वक्रोक्ति: वक्रोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Equivoque, evasion, pun, the covert expression of something else than the words used naturally imply, either from the manner in which they are uttered, or some other sense of which they are susceptible. 	 2. Hint, insinuation. 	 3. Sarcasm. It is thus defined in Sāhityadarpana:--“अन्यस्यान्यार्थकं वाक्यमन्यथायोजयेद्यदि । अन्यः श्लेषेण काक्वा वा सा वक्रोक्तिस्ततो द्विधा ॥” E. वक्र crooked, dishonest, and उक्ति speech.
वक्रोष्ठिका: वक्रोष्ठिका f. (-का) A gentle smile, one in which the teeth are not shewn. E. वक्र crooked, ओष्ठ the lip, and कन् aff., fem. form; also वक्रोष्टिः ।
वक्ष्: वक्ष् r. 1st cl. (वक्षति) To be angry. 	 2. To accumulate.
वक्षण: वक्षण n. (-णं) The breast: see वक्षस् ।
वक्षस्: वक्षस् n. (-क्षः) The breast, the bosom, the chest. 	 m. (-क्षाः) An ox, (con-fined to the Vedas.)  E. वच् to speak, or वक्ष् to accumulate, aff. असुन् in the first case सुट् is inserted; again वह् to bear, असुन् aff., सुट् augment, and the deriv. irr.
वक्षःसम्मर्दिनी: वक्षःसम्मर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) Wife of the bosom.  E. वक्षस् and सम्मर्द्दिनी who rubs.
वक्षःसम्मर्द्दिनी: वक्षःसम्मर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) Wife of the bosom.  E. वक्षस् and सम्मर्द्दिनी who rubs.
वक्ष: वक्षः(क्ष)स्थल n. (-लं) The breast, the heart.  E. वक्षस् and स्थल place.
वक्षः: वक्षः(क्ष)स्थल n. (-लं) The breast, the heart.  E. वक्षस् and स्थल place.
वक्षोज: वक्षोज n. (-जं) The female breast.  E. वक्षस् the breast or chest, ज born.
वक्षोरुह: वक्षोरुह m. (-हः) The female breast.  E. वक्षस् the chest, रुह what rises.

वग्: वग्(इ)वगि r. 1st cl. (वङ्गति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To go lamely, to limp.
वगाह: वगाह m. (-हः) Bathing, ablution.  E. अव before, गाह् to agitate, aff. अच्, and the initial rejected; also अवगाह ।
वग्नु: वग्नु m. (-ग्नुः) A speaker.  E. वच् to speak, नु Unādi aff., and च changed to ग ।
वघ्: वघ्(इ)वघि r. 1st cl. (वङ्घते) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To blame or censure. 	 3. To be-gin. 	 4. To begin moving. 	 5. To move swiftly.
वङ्क: वङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 	 1. The bend or elbow of a river, the winding course of a stream. 	 2. Crookedness. 	 f. (-ङ्का) The pummel of a saddle.  E. वकि to curve or bend, aff. घञ् ।
वङ्किल: वङ्किल m. (-लः) A thorn.  E. वङ्क crookedness, इलच् aff.
वङ्क्य: वङ्क्य mfn. (-ङ्क्यः-ङ्क्या-ङ्क्यं) Crooked, curved.  E. वञ्च् to go, ण्यत् aff., च changed to क ।

वङ्क्षण: वङ्क्षण n. (-णं) The groin, the public and iliac regions.  E. वाञ्छि to desire, ल्युट् aff., and the form irr.; or वक्ष् to accumulate, ल्युट् aff. and नुम् augment.
वङ्क्षु: वङ्क्षु f. (-ङ्क्षुः) A small arm or branch of the Ganges.  E. वङ्क्ष् to accumulate, aff. उ.
वङ्ग: वङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. Lead. 	 2. Tin. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. Bengal, or the eastern parts of the modern province. 	 2. Cotton. 	 3. The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.)  E. वगि to go, अच् aff.
वङ्गन: वङ्गन m. (-नः) The egg-plant. “वेगुण गाछ ।”  E. वगि to go, ल्युट् aff.
वङ्गशुल्वज: वङ्गशुल्वज n. (-जं) Brass.  E. वङ्ग tin, शुल्व copper, and ज produced; an alloy of tin and copper.
वङ्गसेन: वङ्गसेन m. (-नः) The Sesbana grandiflora. “वक्फुलेर गाछ ।”  E. वङ्ग Bengal, सि to sew, aff. ल्युट्; also with कन् added, वङ्गसेनक ।
वङ्गारि: वङ्गारि m. (-रिः) Yellow orpiment.  E. वङ्ग lead, and अरि a foe.
वङ्गुला: वङ्गुला f. (-ला) A mode of music.
वच्: वच्(औ)औवच r. 1st cl. (वचति) r. 2nd cl. (वक्ति) and 10th cl. (वाचयति-ते) 	 1. To speak, to tell. 	 2. To inform. 	 3. To read, to expound. 	 4. To name: (the second cl. is the most usual form of the root, in which its inflections however are very irregular.) With प्र, 1. To begin to speak. 	 2. To call. 	 3. To announce. With प्रति, To answer. With अनु, To recite. With निस्, To explain etymologically.
वच: वच m. (-चः) 	 1. A parrot. 	 2. The sun. 	 f. (-चा) 	 1. Orris root, (Acorus calamus; also Zinziber Zedoaria.) 	 2. The Sārikā, (Turdus Salica.) E. वच् to speak, अच् aff.
वचक्नु: वचक्नु mfn. (-क्नुः-क्नुः-क्नु) Talkative, loquacious, eloquent. 	 m. (-क्नुः) A Brāhmana.  E. वच् to speak, Unādi aff. अक्नुच् ।

वचनकर: वचनकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Obedient. 	 2. Speaking. 	 m. (-रः) The author or enunciator of a precept.  E. वचन, and कर who makes.
वचनक्रम: वचनक्रम m. (-मः) Discourse, order of words.  E. वचन, and क्रम order.
वचनग्राहिन्: वचनग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Compliant, conformable, submissive, humble.  E. वचन speech, ग्राहिन् taking, obeying.
वचनविरुद्ध: वचनविरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Contrary to a text or precept.  E. वचन, विरुद्ध्व opposed.

वचनव्यक्ति: वचनव्यक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Distinctness or perspicuity of a text.  E. वचन, and व्यक्ति plainness.
वचनीय: वचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be spoken or said. 	 2. Censurable, to be noticed or reproved. 	 n. (-यं) Censure.  E. वच् to speak. अनीयर् aff.
वचनीयता: वचनीयता f. (-ता) 	 1. Rumour, report, especially ill report, detraction, scandal. 	 2. Blame, reprehension.  E. वचनीय to be censured, तल् aff.; also with त्व, aff., वचनीयत्वं ।
वचनमात्र: वचनमात्र n. (-त्रं) Mere words, assertion unsupported by facts.  E. वचन, मात्र only.
वचनशत: वचनशत n. (-तं) Repeated speech or declaration.  E. वचन, शत a hundred.
वचनेस्थित: वचनेस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compliant, conformable, obedient.  E. वचने in the word, and स्थित who stays.
वचर: वचर m. (-रः) 	 1. A cock. 	 2. A rogue, a cheat.  E. वच् to speak, अरन् aff.
वचलु: वचलु m. (-लुः) Offence, fault.  E. वच् to speak. अलुच् aff.
वचस्: वचस् n. (-चः) 	 1. Speech, voice. 	 2. Words. 	 3. A sentence. 	 4. Advice. 	 5. Command. 	 6. Number, (in gram.)  E. वच् to speak, असुन् aff.
वचस्कर: वचस्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Obedient, compliant.  E. वचस्, and कर who does.
वज्: वज् r. 1st cl. (वजति) To go. r. 10th cl. (वाजयति-ते) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To make. 	 3. To prepare the way. 	 4. To trim or feather an arrow.
वज्र: वज्र mfn. (-ज्रः-ज्रा-ज्रं) 	 1. Hard, impenetrable, adamantine. 	 2. Cross, fork-ed. 	 mn. (-ज्रः-ज्रं) 	 1. A thunder-bolt in general, or the thunderbolt of INDRA, which is said to have formed out of the bones of the sage Dadhīchī, (in Hindu mytho.) 	 2. The diamond, (the gem being considered analogous in hardness to the thunder-bolt, or in fact to be the same substance.) 	 3. A diagram, the figure of which is supposed to be that of the thunder-bolt. 	 4. A child or pupil. 5. Emblic myrobalan. 	 6. Sour gruel. 	 7. The blossom of the se-samum. 	 8. Harsh language. 	 m. (-ज्रः) 	 1. One of the astronomi-cal Yogas. 	 2. Kuśa grass. 	 3. A form of military array. 	 n. (-ज्रं) 1. Steel. 	 2. A kind of talc. 	 3. Severe language. 	 4. A child. 	 f. (-ज्रा-ज्री) A species of Euphorbia f. (-ज्रा) 	 1. A plant: see गुडुची. 	 2. A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.)  E. वज् to go, रन् aff.
वज्रक: वज्रक n. (-कं) A sort of salt, an impure carbonate of soda.  E. कन् added to the last.
वज्रकङ्कट: वज्रकङ्कट m. (-टः) Hanumāna, the monkey demigod.  E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and कङ्कट armour.
वज्रकण्टक: वज्रकण्टक m. (-कः) Euphorbia.  E. वज्र a thunder-bolt, and कण्टक a thorn.
वज्रकपालिन्: वज्रकपालिन् m. (-ली) One of the Bauddha saints.
वज्रक्षार: वज्रक्षार n. (-रं) An alkaline earth, an impure carbonate of soda.  E. वज्र diamond, क्षार alkali.
वज्रजित्: वज्रजित् m. (-जित्) A name of GARUDĀ.  E. वज्र bolt, जित् who conquers; being invulnerable to repeated shocks of INDRA'S bolt.
वज्रज्वाला: वज्रज्वाला f. (-ला) A clap of thunder.  E. वज्र the bolt, and ज्वाला flame.
वज्रटीक: वज्रटीक m. (-कः) A Jaina deified saint.
वज्रतुण्ड: वज्रतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. The deity GANESA. 	 2. GARUDĀ, the bird and vehicle of VISHṆU. 	 3. A vulture. 	 4. A gnat, a musquito.  E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and तुण्ड face or beak, (as hard.)
वज्रदन्त: वज्रदन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A hog. 	 2. A rat.  E. वज्र a thunder-bolt, (as hard,) दन्त a tooth.
वज्रदशन: वज्रदशन m. (-नः) A rat.  E. वज्र and दशन a tooth; see the last.
वज्रद्रु: वज्रद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Euphorbia of various species.  E. वज्र thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and द्रु a tree; also वज्रद्रुम ।
वज्रद्रुम: वज्रद्रुम m. (-मः) Euphorbia: see the last.
वज्रधर: वज्रधर m. (-रः) 	 1. INDRA, as the JUPITER Tonans of the Hindus. 2. A Bauddha saint.  E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, धर who has or holds.
वज्रनाभ: वज्रनाभ m. (-भः) The discus of KRISHṆA.
वज्रनिर्घोष: वज्रनिर्घोष m. (-षः) A clap of thunder.  E. वज्र the bolt, and निर्घोष sound.
वज्रनिष्पेष: वज्रनिष्पेष m. (-षः) A clap of thunder.  E. वज्र the bolt, and निष्पेष here meaning the sound produced by friction or concussion, from निर् forth, पिष् to grind, aff. घञ् ।
वज्रपाणि: वज्रपाणि m. (-णिः) INDRA.  E. वज्र the bolt, पाणि the hand: see वज्रधर ।
वज्रपात: वज्रपात m. (-तः) A thunder-bolt, a stoke of lightning.  E. वज्र, पात fall.
वज्रपुष्प: वज्रपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) The blossom of the sesamum. “तिलपुष्पे ।”
वज्रबध: वज्रबध m. (-धः) 	 1. Death by lightning. 	 2. Cross multiplication.  E. वज्र, and बध killing, or multiplying.
वज्रमय: वज्रमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 	 1. Hard, adamantine. 	 2. Hard-hearted.  E. वज्र, and मयट् aff.
वज्ररद: वज्ररद m. (-दः) A hog.  E. वज्र a thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and रद a tooth.
वज्रलप: वज्रलप m. (-पः) A kind of hard cement.
वज्रवराही: वज्रवराही f. (-ही) A female personification of Māyā or unreality, amongst the Bauddhas.
वज्रवल्ली: वज्रवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A species of sun-flower, (Heliotropium.)  E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, वल्ली a creeper.
वज्रशृङ्खला: वज्रशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A female deification peculiar to the Jainas, and one of their sixteen Vidyā-Devis.  E. वज्र a diamond, and शृङ्खला a chain.
वज्रसार: वज्रसार Adj. Of the nature of a diamond, (as hard.)
वज्राङ्ग: वज्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A snake. 	 f. (-ङ्गी) A sort of grain, (Coix barbata.) “गवेधु”. the thunder-bolt, (as hard,) अङ्ग body or substance.
वज्राघात: वज्राघात m. (-तः) 	 1. A thunder-bolt or stroke. 	 2. A sudden calamity. E. वज्र, आघात blow.
वज्राभ: वज्राभ m. (-भः) Precious opal.  E. वज्र the diamond, (in hardness perhaps,) आभ resembling.
वज्राभ्यास: वज्राभ्यास m. (-सः) Cross multiplication.  E. वज्र, and अभ्यास practising.
वज्रिन्: वज्रिन् m. (-ज्री) 	 1. INDRA. 	 2. A Jaina deified saint. 	 3. A buffalo. 	 4. An owl.  E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, इनि aff.
वञ्च्: वञ्च्(उ)वञ्चु r. 1st cl. (वञ्चति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To go secretly. r. 1st and 10th cls. (वञ्चते वञ्चयते) To delude, to cheat, to trick or deceive. Caus. (वञ्चयति-ते) 	 1. To shun, to evade. 	 2. To beguile, to defraud.
वञ्चक: वञ्चक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Fraudulent, crafty. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A jackal 2. A tame or house ichneumon. 	 3. A rogue, a cheat. 	 4. A low or vile man. 	 5. A musk-rat. 	 f. (-चिका) Cheating.  E. वञ्च् to cheat, ण्वुल् aff.
वञ्चथ: वञ्चथ m. (-थः) A rogue, a knave, a cheat.  E. वञ्च् to cheat, Unādi aff. अथ ।
वञ्चन: वञ्चन n. (-नं) Cheating, fraud.  E. वञ्च् to cheat, ल्युट् aff.
वञ्चनीय: वञ्चनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be cheated.  E. वञ्च to cheat, अनीयर् aff.
वञ्चयित्वा: वञ्चयित्वा Ind. Having cheated.  E. वञ्च् to cheat, क्त्वाच् aff.
वञ्चित: वञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tricked, deceived. 	 f. (-ता) A kind of riddle. E. वञ्च् to cheat, aff. क्त.
वञ्चुक: वञ्चुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Crafty, fraudulent. 	 m. (-कः) A jackal.  E. वञ्च् to cheat, aff. उकन् ।
वञ्च्य: वञ्च्य mfn. (-ञ्च्य-ञ्च्या-ञ्च्यं) 	 1. To be gone. 	 2. To be cheated.  E. वञ्च् to go, यत् aff.
वञ्जुल: वञ्जुल m. (-लः) 	 1. A tree, (Dalbergia Ougeinensis.) 	 2. Another tree, (Jonesia Asoca.) 	 3. Common cane, (Calamus rotang.) 	 4. A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 	 5. A sort of bird. 	 f. (-ला) A cow that yields abundance of milk.  E. वञ्च to go, aff. उलच्, च changed to ज ।

वट: वट Subst. 	 mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) A string, a rope, a tie. 	 m. (-टः) 	 1. The large Indian fig-tree, (Ficus Indica.) 	 2. A round figure, a circle, a cipher, a ball or globe. 	 3. Pulse ground and fried with oil or butter. 	 4. A small shell, a cowrie. 	 5. Equality in shape or dimen-sion.  E. वट् to surround, to tie, aff. अच् ।
वटक: वटक m. (-कः) 	 1. Pulse ground and fried in oil or butter. 	 2. A weight of eight Māshās. 	 f. (-टिका) A pill.  E. वट् to surround, aff. क्वुन् ।

वटि: वटि m. (-टिः) A sort of tick or body louse.  E. वट् to surround, aff. इन् ।

वटिन्: वटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) 	 1. Stringed, having a string. 	 2. Circular, glo-bular.  E. वट, and इनि aff.

वण्ठर: वण्ठर m. (-रः) 	 1. The new shoot of the Tāl or palm tree. 	 2. The sheath that envelopes the young bamboo. 	 3. A rope for tying a goat, &c. 4. A female breast. 	 5. A dog's tail. 	 6. A dog. 	 7. A cloud.  E. वठि to go alone, aff. अरच् ।

वत्: वत् Ind. As, like, similar: this is more generally considered as an affix to words, termed technically वति, as ब्राह्मणवत् like a Brāh man, &c. 	 f. (-वती) An affix added to nouns to form possessive adjectives, as लक्ष्मीवत्; also added to past passive participles to form past active participles, as कृतवत् ।

वतण्ड: वतण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The name of a Muni.  E. अव before, तडि to beat, aff. अच्, अ rejected.
वतोका: वतोका f. (-का) 	 1. A cow miscarrying from accident. 	 2. A barren wo-man.  E. अव before, तोक offspring, and अ rejected; also अवतोका ।

वत्सर: वत्सर m. (-रः) 	 1. A year. 	 2. An epithet of VISHṆU.  E. वस् to abide, सरन् Unādi aff.
वत्सरान्तक: वत्सरान्तक m. (-कः) The month Phālguṇa.  E. वत्सर, and अन्तक destroyer.
वत्सल: वत्सल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Afflctionate, kind. 	 n. (-लं) Affection, fondness. 	 f. (-ला) A cow anxious for her calf. 	 m. (-लः) A fire fed with grass. E. वत्स a child, and लच् aff.
वत्सलता: वत्सलता f. (-ता) Tenderness, affection.  E. वत्सल, तल् aff.; also with त्व, वत्सलत्वं ।
वत्साक्षी: वत्साक्षी f. (-क्षी) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.)
वत्सादन: वत्सादन m. (-नः) A wolf. 	 f. (-नी) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. वत्स a calf, अदन food.
वत्सीय: वत्सीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Proper or fit for a calf. 	 m. (-यः) A cowherd. E. वत्स a calf, &c., and छ aff.
वद्: वद् r. 1st and 10th cl. (वदति-ते वदयति-ते) 	 1. To inform, to speak to or tell, to declare. 	 2. To speak articulately. 	 3. To abide. 	 4. To shine. 5. To be an authority on. 	 6. To toil. With अनु, (अनुवदते) 1. To speak similarly or subsequently. 	 2. To resound. 	 3. To confirm, to ratify. 	 4. To imitate in loud and distinct voice. With अप prefixed, (अपवदति-ते) To reprove, to censure. With, अभि, To salute respect-fully or by name. With उप, (उपवदते) 1. To explain. 	 2. To flatter, to cajole. 	 3. To conciliate, to persuade. With निर्, To speak out or plainly. With परि, (परिवदति) To speak against. With प्र, 1. To rumour, to slander. 	 2. To call. 	 3. To consider. With प्रति, (प्रति-वदति) To reply to or answer. With वि, (विवदते) 1. To dispute. 	 2. To litigate. With वि and प्र, (विप्रवदति or -ते) To wrangle or dispute together. With वि, and प्र, To break a promise. With सम and प्र, (संप्रवदते) To speak articulately in concert; (संप्रवदति) To utter or articulate sounds together. With सम, 1. To converse. 	 2. To speak to. 	 3. To call, to name. 	 4. To coincide, to resemble, (with an inst.) Caus. (वादयति-ते) 	 1. To cause to utter. 	 2. To play on an instrument. With अभि, To salute. With वि, and सम्, To make inconsistent. With सम्, To consult, (with an inst.) (इ) वदि (वन्दते) 1. To salute with reverence or respect. 	 2. To praise, to eulogize.
वद: वद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Speaking, able to speak, speaking well or sensibly. E. वद् to speak, अच् aff.
वदत्: वदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Speaking, saying.  E. वद् to speak, शतृ aff.
वदन: वदन n. (-नं) 	 1. The mouth, the face. 	 2. The front. 	 3. Look, appearance. 4. The summit or apex of a triangle.  E. वद् to speak, aff. ल्युट् ।

वदनेन्दु: वदनेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) The face.  E. वदन, इन्दु the moon; also similar com-pounds, as वदनचन्द्र, &c.
वदन्ति: वदन्ति f. (-न्तिः-न्ती) Speech, discourse, talk.  E. वद् to say or speak, झिच् Unādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
वदन्य: वदन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Munificent, bountiful.  E. वद् to speak, aff. अन्य; also वदान्य ।
वदमान: वदमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Saying, calling. 	 2. Glorifying, boasting. E. वद् to speak, शानच् aff.
वदरिक: वदरिक m. (-कः) The jujube: see बदरि ।
वदान्य: वदान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) 	 1. Liberal, munificent. 	 2. Speaking kindly or agreeably. 	 3. Eloquent.  E. वद् to speak, अन्य Unādi aff.
वदाल: वदाल m. (-लः) 	 1. A sheat-fish, (Silurus Boalis, HAM.) 	 2. A whirl-pool. E. वद् to speak, aff. आलच्, also with कन् added, वदालक m. (-कः).
वदावद: वदावद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Speaking, a speaker, able to speak, able to speak well, eloquent.  E. वद् to speak, aff. अच्, the root repeated, and आ inserted.
वदि: वदि Ind. In the dark half of, (any month.)
वद्य: वद्य f. (-द्या) Adj. 	 1. Unblamable. 	 2. The second or dark, (fortnight of a lunar month.) 	 n. (-द्यं) Speech, speaking.
वधु: वधु f. (-धुः) 	 1. A son's wife. 	 2. A wife in general. वह् to bear, उ aff.; more commonly वधू ।
वधुका: वधुका f. (-का) A wife.  E. वधु for वधू, and कन् added.
वधुटी: वधुटी f. (-टी) A daughter-in-law: see वधूटी ।

वधूशयन: वधूशयन n. (-नं) A lattice, a loop-hole.

वनकरिन्: वनकरिन् m. (-री) A wild elephant.  E. वन, and करिन् an elephant.
वनकार्पासी: वनकार्प्पासी f. (-सी) Wild cotton, or a plant resembling it, (Hibiscus vitifolius.)  E. वन a wood, and कार्प्पासी cotton.
वनकार्प्पासी: वनकार्प्पासी f. (-सी) Wild cotton, or a plant resembling it, (Hibiscus vitifolius.)  E. वन a wood, and कार्प्पासी cotton.
वनकुक्कुट: वनकुक्कुट m. (-टः) Wild fowl.  E. वन and कुक्कुट a cock.
वनगज: वनगज m. (-जः) A wild elephant.  E. वन, and गज an elephant.
वनगहन: वनगहन n. (-नं) A thicket.  E. वन, and गहन the same.
वनगुप्त: वनगुप्त m. (-प्तः) A spy, an emissary.  E. वन a wood, and गुप्त concealed.

वनचर: वनचर m. (-रः) 	 1. A forester, a woodman. 	 2. A wild animal. 	 3. The fabulous animal called Sārabha.

वनच्छेद: वनच्छेद m. (-दः) Cutting timber.  E. वन, and छेद who cuts.
वनच्छाग: वनछाग m. (-गः) 	 1. A wild goat. 	 2. A hog.  E. वन a wood, and छाग a goat.
वनछाग: वनछाग m. (-गः) 	 1. A wild goat. 	 2. A hog.  E. वन a wood, and छाग a goat.
वनच्छिद्: वनछिद् m. (-द्) A wood-cutter.  E. वन, and छिद् who cuts.
वनछिद्: वनछिद् m. (-द्) A wood-cutter.  E. वन, and छिद् who cuts.

वनधारा: वनधारा f. (-रा) An avenue of trees.

वनपादप: वनपादप m. (-पः) A forest tree.  E. वन, पादप a tree.

वनप्रस्थ: वनप्रस्थ n. (-स्थं) A wood situated on table land.

वनलक्ष्मी: वनलक्ष्मी f. (-क्ष्मी) 	 1. The plantain. 	 2. The beauty of a wood.

वनसमूह: वनसमूह m. (-हः) A multitude of groves or forests.  E. वन, and समूह a collection.

वनार्चक: वनार्च्चक m. (-कः) A flower-gatherer.  E. वन a wood, अर्च्च् to go, वुन् aff.
वनार्च्चक: वनार्च्चक m. (-कः) A flower-gatherer.  E. वन a wood, अर्च्च् to go, वुन् aff.
वनालिका: वनालिका f. (-का) A sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.)  E. वन a wood, अल् to adorn, aff. वन् and fem. form.

वनि: वनि m. (-निः) 	 1. Fire or its deity. 	 2. Wish, desire.  E. वन् to worship, Unādi aff. इन् ।

वनिन्: वनिन् m. (-नी) 	 1. A tree. 	 2. A Brāhman in the third stage of his life.
वनिष्ठु: वनिष्ठु m. (-ष्ठुः) The entrails of an animal offered in sacrifice.  E. वन् to worship, इष्ठुच् Unādi aff.
वनिष्णु: वनिष्णु Adj. Begging, soliciting.  E. वन, इष्णुच् aff.
वनीक: वनीक m. (-कः) A beggar; also वनीयक ।
वनीयक: वनीयक m. (-कः) A beggar, a mendicant.  E. वन् to ask, इन् aff., क्यच् and वुन् added; also य being changed to प, वनीपक ।

वनेचराग्र्य: वनेचराग्र्य m. (-ग्र्यः) An ascetic, an anchorite.  E. वनेचर and अग्र्य a chief.
वनेशय: वनेशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Living in the woods.  E. वने, शी to sleep, श aff.
वनैकदेश: वनैकदेश m. (-शः) A part of a thicket.  E. वन, and एकदेश a part.
वनोत्साह: वनोत्साह m. (-हः) A rhinoceros.  E. वन a wood, and उत्साह effort.
वनोद्देश: वनोद्देश m. (-शः) A part of a thicket.  E. वन, and उद्देश direction.
वनोद्भव: वनोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in a forest. 	 f. (-वा) Wild cotton.  E. वन a wood, उद्भव produced.
वनीकस्: वनीकस् m. (-काः) 	 1. A forester. 	 2. A monkey, an ape. 	 3. An ascetic. E. वन wood, ओकस् dwelling.
वन्दका: वन्दका f. (-का) A parasite plant.  E. वन्दा the same, कन् aff.

A drug for reviving the dead. 	 f. (-ना) Praise, praising, especially the gods or great men. E. वदि to praise, aff. ल्युट् or युच्, fem. aff. ङीष् or टाप् ।

वन्दाका: वन्दाका f. (-का) A parasite plant.  E. वदि, आकन् aff.
वन्दार: वन्दार m. (-रः) A parasite plant.  E. वन्दा the same, ऋ to go, or be, aff. अच् ।
वन्दारु: वन्दारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) 	 1. Civil, complementary, polite. 	 2. Praising, celebrating. 	 m. (-रुः) A panegyrist, a bard.  E. वदि to praise, आरु aff.

वन्दीकार: वन्दीकार m. (-रः) A thief, a house-breaker.

वप्रि: वप्रि m. (-प्रिः) 	 1. A field. 	 2. The ocean.  E. वप् to sow, Unādi aff. रि ।

(-स्था) 	 1. The moon-plant, (Asclepias acida.) 	 2. Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) 3. Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 	 4. Small cardamoms. 5. A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 	 6. वशि: वशि m. (-शिः) Subjugating, fascinating, bewitching, holding others in magical or mysterious submission to one's will.  E. वश् to desire, (supremacy,) इन् affix; also with तल् and त्व affs. वशिता and वशित्वं ।
वशिक: वशिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Void, empty. 	 f. (-का) Aloe-wood.  E. वश् to desire, इन् aff., and कन् added.
वशिता: वशिता f. (-ता) 	 1. Fascinating, bewitching. 	 2. Subjection, holding in order or subjugation; also वशित्वं.  E. वशिन् and तल् or त्व aff.
वशिन्: वशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 	 1. Subdued, subjugated, in subjection. 	 2. Powerful. 	 m. (-शी) A sage with subdued passions. 	 f. (-शिनी) 	 1. The Śhamī tree, (Mimosa Sama, Rox.) 	 2. A parasite plant.  E. वश, इनि and ङीप् affixes.
वशिर: वशिर n. (-रं) Sea-salt. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) 	 2. A sort of long pepper: see वशीर. 	 3. Orris root.  E. वश् to desire, इरन् aff.
वशिष्ठ: वशिष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) VASHISṬHA, a Rishi or divine sage of the first order, he is also a Brahmādika, a Prajāpati, and one of the seven stars of Ursa Major.  E. अव before, शास् to govern, to instruct, (the other saints,) aff. क्त; the first vowel of the prefix rejected: also written वशिष्ट and वसिष्ट । अतिशयेन वशी इष्ठन् इनेर्लुक् ।
वशीकरण: वशीकरण n. (-ण) 	 1. Subduing or overcoming by drugs, charms, &c., enchanting, charming. 	 2. Subduing in general.  E. वश subduing, and करण making, च्वि augment, leaving ई.
वशीकृत: वशीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bewitched, fascinated, subjected to another's will.  E. वशी and कृत made, च्वि augment.
वशीभूत: वशीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subjugated, subject to another's will.  E. वशी and भूत become, च्वि augment.
वशीर: वशीर m. (-रः) A pungent fruit resembling pepper, (Pothos officinalis:) also वशिर ।  E. वश, ईरन् aff. “गजपिप्पल्याम् ।”
वश्य: वश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 	 1. Docile, tame, humble, governable. 	 2. To be tamed or humbled. 	 m. (-श्यः) A dependent, a slave, f. (-श्या) A do-cile and obedient wife. 	 n. (-श्यं) Cloves.  E. वश subjection, यत् aff.
वश्यका: वश्यका f. (-का) An obedient wife.  E. वश्या and कन् added.
वश्यता: वश्यता f. (-ता) Humility, subjugation, disposition to, or fitness for sub-jection.  E. वश्य and तल् aff.; also with त्व, वश्यत्वं ।
वश्यात्मन्: वश्यात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Of subdued mind.  E. वशी and आत्मन् spirit.
वष्: वष् r. 1st cl. (वषति) To kill or hurt.
वषट्: वषट् Ind. An exclamation used on making an oblation to a deity with fire, (used with a dat.)  E. वह् to bear or convey, aff. डषट् ।
वषट्कर्तृ: वषट्कर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) The priest who pours the oiled butter into the fire at a sacrifice with the exclamation वषट्.  E. वषट् an exclamation, &c., and कर्त्तृ who makes.
वषट्कर्त्तृ: वषट्कर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) The priest who pours the oiled butter into the fire at a sacrifice with the exclamation वषट्.  E. वषट् an exclamation, &c., and कर्त्तृ who makes.
वषट्कार: वषट्कार m. (-रः) 	 1. The formula वषट्. 	 2. An oblation made with the exclamation वषट्.  E. वषट् the exclamation used on this occasion, and कार making.
वषटकृत: वषटकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Offered or sacrificed with fire with the formula वषट्.  E. वषट् as above, कृत made.
वष्क्: वष्क् r. 1st cl. (वष्कते) r. 10th cl. (वष्कयति-ते) 	 1. To see. 	 2. To go, to move.
वष्कय: वष्कय m. (-यः) A one year old calf.  E. वष्क् to go, अयन् aff.
वष्कयणी: वष्कयणी f. (-णी) A cow bearing many calves.  E. वष्कय a calf, नी to have, affs. ड and ङीष्; also वष्कय, with इनि and ङीप् affs., वष्कयिणी ।
वस्: वस्(औ)औवस r. 1st cl. (वसति) To dwell or inhabit. r. 2nd cl. (वस्ते) To cover with dress, to wear as clothes. r. 10th cl. (वसयति-ते) 	 1. To per-fume. 	 2. To dwell. (वासयति-ते) 	 1. To be affectionate, to love. 	 2. To cut or divide. 	 3. To kill. 	 4. To accept. (इर, उ) इरवसु r. 4th cl. (वस्यति) To be straight, to be unbending; literally or figuratively. With अधि prefixed, To sit upon, to occupy. With उप, To fast. With नि, 1. To dwell in or inhabit. 	 2. To dress. With प्र, To dwell abroad. With सम्, To cohabit. Caus. (वासयति-ते) 	 1. To cause to live or dwell. 	 2. To put on, to dress. With निस्, To drive away, to expel, to banish. With प्र, To exile.
वसत्: वसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती or सती-सत्) 	 1. Dwelling, inhabiting. 	 2. Wearing, (as clothes.)  E. वस् to dwell, शतृ aff.
वसति: वसति f. (-तिः or ती) 	 1. A house, a dwelling. 	 2. Abiding, abode, resi-dence. 	 3. Night.  E. वस् to dwell, अति Unādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
वसन: वसन n. (-नं) 	 1. Cloth or clothes. 	 2. Covering, clothing. 	 3. A dwelling, a house. 	 4. An ornament worn by women round the loins. 	 5. Dwelling, residing.  E. वस् to be clothed, &c., aff. ल्युट् ।
वसनसद्मन्: वसनसद्मन् n. (-द्म) A tent.  E. वसन and सद्मन् a dwelling.
वसन्त: वसन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. Vasanta, the season of spring, comprising the month of Chaitra and Vaisākha, or its deified personification, which is considered to be a companion of KĀMADEVA. 	 2. Dysentery, diarrhœa. 	 3. Small-pox.  E. वस् to dwell, Unādi aff. झच्, as applied to the season, when love is especially present on earth.
वसन्तकुसुम: वसन्तकुसुम m. (-मः) A tree, (Cordia myxa and latifolia.)  E. वसन्त spring, कुसुम a flower; blossoming in the spring. “वसन्तफुलेर गाछ ।”
वसन्तघोषिन्: वसन्तघोषिन् m. (-षी) The Indian cuckoo or Kokila.  E. वसन्त spring, घोषिन् who sings.
वसन्तज: वसन्तज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in the spring. 	 f. (-जा) 	 1. A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held in the month of Chaitra. 	 2. The Mādhabi creeper.  E. वसन्त, ज born.
वसन्तदूत: वसन्तदूत m. (-तः) 	 1. The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 	 2. The month Chai-tra, (March-April.) 	 3. The mango tree. 	 f. (-ती) 	 1. The trumpet flower. 	 2. A large and beautiful creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) E. वसन्त spring, and दूत the messenger.
वसन्तद्रु: वसन्तद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.)  E. वसन्त spring, and द्रु a tree, or वसन्तद्रुम; the mango blossoms in March or April, and is then an object of great beauty.
वसन्तपञ्चमी: वसन्तपञ्चमी f. (-मी) The fifth day of the light-half of Māgha.
वसन्तसख: वसन्तसख m. (-खः) KAMADEVA or CUPID.  E. वसन्त spring, सखि the friend.
वसन्तोत्सव: वसन्तोत्सव n. (-वं) The celebration of the return of spring, formerly held on the full-moon of Chaitra, but now on the full-moon of Phāl-guṇa, being identified with the Dola-yātra or Holi.  E. वसन्त and उत्सव a festival.
वसा: वसा f. (-सा) 	 1. The serum or marrow of the flesh, considered by some authorities as distinct from the marrow of the bones, though regarded by others as the same substance. 	 2. Adeps, fat, suet. E. वस् to divide, (in the body,) अङ् and टाप् affs.; or वस्-अच् ।
वसाढ्य: वसाढ्य m. (-ढ्यः) The Gangetic porpoise, (Delphinus Gangeticus;) also वसाढ्यक and वशाढ्यक, the last perhaps incorrectly.
वसान: वसान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wearing, putting on, (as clothes.)  E. वस् to clothe, शानच् aff.
वसापायिन्: वसापायिन् m. (-यी) A dog.  E. वसा and पायिन् who drinks.
वसि: वसि m. (-सिः) 	 1. Dwelling, abode. 	 2. A dwelling. 	 3. Clothes.  E. वस् to dwell, Unādi aff. इन् ।
वसित: वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Stored, (as grain.) 	 2. Dwelling, inhabiting. 3. Put on, worn. 	 n. (-तं) Abiding, residence. 	 f. (-ता) The power of subduing all things: see वशिता.  E. वस् to dwell, &c., क्त aff.; or वशिता as above, and श changed to स ।
वसितृ: वसितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what wears.  E. वस् to put on, तृच् aff.
वसित्वा: वसित्वा Ind. Having put on, (as clothes,) wearing.  E. वस् to wear, क्त्वा aff.
वसिर: वसिर n. (-रं) Sea-salt. 	 m. (-रः) A pungent fruit, considered as a sort of pepper, (Pothos officinalis.)  E. वस् to abide, (in the sea,) इरन् aff.; also, as derived from वश् to desire, वशिर &c.
वसिष्ठ: वसिष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A celebrated Muni.  E. वस् to abide, (in the practice of religious austerities,) aff. णिनि, वसिन्, superlative aff. इष्टन् added; pre-eminent amongst the ascetics; also वशिष्ठ &c.
वसु: वसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) 	 1. Sweet, sweet-flavoured. 	 2. Dry, dried. 	 n. (-सु) 	 1. Wealth, thing, substance. 	 2. A gem, a jewel. 	 3. A medicinal root, commonly Vriddhi. 	 4. Water. 	 5. Gold. 	 6. A yellow kind of kidney-bean. 	 7. A sort of salt. 	 8. The number eight, i. e. the eight Vasus. 	 m. (-सुः) 	 1. A kind of demi-god, of whom eight are enumer-ated, viz.:--DHARA, DHRUVA, SOMA or the moon, ĀPA, ANILA or wind, ANALA or fire, PRABHĀSA and PRATYUSA. 	 2. A name of ĀGNI or fire. 	 3. A ray of light. 	 4. The tie of a yoke. 	 5. A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) 	 6. The name of a king. 	 7. A name of KUVERA. 	 8. A tree in general. 	 9. A lake, a pool. 	 10. A rein, a halter. 	 11. A plant, (Trophis aspera.) 	 12. ŚIVA. 	 13. The sun. 14. A kind of fish.  E. वस् to abide or dwell, Unādi aff. उ ।

वसु(सू)क n. (-कं) A fossil-salt, brought from a district in Ajmere, Sambhar-salt. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A shrub, (Gigantic Asclepias.) 	 2. A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)  E. कन् added to the preceding; or वसु wealth, कै to sound, aff. ड ।
वसुकीट: वसुकीट m. (-टः) A supplicant, a beggar, a petitioner.  E. वसु wealth, कीट a worm.
वसुदा: वसुदा f. (-दा) The earth.  E. वसु wealth, and दा who gives.
वसुदेव: वसुदेव m. (-वः) BASUDEVA, the father of KRISHṆA.  E. वसु a deity, the in-carnation of one of the Vasus, or वसु wealth, दिव् to shine, aff. अच् ।
वसुदेवता: वसुदेवता f. (-ता) The constellation Dhanisṭhā.  E. वसु the Vasus, and देवता divinity; presiding over the asterism.
वसुदेवभू: वसुदेवभू m. (-भूः) KRISHṆA.  E. वसुदेव and भू born.
वसुदेव्या: वसुदेव्या f. (-व्या) 	 1. The asterism Dhanisṭhā. 	 2. The ninth day of the fortnight.
वसुधा: वसुधा f. (-धा) The earth.  E. वसु wealth, धा to have or contain, affs. क and टाप् ।
वसुधाधर: वसुधाधर m. (-रः) A mountain.  E. वसुधा and धर what holds.
वसुधाधिप: वसुधाधिप m. (-पः) A king.  E. वसुधा and अधिप sovereign.
वसुधानगर: वसुधानगर n. (-रं) The capital of VARUṆA in the western ocean.
वसुधारा: वसुधारा f. (-रा) 	 1. A female Śaktī peculiar to the Jainas. 	 2. The capital of KUVERA.  E. वसु wealth, धृ to have, affs. घञ् and टाप्; some authorities read वसुभारा for KUVERA'S capital.
वसुन्धरा: वसुन्धरा f. (-रा) The earth.  E. वसु wealth, धृ to have, खच् aff.
वसुप्राण: वसुप्राण m. (-णः) Fire or its deity, AGNI.  E. वसु a Vasu, प्राण life.
वसुमत्: वसुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Wealthy, rich. 	 f. (-ती) The earth.  E. वसु wealth, and मतुप् aff.
वसुरोचिस्: वसुरोचिस् n. (-चिः) A religious ceremony in which the demi-gods called Vasus especially are worshipped.  E. वसु, रुच् to shine, इसि Unādi aff.
वसुल: वसुल m. (-लः) A deity, a divinity.  E. वसु wealth, ला to have, aff. क ।
वसुषेण: वसुषेण m. (-णः) A name of KARṆA, the illegitimate brother of the PĀṆḌU princes.  E. वसु wealth, सेना an army; surrounded by hosts of beggars for his wealth, of which he was liberal.
वसुस्थली: वसुस्थली f. (-ली) The city of KUVERA.  E. वसु wealth, स्थल place or site, aff. ङीष् ।
वसुहट्ट: वसुहट्ट m. (-ट्टः) The Vaka-puspa, (Sesbana grandiflora;) also वसुहट्टक ।
वसूक: वसूक n. (-कं) 	 1. Sambhar-salt. 	 2. The Sesbana grandiflora. E. See वसुक the उ of वसुक is here optionally long.
वसूरा: वसूरा f. (-रा) A whore, a harlot.
वस्क्: वस्क् r. 1st cl. (वस्कते) To go, to move.
वस्क: वस्क m. (-स्कः) 	 1. Application, perseverance. 	 2. Going, motion.  E. वस्क् to go, aff. अच् ।
वस्कय: वस्कय m. (-यः) A calf of one year, a yearling.  E. वस्क् to go, अयन् aff.; also वष्कय &c.
वस्कयणी: वस्कयणी f. (-णी) A cow bearing many calves.  E. वस्कय a calf, णी to have, affs. ड and ङीप्; also वष्कयणी, &c.
वस्त्: वस्त् r. 10th cl. (वस्तयति-ते) 	 1. To hurt or kill. 	 2. To go or move. 	 3. To ask, to beg, to solicit.
वस्त: वस्त m. (-स्तः) A goat. 	 n. (-स्तं) A house.  E. वस्त् to kill, aff. घञ् ।
वस्तमोदा: वस्तमोदा f. (-दा) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen:) see अजमोदा ।
वस्तव्य: वस्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be dwelt in, or inhabited, resided, remained at, &c.  E. वस् to dwell, तव्य aff.
वस्तान्त्री: वस्तान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) 	 1. Benzoin or storax. 	 2. A plant, commonly Ajā-shringī. E. वस्त a goat, and अन्त्र entrail.
वस्ति: वस्ति mf. (-स्तिः) 	 1. The lower belly, hypogastric or pubic region. 	 2. The bladder. 	 3. A clyster-syringe, or bag made of bladder or gut, with a wooden or metallic nozzle. 	 4. Abiding, dwelling, staying. plu. only (-स्तयः) The ends of a cloth.  E. वस् to wear, Unādi aff. ति; or वस् to abide, क्तिन् aff.; or वस्ते आवृणोति मूत्रम् वस्-तिच् ।
वस्तिकर्माढ्य: वस्तिकर्म्माढ्य m. (-ढ्यः) The soap-berry, (Sapindus detergens.)  E. वस्ति the ends of cloth, कर्म्म business, and आढ्य rich in; used in washing.
वस्तिकर्म्माढ्य: वस्तिकर्म्माढ्य m. (-ढ्यः) The soap-berry, (Sapindus detergens.)  E. वस्ति the ends of cloth, कर्म्म business, and आढ्य rich in; used in washing.
वस्तिमल: वस्तिमल n. (-लं) Urine, piss.  E. वस्ति the belly, and मल excretion.
वस्तिशिरस्: वस्तिशिरस् n. (-रः) 	 1. The neck of the bladder. 	 2. The pipe of the clys-ter-bag.  E. वस्ति and शिरस् head.
वस्तिशोधन: वस्तिशोधन n. (-नं) A diuretic.  E. वस्ति and शोधन cleansing.
वस्तु: वस्तु n. (-स्तु) 	 1. Thing, matter, substance. 	 2. Natural disposition, es-sential property, nature, essence. 	 3. The pith or substance of any thing. 	 4. The main plot or subject of a poem or play. 	 5. The rear. E. वस् to abide, Unādi aff. तुन् ।
वस्तुक: वस्तुक n. (-कं) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)  E. वस् to abide, (in the ground,) उकञ् aff., and तुट् augment; also वास्तुक, वास्तूक, &c.
वस्तुतस्: वस्तुतस् Ind. In fact, really, essentially, substantially.  E. वस्तु, तसि aff.
वस्तुमात्र: वस्तुमात्र n. (-त्रं) Outline of any subject, skeleton of a discourse.  E. वस्तु and मात्र only.
वस्तुहानि: वस्तुहानि f. (-निः) Loss of substance or property.  E. वस्तु and हानि abandonment.
वस्तूत्थापन: वस्तूत्थापन n. (-नं) Producing any change or incident in a play by magic. E. वस्तु and उत्थापन raising.
वस्त्वन्तर: वस्त्वन्तर n. (-रं) Another thing or subject.  E. वस्तु and अन्तर other.
वस्त्वभाव: वस्त्वभाव m. (-वः) 	 1. Insubstantial existence. 	 2. Loss or destruction of property.  E. वस्तु and अभाव non-existence.
वस्त्य: वस्त्य n. (-स्त्यं) A house.  E. वस् to abide, ति aff. and यत् added; this word has many etymologies; it is also read पस्त्य ।
वस्त्र: वस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 	 1. Cloth, clothes, raiment. 	 2. Covering, a cover.  E. वस् to wear, (as clothes,) ष्ट्रन् Unādi aff.
वस्त्रकुट्टिम: वस्त्रकुट्टिम n. (-मं) 	 1. A tent. 	 2. An umbrella. वस्त्र cloth, and कुट्टिम a hut.
वस्त्रगृह: वस्त्रगृह n. (-हं) A tent.  E. वस्त्र cloth, and गृह a house.
वस्त्रग्रन्थि: वस्त्रग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) The string or twist by which the lower garments are fastened above the hips.  E. वस्त्र cloth, and ग्रन्थि knot.
वस्त्रनिर्णेजक: वस्त्रनिर्णेजक m. (-कः) A washerman.  E. वस्त्र, निर्णेजक who washes.
वस्त्रपुत्त्रिका: वस्त्रपुत्त्रिका f. (-का) A doll, a puppet.  E. वस्त्र cloth, पुत्त्री infant, (as it were,) कन् aff.
वस्त्रभेदक: वस्त्रभेदक m. (-कः) A tailor.  E. वस्त्र cloth, clothes, भेदक who pierces or cuts.
वस्त्रभेदिन्: वस्त्रभेदिन् m. (-दी) A tailor.  E. वस्त्र cloth, add भेदिन् who pierces.
वस्त्रयुग्म: वस्त्रयुग्म n. (-ग्मं) A pair of clothes.  E. वस्त्र and युग्म a pair.
वस्त्रयोनि: वस्त्रयोनि f. (-निः) The basis or material of cloth, as cotton, silk, wool, &c.  E. वस्त्र cloth, and योनि place of production.
वस्त्राञ्चल: वस्त्राञ्चल n. (-लं) The end or hem of a garment.  E. वस्त्र, अञ्चल the same.
वस्त्रापहारक: वस्त्रापहारक m. (-कः) A stealer of clothes.  E. वस्त्र and अपहारक who carries off; also वस्त्रापहारिन् ।
वस्न: वस्न m. (-स्नः) Price. 	 n. (-स्नं) 	 1. Wages, hire. 	 2. Cloth, clothes. 	 3. Wealth. 	 4. Death. 	 5. Abiding, dwelling. 	 6. Thing, substance. 7. Skin. 	 9. Health.  E. वस् to dwell, Unādi aff. मन् ।
वस्नन: वस्नन n. (-नं) An ornament for a woman's loins, a zone, a girdle.
वस्नसा: वस्नसा f. (-सा) A tendon, a nerve, a fibre, described as a hollow tube resembling a string, attached to the bones, and supposed to be for the passage of the vital air.  E. वस्न skin, सो to destroy, aff. क ।
वस्निक: वस्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Hireling, mercenary. 	 2. Purchasable. 	 3. Re-lating to hire, wages, price, &c.  E. वस्न hire, &c., and ठन् aff.
वस्वौकसारा: वस्वौकसारा f. (-रा) 	 1. The capital of INDRA. 	 2. ALAKĀ, the residence of KUVERA. 	 3. A lake attached to ALAKĀ or AMARĀVATĪ, and belonging to either deity.  E. वसु the Vasus, ओकस् a residence, रा to contain, with आङ् prefixed, and क and टाप् affs., the favourite haunts of these demi-gods.
वह्: वह् r. 1st cl. (वहति) To bear, to carry, to convey or transport. (वहते) To flow, (as a stream.) Desid. (विवक्षति-ते) [This is one of those roots which take two accusatives.] 1. To transport. 	 2. To move on. 	 3. To flow. 4. To blow. 	 5. To marry. 	 6. To be responsible for. 	 7. To waft, to propel. 	 8. To bear the load of. 	 9. To possess. With अति, To pass, (as time.) With अप, 1. To carry off. 	 2. To deduct. With आ, 1. To cause to bring about. 	 2. To flow. 	 3. To have, to possess. With उद्, 1. To raise, to elevate, to bear up. 	 2. To marry. 	 3. To bear the burden of. 	 4. To wear. 	 5. To have. With उप, To commence. With नि, To support. With निस्, To be finished. With परि, To overflow. With प्र, 1. To draw, to carry. 	 2. To blow. 	 3. To flow. 4. To waft, (as scent.) 	 5. To bear the burden of. With वि, To marry. With सम, 1. To bear along. 	 2. To take a wife. 	 3. To press together. 	 4. To display. Caus. (वाहयति-ते) 	 1. To cause to draw or carry. 	 2. To traverse, to go over. With अति, To lead, (as life.) With आ, To invoke. With निस्, To perform, to manage, to com-plete. With सम्, To press together, to rub. (इ) वहि r. 10th cl. (वंहयति-ते) To shine. r. 1st cl. (वंहते) To grow or increase; this last root is more properly बहि q. v.
वह: वह m. (-हः) 	 1. Bearing, conveying. 	 2. Any vehicle or means of con-veyance, as a horse, a car, &c. 	 3. The shoulder of an ox. 	 4. Air, wind. 	 5. A road, a way. 	 6. Any male river. 	 7. A measure of four Droṇas. 	 f. (-हा) A river in general.  E. वह् to bear, aff. घ ।
वहंलिह: वहंलिह m. (-हः) An ox.  E. वह the shoulder, लिह् to lick, खश् aff.
वहत्: वहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 	 1. Bearing, conveying. 	 2. Assuming, taking. 3. Wearing. 	 4. Having, possessing.  E. वह् to bear, शतृ aff.
वहत: वहत m. (-तः) 	 1. An ox. 	 2. A traveller.  E. वह to bear, Unādi aff. अतच् ।
वहति: वहति m. (-तिः) 	 1. An ox. 	 2. A friend, a counsellor. 	 3. Air, wind. 	 f. (-ती) A river.  E. वह् to bear, अति Unādi aff.
वहतु: वहतु m. (-तुः) 	 1. An ox. 	 2. A traveller.  E. वह् to bear, Unādi aff. अतु ।
वहन: वहन n. (-नं) 	 1. Bearing, conveying. 	 2. Flowing, (as a stream.) 	 3. Any vehicle. 	 4. A raft, a float.  E. वह् to bear, ल्युट् aff.
वहनीय: वहनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be carried or borne.  E. वह् to bear, अनीयर् aff.
वहन्त: वहन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. Air, wind. 	 2. An infant.  E. वह् to bear, Unādi aff. झच् ।
वहमान: वहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Bearing, conveying. 	 2. Having, possessing. 3. Flowing.  E. वह् to bear, शानच् aff.
वहल: वहल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Hard, firm, compact. 	 n. (-लं) A raft, a float.  E. वह् to bear, aff. अलच् ।
वहलचक्षुस्: वहलचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) A climbing and milky plant, (Asclepias geminata.)
वहिःकुटीचर: वहिःकुटीचर m. (-रः) A crab.  E. वहिस् externally, कुटी crookedly, चर what goes.
वहिःस्थ: वहिःस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) External, outer.  E. वहिर् and स्था to stay, ड aff.; also वहिःस्थित, वहिःस्थायिन्, &c.
वहित: वहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Known, celebrated. 	 2. Borne, conveyed. 	 3. Obtained.  E. वह् to bear, aff. क्त ।
वहित्र: वहित्र n. (-त्रं) A raft, a float, a boat, a vessel.  E. वह् to bear, Unādi aff. इत्र; also with कन् added, वहित्रक n. (-कं) ।
वहिन्: वहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Bearing, conveying. 	 f. (-नी) A boat, a vessel. E. वस् to bear, णिनि aff.
वहिरङ्ग: वहिरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. An outer or external part, limb, member, property, &c. 	 2. A stranger, an indifferent person.  E. वहिर् and अङ्ग a limb.
वहिरिन्द्रिय: वहिरिन्द्रिय n. (-यं) An organ of sense or perception, an organ of action, as the eye, hand, &c.  E. वहिर् and इन्द्रिय organ of sense.
वहिर्गत: वहिर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone out or forth.  E. वहिर् and गत gone.
वहिर्गमन: वहिर्गमन n. (-नं) Going forth or out.  E. वहिर् and गमन going.
वहिर्देश: वहिर्देश m. (-शः) 	 1. A foreign country. 	 2. A place without a town or village.  E. वहिर् and देश place.
वहिर्द्वार: वहिर्द्वार n. (-रं) An outer gate.  E. वहिर् for वहिस् outer, and द्वार door.
वहिर्द्वारप्रकोष्ठक: वहिर्द्वारप्रकोष्ठक n. (-कं) A portico, a covered terrace before the door of a house.  E. वहिर्द्वार an outer door, प्रकोष्ठ an elbow, aff. कन् ।
वहिर्भव: वहिर्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced externally.  E. वहिस् outwardly, भव born.
वहिर्भूत: वहिर्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being out or without, excluded.  E. वहिस्, भूत being.
वहिर्लम्ब: वहिर्लम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) Obtuse angular.  E. वहिस् and लम्ब a perpendicular.
वहिश्चर: वहिश्चर m. (-रः) A crab.  E. वहिस् externally, and चर what goes.
वहिष्करण: वहिष्करण n. (-णं) Expelling, excluding.  E. वहिस् out, and करण making.
वहिष्कृत: वहिष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, excluded.  E. वहिस् and कृत made.
वहिस्: वहिस् Ind. Out, outwards, external.  E. वह् to bear, aff. इसुन्.
वहीरु: वहीरु m. (-रुः) A tendon, a nerve, a muscle.
वह्नि: वह्नि m. (-ह्निः) 	 1. Fire, or its deity Agni. 	 2. Lead-wort, (Plumbago zey-lanica.) 	 3. Marking-nut plant. 	 4. Appetite, digestion, the meta-phorical fire of the stomach.  E. वह to bear, (the oblations pre-sented to the gods,) and नि Unādi aff.
वह्निकर: वह्निकर mfn. (-रः-रा or री-रं) 	 1. Making fire, lighting. 	 2. Stomachic, giving appetite. 	 f. (-री) A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.)  E. वह्नि fire, (appetite,) कृ to make, aff. अच् or ट, and टाप् or ङीप् aff.
वह्निगन्ध: वह्निगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Incense or resin  E. वह्नि fire, and गन्ध smell.
वह्निगर्भ: वह्निगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A bamboo. 	 f. (-र्भा) A sort of Mimosa, (M. Suma. Rox.) E. वह्नि fire, and गर्भ embryo; taking or producing fire by friction.
वह्निदीपक: वह्निदीपक m. (-कः) Safflower.  E. वह्नि fire, and दीपक what shines like or resembles.
वह्निनामन्: वह्निनामन् m. (-मा) 	 1. Marking-nut plant. 	 2. Lead-wort.  E. वह्नि fire, and नामन् appellation; the synonimes of fire being equally applicable to those plants.
वह्निभोग्य: वह्निभोग्य n. (-ग्यं) Ghee or clarified butter.  E. वह्नि fire, भोग्य to be consumed or enjoyed.
वह्निमन्थ: वह्निमन्थ m. (-न्थः) A tree, the wood of which is used to procure fire by attrition, (Premna spinosa.)  E. वह्नि fire, and मन्थ churning.
वह्निमारक: वह्निमारक n. (-कं) Water.  E. वह्नि fire, and मारक destroyer.
वह्निमित्र: वह्निमित्र m. (-त्रः) Air, wind.  E. वह्नि fire, and मित्र the friend.
वह्निरेतस्: वह्निरेतस् m. (-ताः) ŚIVA.  E. वह्नि fire, रेतस् semen.
वह्निलोह: वह्निलोह n. (-हं) Copper.  E. वह्नि and लोह iron; also with कन् added वह्निलोहक ।
वह्निवधू: वह्निवधू f. (-धूः) The wife of AGNI or fire.  E. वह्नि and वधू the wife.
वह्निवर्ण: वह्निवर्ण n. (-र्णं) The red water-lily.  E. वह्नि fire, and वर्ण colour.
वह्निवल्लभ: वह्निवल्लभ m. (-भः) Resin.  E. वह्नि fire, and वल्लभ friend.
वह्निवीज: वह्निवीज n. (-जं) 	 1. Gold. 	 2. The common lime. 	 3. A particle, to be repeated as the peculiar prayer of fire in the Tantra system: the syllable “रं”.  E. वह्नि fire, वीज seed.
वह्निशिख: वह्निशिख n. (-खं) 	 1. Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) 	 2. Saffron. 	 f. (-खा) A potherb, (Echites dichotoma.)  E. वह्नि fire, and शिखा crest; also अग्निशिखा ।
वह्निशिखर: वह्निशिखर m. (-रः) A flower, coxcomb, (Celosia cristata.)  E. वह्नि fire, and शिखर a crest.
वह्य: वह्य n. (-ह्यं) 	 1. A vehicle, a conveyance of any sort. 	 2. A cart. 	 f. (-ह्या) The wife of a Muni or saint.  E. वह् to bear, aff. यत् ।
वा: वा r. 2nd cl. (वाति) 	 1. To go or move. 	 2. To blow, (as the wind.) With निर् prefixed, 1. To blow out, to extinguish. 	 2. To cool. 	 3. To hurt, to injure. Caus. (वापयति-ते) To cause to blow; also (वाजयति-ते) To shake.

वा Ind. A particle of,:--1. Comparison, (as, like, so;) 	 2. Alternative or-option, (or, either, else, sometimes.) 	 3. Doubt and consideration, (or, whether.) 	 4. Exception, (only, no other;) 	 5. Asseveration or confirmation, (indeed, even, very.) 	 6. A conjunction, (and, as well, also.) 	 7. An expletive.  E. वा to go, aff. क्विप्, the व is some-times changed to ब, and the word is read बा ।

वा(बा)ह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 	 1. To be carried or borne. 	 2. Outer, external. n. (-ह्यं) A carriage, a vehicle. 	 m. (-ह्यः) A beast of burthen, an ox, a horse, &c.  E. वह् to bear, aff. ण्यत्, or वहिर् external, यञ् aff.
वांश: वांश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Bamboo, of or belonging to, made from a bamboo, &c. 	 f. (-शी) The manna of the bamboo.  E. वंश a bamboo, अण् aff.
वांशिक: वांशिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A flute-player, a piper, a fifer. 	 2. A bamboo-cutter, &c.  E. वश a pipe, aff. ठक् or ठन् ।
वाःकिटि: वाःकिटि m. (-टिः) A porpoise.  E. वार् water, and किटि a hog.
वाःपुष्प: वाःपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Cloves.  E. वार् water, and पुष्प flower.
वाःसदन: वाःसदन n. (-नं) A large water-jar.  E. वार् water, सदन abode.
वाक: वाक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to a crane. 	 n. (-कं) A flight of cranes.  E. वक, and अण्, अञ् or घञ् aff.
वाकुची: वाकुची f. (-ची) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)  E. वा wind, and कुच् to contract, क aff., form irr.
वाक्वलह: वाक्वलह n. (-हं) Quarrel, dispute.  E. वाच् and कलह disturbance.
वाक्कीर: वाक्कीर m. (-रः) A wife's brother.  E. वाच् a speech, a phrase, and कीर parrot: having giving rise to a proverb; as a cock parrot is, so is the hen; i. e. of the same breed and disposition.
वाक्चपल: वाक्चपल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frivolous, inconsistent, (in speech.)  E. वाक्, चपल changeable.
वाक्चापल्य: वाक्चापल्य n. (-ल्यं) Gossiping, chattering idle or improper talk.  E. वाक् speech, चापल्य unsteadiness.
वाक्छल: वाक्छल n. (-लं) Prevarication, equivocation.  E. वाक् speech, छल disguise, fraud.
वाक्छलान्वित: वाक्छलान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Equivocating, evasive.  E. वाक्छल, and अन्वित possessed of.
वाक्पटु: वाक्पटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु) Eloquent, able in speech.  E. वाक्, and पटु skilful.
वाक्पटुता: वाक्पटुता f. (-ता) Eloquence.  E. तल् added to the last; with त्व, वाक्पटुत्वं ।
वाक्पति: वाक्पति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Eloquent. 	 m. (-तिः) A name of VRIHASPATĪ. E. वाक् speech, and पति master.
वाकपथ: वाकपथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Suitable or seasonable for discourse.  E. वाक्, and पथ path.
वाक्पारुष्य: वाक्पारुष्य n. (-ष्यं) Abuse, scurrility, defamation, wordy violence or assault.  E. वाक् speech, पारुष्य violence.
वाक्य: वाक्य n. (-क्यं) 	 1. A sentence. 	 2. A rule or aphorism. 	 3. Speech. 	 4. (In astronomy,) The solar process for all astronomical computations. E. वच् to speak, ण्यत् aff.
वाक्यखण्डन: वाक्यखण्डन n. (-नं) Refuting or criticising an assertion.  E. वाक्य and खण्डन breaking.
वाक्यप्रयोग: वाक्यप्रयोग m. (-गः) Employment or application of speech or language. E. वाक्य, प्रयोग application.
वाक्यविन्यास: वाक्यविन्यास m. (-सः) Syntax, order, or arrangement of a sentence. E. वाक्य, विन्यास disposition.
वाक्यविशारद: वाक्यविशारद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Eloquent.  E. वाक्य and विशारद skilful.
वाक्यशेष: वाक्यशेष m. (-षः) 	 1. The remainder of a speech. 	 2. An ellipsis.
वाक्यस्थ: वाक्यस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Contained in a sentence. 	 2. Obedient, atten-tive.  E. वाक्य and स्थ what stays; also वाक्यस्थित &c.
वाक्ष्: वाक्ष्(इ)वाक्षि r. 10th cl. (वाङ्क्षति) To desire, to wish.
वागपहारक: वागपहारक m. (-कः) 	 1. A stealer of books. 	 2. A reader of prohibited works or passages.  E. वाक् speech, अपहारक seizer, stealer.
वागर: वागर m. (-रः) 	 1. A sage, a holy man, one desirous of final emancipa-tion. 	 2. A scholar, a Paṇḍit, a learned Brāhman. 	 3. A hero, a brave man one who is intrepid or fearless. 	 4. Certainty, ascer-tainment. 	 5. A whet-stone. 	 6. An obstacle, an impediment, or cause of obstruction. 	 7. Submarine fire. 	 8. A wolf.  E. वाक् speech, ऋ to go, aff. अप् ।
वागसि: वागसि f. (-सिः) Sharp or piercing speech.  E. वाच्, असि a sword, piercing men's thoughts.
वागारु: वागारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Breaking promise or faith, disappointing, a disappointer or deceiver.  E. वाक् speech, ऋ to go, उण् aff.
वागीश: वागीश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Eloquent, well spoken. 	 m. (-शः) 	 1. An author, an orator, a poet, &c. 	 2. BRAHMĀ.  E. वाक् speech, ईश master.
वागीश्वर: वागीश्वर m. (-रः) 	 1. An orator, a learned man. 	 2. A Bauddha deified sage; also MANJUGHOSHA. 	 3. BRAHMĀ. 	 f. (-री) SARASWATĪ. E. वाक् speech, ईश्वर lord.
वागुजी: वागुजी f. (-जी) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)  E. वाच् speech, गुज् to sound inarticulately, aff. क, form irr.
वागुण: वागुण m. (-णः) An acid fruit, (Averrhoa carambola.)
वागुरा: वागुरा f. (-रा) A net, a snare, a noose.  E. वा to hurt, उरच् Unādi aff., गन् augment.
वागुरावृत्ति: वागुरावृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Livelihood obtained by catching wild animals. E. वागुरा a snare, वृत्ति practice.
वागुरिक: वागुरिक m. (-कः) A hunter, a deer-catcher.  E. वागुरा a net, aff. ठक्.
वागृषभ: वागृषभ m. (-भः) A learned or eloquent man.  E. वाच्, and ऋषभ best.
वागृषभत्व: वागृषभत्व n. (-त्वं) Eloquence, learning, erudition.  E. वागृषभ, and त्व aff.
वाग्गुद: वाग्गुद m. (-दः) A sort of bird.  E. वाक् speech, गुद् to sport, aff. क.
वाग्गुलि: वाग्गुलि m. (-लिः) The betel-bearer, an officer or servant whose business it is to have the box of Pān ready for his prince or master.  E. वाक् speech, (command,) गुर् to obey, कि aff., and र changed to ल; or गृ to swallow, deriv. irr.
वाग्गुलिक: वाग्गुलिक m. (-कः) A betel-bearer.  E. ठक् pleonasm added to the preceding.
वाग्डम्बर: वाग्डम्बर m. (-रः) Graceful or eloquent language.
वाग्दण्ड: वाग्दण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. Reproof, reprimand. 	 2. Restraint or control of speech.  E. वाक् and दण्ड punishment.
वाग्दत्त: वाग्दत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Promised. 	 f. (-त्ता) A virgin betrothed.  E. वाच्, दत्त given.

वाग्देवी: वाग्देवी f. (-वी) A name of SARASWATĪ.  E. वाक् speech, and देवी goddess, the goddess of eloquence.
वाग्दोष: वाग्दोष m. (-षः) 	 1. Speaking ill, defamation, abuse. 	 2. Ungrammatical speech. 	 3. Uttering a disagreeable sound.  E. वाक् and दोष fault.
वाग्मात्र: वाग्मात्र n. (-त्रं) Mere speech, words alone.  E. वाच् and मात्र only.

वाग्मिन्: वाग्मिन् mfn. (-ग्मी-ग्मिनी-ग्मि) 	 1. Loquacious, talkative, speaking much. 2. Speaking well, eloquent. 	 m. (-ग्मी) A name of VRIHASPATĪ. E. वाच् speech, ग्मिनि aff.; hence also वागिमन् ।

वाग्विनिःसृत: वाग्विनिःसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Emitted or put forth by speech.  E. वाच् and विनिःसृत issued.
वाग्विलास: वाग्विलास m. (-सः) Graceful or elegant speech.  E. वाक् and विलास sport.
वाग्व्यापार: वाग्व्यापार m. (-रः) 	 1. Manner, style or habit of speaking. 	 2. Customary phraseology.  E. वाक् and व्यापार usual practice.
वाङ्क: वाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The ocean, the sea.  E. वङ्क a bend or creek, aff. अण् ।

वाङ्मुख: वाङ्मुख m. (-खः) The opening of a speech, an exordium.  E. वाच् speech, मुख beginning.
वाच्: वाच् f. (-वाक्) 	 1. Speech. 	 2. Speaking. 	 3. SARASWATĪ, the goddess of speech. 	 4. A phrase, a proverb or adage. 	 5. An assertion, an assurance.  E. वच् speak, aff. क्विप, and the vowel made long.
वाच: वाच m. (-चः) 	 1. A plant: see मदन । 2. A kind of fish. “वाचा ।”
वाचयम: वाचयम m. (-मः) A holy sage, practising rigid taciturnity, devoid of passions, and unmoved by pain or pleasure.  E. वाच् speech, यम् to restrain, aff. खच् ।
वाचक: वाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Declaratory, explaining, speaking. 	 2. Verbal, expressed by words. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A word, a significant sound. 	 2. A speaker. 	 3. A reader. 	 4. A messenger.  E. वच् to speak, aff. ण्वुल् ।
वाचकता: वाचकता f. (-ता) Expressiveness, significance.  E. वाचक and तल् aff.; also with त्व, वाचकत्वं ।
वाचकपद: वाचकपद n. (-दं) A clear and explicit term.  E. वाचक and पद a word.
वाचन: वाचन n. (-नं) 	 1. Reading, reciting. 	 2. Proclamation, declaration.
वाचनीक: वाचनीक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Verbal. 	 2. Textual.  E. वचन and ठक् aff.
वाचसाम्पति: वाचसाम्पति f. (-तिः) VRIHASPATĪ, regent of the planet JUPITER, and preceptor of the gods.  E. वाच् speech, in the second case plural and पति master.
वाचस्पति: वाचस्पति m. (-तिः) 	 1. VRIHASPATĪ: see the last. 	 2. A title of the great scholar Professor TĀRĀ-NĀTHA TARKA-BĀCHASPATĪ, son of the illustrious Pandit KĀLI-DĀSA SĀRBABHOUMA and grandson of the Venerable Pandit RĀM-RĀM TARKASIDDHĀNTA, the commentator of the six different schools of Hindu philosophy: (Vide Mr. ADAM'S report on the researches of the Pandits of Bengal.) He was born at KĀLNĀ, situated on the bank of the river BHĀGIRATHĪ, in the District of BURDWĀN in the year 1806 A. D. and died at the sacred city of BENARES in 1885, at the ripe age of eighty, where he retired for abstract meditation and contemplation of the Supreme Spirit. He is the commentator “of SĀNKHYA-TATWA-KOUMUDĪ,” of BĀCHASPATĪ MISHRA, “SIDDHĀNTA-KOUMUDĪ,” the most authoritative grammar of PĀNINĪ methodised by BHATTOJI-DIKSHITA, and several Sanskrit dramas; he is also the author of “SHABDĀRTHARATNA”, a useful work on the philosophy of grammar, “SIDDHĀNTABINDUSĀRA,” &c.; he is also the compiler of “ĀSHUBODH,” the well known Sanskrit grammar, “DHĀTURUPA,” the easy treatise on the paradigm of Sanskrit conjugations, both meant for beginners, “VĀCHASPATYA,” the first voluminous Sanskrit dictionary with derivations in al-phabetical order and “SHABDASTOMA-MAHĀNIDHĪ”, the most useful handy Sanskrit dictionary, and other works in almost all the bran-ches of Sanskrit language too numerous to mention, all of which he wrote single-handed.  E. वाच् speech, in the sixth case, पति master.
वाचस्पत्य: वाचस्पत्य n. (-त्यं) 	 1. The great encyclopædic Sanskrit lexicon by Prof. TĀRĀNĀTHA TARKAVĀCHASPATĪ, the most profoundest gram-marian and philosopher of the nineteenth century: see the last. 	 2. Eloquence, an eloquent speech, a harangue.
वाचा: वाचा f. (-चा) 	 1. Speech. 	 2. A text, an aphorism. 	 3. The tongue. 	 4. An oath.  E. वाच् as above, टाप् added.
वाचाट: वाचाट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Talkative, talking much and idly or blamably. E. वाच् speech and आटच् aff. भत्वात् न कः ।
वाचाल: वाचाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Talkative, chattering, gabbling, talking much and idly or blamably.  E. वाच् speech, and आलच् aff.
वाचिक: वाचिक mfn. (-कः-का or की-कं) Verbal. 	 n. (-कं) News, tidings, intelli-gence.  E. वाच् speech, aff. ठक् ।
वाचिकपत्रक: वाचिकपत्रक n. (-कं) 	 1. A letter, a despatch. 	 2. A newspaper, a gazette.  E. वाचिक news, पत्र a leaf.
वाचिकहारक: वाचिकहारक n. (-कः) 	 1. A letter, an epistle. 	 2. A messenger, a courier. E. वाचिक news, हृ to convey, aff. ण्वुल् ।
वाचोयुक्ति: वाचोयुक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Speaking much or well.  E. वाच speech, in the sixth case, and युक्ति joining, fitness.
वाचोयुक्तिपटु: वाचोयुक्तिपटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः or -ट्वी-टु) Eloquent, speaking much or well. E. वाचोयुक्ति as above, and पटु skilful.
वाच्छ्: वाच्छ्(इ)वाच्छि r. 1st cl. (-वाञ्छति) To wish or desire.
वाच्य: वाच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 	 1. Vile, bad. 	 2. Vile, contemptible, low, out-cast. 	 3. Fit or proper to be spoken or said. 	 4. Attributive adjec-tive, to be predicated of any thing. 	 5. Declinable as an adjective, taking the three genders. 	 6. Expressed, (as the meaning of a word.) 	 n. (-च्यं) Blame, reviling. 	 2. A predicate, that which may be said of anything. 	 3. (In grammar.) The voice or mode of a verb; as, कर्त्तृवाच्यं the active voice, कर्म्मणिवाच्यं the passive voice. 	 4. The expressed or conventional meaning of word, (opposed to लक्ष्य and व्यङ्ग्य ।)  E. वच् to speak, aff. ण्यत् ।

वाच्यता: वाच्यता f. (-ता) 	 1. Infamy, ill repute. 	 2. Blame, reproach. 	 3. The qua-lity of that which may be said of any thing. 	 4. Conjugation. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, वाच्यत्वं ।
वाज: वाज mn. (-जः-जं) A wing. 	 m. (-जः) The feather of an arrow. 	 2. Speed. 3. Sound. 	 4. A Muni. 	 n. (-जं) 	 1. Ghee or clarified butter. 	 2. Water. 	 3. A Mantra or prayer which concludes a sacrifice. 	 4. Rice offered at a Śrāddha or obsequial ceremony. 	 5. Rice in general. 	 6. The acidulous mixture of ground meal and water left to ferment. वाजिगन्ध: वाजिगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The name of a plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)  E. वाजिन् a horse, and गन्ध smell; also वाजिगन्धक ।
वाजिता: वाजिता f. (-ता) 	 1. The condition of having wings. 	 2. The nature of a horse.  E. वाजिन् a horse, &c., तल् aff.; also with त्व, वाजित्वं ।
वाजिदन्त: वाजिदन्त m. (-न्तः) A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda.)  E. वाजि a horse, दन्त a tooth, to which the flower is compared; with कन् added वाजिदन्तक ।
वाजिन्: वाजिन् m. (-जी) 	 1. A horse. 	 2. An arrow. 	 3. A bird. 	 4. A plant (Justicia adhenatoda.) 	 f. (-जिनी) A mare.  E. वाज speed or a feather, &c., and इनि poss. aff.

वाञ्छित: वाञ्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. 	 n. (-तं) Wish.  E. वाच्छि to wish, क्त aff.

वाडव्य: वाडव्य n. (-व्यं) A multitude of Brāhmans.

वाढविक्रम: वाढविक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Powerful, very strong, mighty.  E. वाढ, विक्रम prowess.
