वाणी: वाणी f. (-णी) 	 1. SARASWATĪ, the goddess of speech. 	 2. Speech, sound. 3. Voice, (as दैववाणी). 	 4. Eloquence. 	 5. Praise. 	 6. A literary pro-duction.  E. वण् to sound, aff. इञ् and ङीप् or ङीष् added.
वात: वात r. 10th cl. (वातयति-ते) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To serve. 	 3. To be happy. 	 4. To give pleasure in travelling. 	 5. To blow gently, to fan or ventilate.

वात m. (-तः) 	 1. Air, wind. 	 2. Rheumatism, gout, inflammation of the joints. 	 3. Air, wind, as one of the three humours of the body. 	 4. The deity that presides over wind. 	 f. (-ता) Adj. 	 1. Blown. 	 2. Wished for, solicited.  E. वा to go, Unādi aff. तन्.
वात्: वात् mfn. (-वान्-वाती or वान्ती-वात्) Going, moving.  E. वा to go, शतृ aff.
वातक: वातक m. (-कः) 	 1. A paramour. 	 2. A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) E. वात wind, कृ to make, aff. ड ।
वातकिन्: वातकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Rheumatic, gouty.  E. वात inflammation of the joints, and इनि aff., कुक् augment.
वातकुण्डलिका: वातकुण्डलिका f. (-का) Scanty and painful flow of urine.
वातकुम्भ: वातकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) The part of an elephant's forehead below the frontal sinuses.  E. वात wind and कुम्भ a receptacle.
वातकेतु: वातकेतु m. (-तुः) Dust.  E. वात wind, and केतु a symbol.
वातकेलि: वातकेलि m. (-लिः) 	 1. Speaking in murmurs, especially amorous con-verse. 	 2. The marks of finger-nails on the lover's person.  E. वात wind, केलि playing.
वातगामिन्: वातगामिन् m. (-मी) A bird.  E. वात wind, and गामिन् who goes.
वातगुल्म: वातगुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 	 1. A gale, a high wind. 	 2. Acute gout or rheuma-tism. 	 3. Any disease arising from the morbid affection of the windy humour, such as, madness, the glandular enlargement of the mesenteric gland, in the abdomen, so as to be perceived ex-ternally, &c. according to our Hindu system of pathology.  E. वात wind, गुल्म a cluster, a quantity.
वातग्रस्त: वातग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. Epileptic. 	 2. Rheumatic.  E. वात and ग्रस्त seized.
वातघ्न: वातघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing disorders from wind.  E. वात and घ्न who destroys.
वातज: वातज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by or arising from wind.  E. वात, ज born.
वातज्वर: वातज्वर m. (-रः) Fever arising from vitiated wind.  E. वात and ज्वर fever.
वाततूल: वाततूल n. (-लं) Cottony flocks or seeds floating in the air.  E. वात, तुला cotton.
वातथुडा: वातथुडा f. (-डा) 	 1. A gale, a high wind. 	 2. Acute gout or rheumatism. 3. A handsome woman. 	 4. A disease, a sort of small pox.  E. वात wind, हुड् to reap, aff. क, deriv. irr.
वातध्वज: वातध्वज m. (-जः) A cloud.  E. वात wind, and ध्वज banner.
वातपित्त: वातपित्त n. (-त्तं) Rheumatism attended with fever.  E. वात, पित्त bile.
वातपुत्त्र: वातपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 	 1. A name of BHĪMA. 	 2. The monkey HANUMĀNA. 	 3. A cheat, a swindler.  E. वात the wind, and पुत्त्र a son.
वातपोथ: वातपोथ m. (-थः) The Palāsha tree, (Butea frondosa.)  E. वात rheuma-tism, पुथ् to hurt, aff. अण्; also वातपोथक ।
वातप्रमी: वातप्रमी m. (-मीः) A swift antelope.  E. वात the wind, प्र before, मा to measure, to surpass or outgo, Unādi aff. ईप् ।
वातफुल्ल: वातफुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Inflated, puffed up with wind.  E. वात, फुल्ल blown.
वातफुल्लान्त्र: वातफुल्लान्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) Colic, flatulence, borborygmi.  E. वात wind, and फुल्ल swoln, अन्त्र the intestines.
वातमज: वातमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Going in or against the wind. 	 m. (-जः) A swift antelope.  E. वात wind, अज् to go, aff. खश् ।
वातमण्डली: वातमण्डली f. (-ली) A whirl-wind.  E. वात wind, मण्डल a region, aff. ङीप् ।
वातमृग: वातमृग m. (-गः) A swift antelope.  E. वात wind, and मृग a deer.
वातरहस्: वातरहस् mfn. (-हाः-हाः-हः) Swift, (as the wind.)  E. वात, रंहस् speed.
वातर: वातर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Windy, stormy. 	 2. Swift, (as the wind.)  E. वात and रा to get, क aff.
वातरक्त: वातरक्त n. (-क्तं) Acute gout or rheumatism.  E. वात wind, and रक्त blood; ascribed to a vitiated state of the blood and the aerial humour.
वातरक्तघ्न: वातरक्तघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A plant, commonly Kukurmurā.  E. वातरक्त gout, and घ्न destroying.
वातरक्तारि: वातरक्तारि m. (-रिः) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)  E. वातरक्त acute gout, अरि a foe.
वातरङ्ग: वातरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The holy fig-tree. वातस्येव सततं रङ्गश्चलनमस्य; also वादरङ्ग ।
वातरथ: वातरथ m. (-थः) A cloud.  E. वात the wind, and रथ a car.
वातरायण: वातरायण m. (-णः) 	 1. An arrow. 	 2. An arrow's flight, the discharge of an arrow, a bow shot. 	 3. A saw. 	 4. The peak of a mountain. 	 5. A mad man, one wild or intoxicated, either literally or figura-tively. 	 6. An idler, one who lives to no purpose. 	 7. The Saral, a sort of pine tree.  E. वातर and अयन going.
वातरूष: वातरूष m. (-षः) 	 1. A gale, a breeze. 	 2. The rainbow. 	 5. A bribe.  E. वात wind, रूष् to rage, aff. घञ् ।
वातरोग: वातरोग n. (-गं) Rheumatism, gout.  E. वात wind, and रोग disease.
वातरोगिन्: वातरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Rheumatic, afflicted with gout or rheu-matism, especially of the acute kind.  E. वातरोग acute rheumatism, &c., aff. इनि ।
वातर्द्धि: वातर्द्धि m. (-र्द्धिः) 	 1. A sort of cup or vessel made of wood, with an iron foot or stand. 	 2. A mace, a club or stick bound with iron. 3. Excess of wind.  E. वात wind, ऋद्धि increase.
वातल: वातल mfn. (-लः-ला or ली-लं) 	 1. Windy, stormy. 	 2. Flatulent. 	 m. (-लः) 1. A sort of pulse, (Cicer arietinum.) 	 2. Wind. 	 f. (-ला) A morbid state of the uterus.  E. वात wind, ला to get, aff. क ।
वातलमण्डली: वातलमण्डली f. (-ली) A whirl-wind.  E. वातल windy, मण्डल a region, aff. ङीप्; also वातमण्डली ।
वातवत्: वातवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Windy, gusty.  E. वात and मतुप् aff.
वातवलासक: वातवलासक m. (-कः) Nervous or low fever.
वातवस्ति: वातवस्ति f. (-स्तिः) Suppression of urine.  E. वात and वस्ति the bladder.
वातवृद्धि: वातवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Swelled testicle.  E. वात, वृद्धि increase.
वातवैरिन्: वातवैरिन् m. (-री) The castor-oil tree, &c.: see वातारि ।
वातव्याधि: वातव्याधि f. (-धिः) Any morbid affection attributed to disorder of the wind.  E. वात and व्याधि disease.
वातशीर्ष: वातशीर्ष n. (-र्षं) The lower belly.  E. वात wind, शीर्ष the head or source.
वातशूल: वातशूल n. (-लं) Colic with flatulence.  E. वात and शूल colic.
वातशोणित: वातशोणित n. (-तं) Acute gout or rheumatism.  E. वात wind, शोणित blood; ascribed to a vitiated state of these two.
वातसह: वातसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Gouty, rheumatic.  E. वात the disease, सह bear-ing, suffering.
वातसारथि: वातसारथि m. (-थिः) AGNI or fire.  E. वात wind, and सारथि charioteer.
वातस्कन्ध: वातस्कन्ध n. (-न्धं) The portion of the atmosphere where the wind blows. E. वात wind, स्कन्ध part.
वाताट: वाताट m. (-टः) 	 1. A horse of the sun. 	 2. An antelope.  E. वात the wind, and अट who goes.
वाताण्ड: वाताण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A disease of the testicles.
वातातिसार: वातातिसार m. (-रः) Dysentery produced by some disorder in the wind of the stomach.
वाताद: वाताद m. (-दः) The almond, (Prunus amygdalus. Syn. Amygdalus cummunis. Terminalia catappa.)  E. वात windy humour, अद् to des-troy, aff. घञ्; also वाताम । “वादाम् इति भाषा ।”
वातानुलोमन: वातानुलोमन n. (-नं) Forcing the wind in downwards, as in inflating the lungs.
वातापि: वातापि m. (-पिः) The name of an Asura devoured by AGASTYA.  E. वात wind, पा to drink, aff. कि, and आङ् prefixed.
वातापिद्विष्: वातापिद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) The Muni AGASTYA.  E. वातापि and द्विष् who hates; also similar names, as वातापिसूदन, वातापिहन्, &c.
वातामोदा: वातामोदा f. (-दा) Musk.  E. वात the wind, आमोदा a diffusive fragrance.
वाताय: वाताय n. (-यं) A leaf.  E. वात wind, अय् to go, aff. अच् ।
वातायन: वातायन n. (-नं) 	 1. A window, an eyelet or loop-hole. 	 2. A porch, a portico, a covered shed, a pavilion. 	 m. (-नः) A horse.  E. वात the wind, and अयन going.
वातायु: वातायु m. (-युः) An antelope, a deer.  E. वात wind, (like,) अय् to go, aff. उण् ।
वातारि: वातारि f. (-रिः) 	 1. The castor-oil tree. 	 2. A plant, (Asparagus racemo-sus.)  E. वात rheumatism, अरि hostile.
वाताली: वाताली f. (-ली) A whirl-wind, a gale.  E. वात wind, आली a line.
वाताश्व: वाताश्व m. (-श्वः) A swift horse, or one of a good breed.  E. वात the wind, and अश्व a horse.
वातासह: वातासह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Rheumatic, gouty.  E. वात rheumatism, आसह who bears or suffers.
वाताहत: वाताहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Stirred or shaken by the wind. 	 2. Affected by rheumatism.  E. वात and आहत struck.
वाताहति: वाताहति f. (-तिः) 	 1. The action of the wind. 	 2. The occurance of arthritic pains.  E. वात and आहति striking.
वाति: वाति m. (-तिः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. The moon. 	 3. Air, wind.  E. वा to go, Unādi aff. क्तिच् ।
वातिक: वातिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Windy, stormy. 	 2. Rheumatic. 	 3. Produced by or proceeding from wind, (disease, &c.) 	 m. (-कः) Fever or inflammation ascribed to a vitiated state of the aerial humour. E. वात wind, &c., ठक् aff.
वातिग: वातिग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Acquainted with or working in minerals or fossils, &c. 	 m. (-गः) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.)  E. वाति wind, ग who counts, from गण with ड aff.
वातिङ्गण: वातिङ्गण m. (-णः) The egg-plant.  E. वाति wind, गण् to count, aff. खच्, curing rheumatism, &c.
वातीय: वातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Windy, relating or belonging to wind, &c. 	 n. (-यं) Sour rice-gruel.  E. वात the wind, छ aff.; acidulated by air.
वातुल: वातुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Gouty, rheumatic. 	 2. Mad, crazy. 	 m. (-लः) A whirlwind, a gale.  E. वात wind, &c., and उलच् aff.; more com-monly वातूल ।
वातुलि: वातुलि f. (-लिः) A large bat, commonly the flying fox.  E. वात wind, उलि aff., form irr. “वादुड ।”
वातूल: वातूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Gouty, rheumatic. 	 2. Mad, insane, inebriate. m. (-लः) A whirlwind, a gale, a hurricane.  E. वात wind, ऊलच् aff.; also वातुल; form irr.
वातृ: वातृ m. (-ता) Air, wind.  E. वा to go, तृच् aff.
वात्या: वात्या f. (-त्या) A gale, a whirlwind, a hurricane.  E. वात wind, यत् implying quantity.
वात्सक: वात्सक n. (-कं) A herd of calves.  E. वत्स a calf, बुञ् aff. of number.
वात्सल्य: वात्सल्य n. (-ल्यं) Tenderness, affection, fondness.  E. वत्सल affectionate, ष्यञ् aff.
वात्सीपुत्त्र: वात्सीपुत्त्र m. (-त्तः) A barber.  E. वात्सी a girl born of a Sudra woman by a Brāhman, and पुत्त्र son.
वात्स्यायन: वात्स्यायन m. (-नः) The name of a Muni.  E. वात्स्य the father of the sage, and फक् aff. of descent.
वाद: वाद m. (-दः) 	 1. Demonstrated conclusion, reply, result. 	 2. Discourse, discussion, defined as the speech of one desirous to know the truth. 	 3. A plaint, an accusation. 	 4. Sound, sounding. 	 5. Rumour, report.  E. वद् to speak, aff. घञ् ।
वादकर: वादकर mfn. (-रः-रा or री-रं) Causing or making a dispute.  E. वाद, कर what makes; also वादकृत् &c.
वादन: वादन n. (-नं) Sound, sounding, (as musical instruments.)  E. वद् to sound, causal form, aff. ल्युट् ।
वादयत्: वादयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Sounding, playing, (as on a musical instru-ment.)  E. वद् to speak, causal v., शतृ aff.
वादयुद्ध: वादयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Controversy, dispute.  E. वाद, and युद्ध war.
वादर: वादर f. (-री) Made of cotton. 	 n. (-र) Cotton cloth.  E. वदर cotton, अण् aff.
वादरङ्ग: वादरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The religious fig-tree: see वातरङ्ग ।
वादरत: वादरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Adhering to or following a doctrine. 	 2. Addicted to controversy, disputations.  E. वाद, and रत fond of.
वादरायण: वादरायण m. (-णः) A name of VYĀSA, the compiler of the Vedas, and reputed author of the Purāṇas, &c.  E. वादर a place of pilgrimage अयन going, aff. अण्; also written with an initial ब, बादरायण ।
वादल: वादल n. (-लं) Liquorice, or the root of the Abrus precatorius, which is used for it.  E. वा for वात wind, दल् to disperse, aff. अच्; form irr.
वादवादिन्: वादवादिन् m. (-दी) A Jaina.  E. वाद result, truth, वादिन् who declares.
वादसाधन: वादसाधन n. (-नं) Argument, maintaining a controversy.  E. वाद and साधन instrument.
वादानुवाद: वादानुवाद m. (-दः) Attack and rejoinder, plaint and reply.  E. वाद, अनुवाद subsequent dispute.
वादान्य: वादान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Munificent, liberal, &c.  E. वदान्य, and अण् pleonasm added.
वादाल: वादाल m. (-लः) A sheat-fish.  E. वदाल the same, अण् pleonasm added.
वादि: वादि mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि) Wise, learned, skilful, sage.  E. वद् to speak, (wisely, &c.,) इन् Unādi aff.
वादित: वादित f. (-ता) Played, sounded. 	 2. Made to speak.
वादित्र: वादित्र n. (-त्रं) A musical instrument.  E. वद् to sound, Unādi aff. णित्रन् ।
वादिन्: वादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 	 1. Speaking, discoursing. 	 2. Asserting, de-claring. 	 m. (-दी) 	 1. A sage, an expounder of the law and the Shās-tras. 	 2. A plaintiff, an accuser. 	 3. Leading or key note, (in music.) 4. A disputant. 	 5. A speaker.  E. वद् to speak, णिनि aff.
वादिराज्: वादिराज् m. (-राट्) A Bauddha sage; also MANJUGHOSA.  E. वादि a sage, राज् chief.
वादिश: वादिश m. (-शः) A learned and virtuous man, a sage, a seer.  E. वादि truth or true conclusion, इशच् aff.
वाद्य: वाद्य n. (-द्यं) Any musical instrument.  E. वद् to sound, aff. ण्यत्; to be sounded or played.
वाद्यनिर्घोष: वाद्यनिर्घोष m. (-षः) The sound of musical instruments.  E. वाद्य a musical instrument, and निर्घोष sound.
वाद्यभाण्ड: वाद्यभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) 	 1. A multitude of musical instruments, a band. 	 2. Any musical instrument.  E. वाद्य a musical instrument, and भाण्ड assemblage or vessel.
वाध्: वाध्(ऋ)वाधृ r. 1st cl. (वाधते) To distress, to give pain: more correctly बाध् ।
वाध: वाध m. (-धः) 	 1. Pain. 	 2. Annoyance: see बाध ।
वाधुक्य: वाधुक्य n. (-क्यं) Marriage.  E. वधुका a wife, ष्यञ् aff.
वाधू: वाधू f. (-धूः) A vessel, a boat, a raft.  E. वह् to bear, aff. ऊण्; form irr.
वान: वान mfn. Subst. (-नः-ना-नं) Dry fruit. Adj. Dry, dried. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Living. 2. Going, moving. 	 3. A mat of straw. 	 4. A heavy sea, the rolling of water from wind, &c.; hence the high tide in the Indian rivers, commonly called the Bore. 	 5. A hole in the wall of a house. 	 6. A perfume, a fragrance. 	 7. Weaving. 	 8. Blowing. 	 mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Relating to a wood, a house, &c.: see वन. 	 n. (-नं) A number or multitude of woods.  E. वै to dry or wither, aff. क्त, form irr.: in other of its applications, वन् to sound, aff. घञ्; or वन a wood, water, a house, &c., and अण् referential aff.
वानप्रस्थ: वानप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) 	 1. The Brāhmana of the third order, who has passed through the conditions of student and householder, and has left his house and family for lonely meditation in woods and wilds; the hermit, the anchoret. 	 2. A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) 	 3. The Palāsha-tree, (Butea frondosa.)  E. वन a wood, अण् aff., वान a soli-tude in the woods, &c., प्रस्थ who goes forth to, from स्था to stay, with प्र prefix, and क aff.
वानर: वानर mf. (-रः-री) An ape, a monkey. 	 f. (-री) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)  E. वान what relates to a wood, रा to get, aff. क, a Sylvan; or वा implying resemblance, and नर a man; or वन a wood, रस् to play, aff. ड, वनर, and अण् pleonasm added.
वानरप्रिय: वानरप्रिय m. (-यः) A tree, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.)  E. वानर a monkey, प्रिय fond of.
वानराघात: वानराघात m. (-तः) A tree, commonly Lodh, (Symplocos racemosa.) E. वानर a monkey, आघात struck, injured.
वानरेन्द्र: वानरेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 	 1. The monkey-chief SUGRĪVA. 	 2. HANUMĀNA.  E. वानर, इन्द्र chief.
वानल: वानल m. (-लः) A kind of holy basil, distinguished as the black species of Tulasī, (Ocymum sanctum.) “काल वावुइ तुलसी ।”
वानस्पत्य: वानस्पत्य m. (-त्यः) A tree bearing fruits from blossoms, as the mango, eugenia, &c.  E. वनस्पति a tree, bearing fruits without blossoms, and ण्य aff.
वानायु: वानायु m. (-युः) 	 1. A country to the north-west of India; see वनायु । 2. An antelope.
वानायुज: वानायुज m. (-जः) A Vānāyu horse, considered as one of a particularly good breed.  E. वनायु and ज born.
वानीर: वानीर m. (-रः) A sort of cane or ratan, (Calamus rotang.)  E. वन water, ईरन् aff., and the first vowel made long.
वानेय: वानेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Relating or belonging to water, &c. 	 m. (-यः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)  E. वन water, ढक् aff.
वान्त: वान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Vomited, ejected from the mouth.  E. वम् to vomit, aff. क्त ।
वान्ताद: वान्ताद m. (-दः) A dog.  E. वान्त what is ejected from the mouth, and अद who eats.
वान्ति: वान्ति m. (-न्तिः) Vomiting, ejecting from the mouth.  E. वम् to vomit, क्तिन् aff.
वान्तिकृत्: वान्तिकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Emetic. 	 m. (-कृत्) A thorny plant, (Vangueria spi-nosa.)  E. वान्ति vomiting, and कृत् what makes; an emetic.
वान्तिद: वान्तिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Emetic. 	 f. (-दा) A medicinal plant, commonly Katukī, (Wrightea antidysenterica; and Colotropis gigantea, BROWN.)  E. वान्ति vomiting, and द what produces; an emetic.
वान्या: वान्या f. (-न्या) A multitude of groves or thickets.  E. वन a wood, यञ् aff. of multitude; also with यत् aff. वन्या ।
वाप: वाप m. (-पः) 	 1. Shaving. 	 2. Sowing seed. 	 3. Weaving.  E. वप् to sow seed, &c., aff. घञ् ।
वाप(य)दण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A weaver's loom.  E. वाप or वाय weaving, दण्ड a stick.
वापि: वापि f. (-पिः or पी) A large oblong pond, a pool, a lake.  E. वाप् to sow seed, (of the lotus, &c.) Unādi aff. इञ् and ङीष् optionally added.
वापित: वापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sown as seed. 	 2. Shaven.  E. वाप shaving, &c., इतच् aff.
वापीह: वापीह m. (-हः) The Chātaka, a bird, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)  E. वापी a pool, हा to abandon, aff. क; drinking rain water only.
वाप्य: वाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be sown, what may or ought to be sown. m. (-प्यः) A sort of costus, (C. speciosus.)  E. वप् to sow, aff. ण्यत् ।
वाम: वाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Left, not right. 	 2. Reverse, contrary, inverted. 3. Beautiful, pleasing. 	 4. Vile, base, wicked. 	 5. Short. 	 6. Crooked. m. (-मः) 	 1. A name of ŚIVA. 	 2. KĀMA or CUPID. 	 3. An udder, a breast. 	 4. A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) 	 5. An animal, a sentient being. 	 6. A snake. 	 n. (-मं) Wealth, possessions. 	 f. (-मा) 1. A woman. 	 2. Gourī. 	 3. LAKSHMĪ. 	 4. SARASWATĪ. 	 f. (-मी) 	 1. A mare. 	 2. A she-ass. 	 3. A young female elephant. 	 4. The female of the jackal.  E. वा to go, Unādi aff. मन् ।
वामता: वामता f. (-ता) 	 1. Perverseness, contrariety. 	 2. Craftiness, wickedness. 3. Loveliness.  E. तल् added to वाम; also with त्व, वामत्वं ।
वामदेव: वामदेव m. (-वः) A name of ŚIVA.  E. वाम contrary, (to human institu-tions,) देव who sports.
वामन: वामन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Short, dwarfish, a dwarf. 	 2. Depressed, pressed flat or down. 	 3. Low, vile, base. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. VISHṆU in his charac-ter of the dwarf, in which he appeared on his fifth descent from heaven, to prevent BALĪ from obtaining dominion of the three worlds. 	 2. The elephant that supports the south quarter. 	 3. A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A female dwarf. 	 2. A sort of woman; also वामनिका । 3. A disease of the vagina. 	 4. A mare.  E. वम् to eject from the mouth, and ल्यु or ल्युट् aff.
वामनीकृत: वामनीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shortened, flattened.  E. वामन, कृत made, च्वि aug.
वामलूर: वामलूर m. (-रः) An ant or mole hill, especially the hillocks of ground thrown up by the white ant.  E. वाम inverted, reversed, लू to cut, aff. रक् ।
वामलोचन: वामलोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fine-eyed. 	 f. (-ना) A handsome woman.  E. वाम beautiful, लोचन eye.
वामशील: वामशील m. (-लः) An epithet of KĀMA.
वामाक्षी: वामाक्षी f. (-क्षी) A handsome woman.  E. वाम beautiful, and अक्षि an eye.
वामाचार: वामाचार m. (-रः) The doctrine of the Tantras according to one system. E. वाम left, and आचार institute; the left hand ritual, the use of flesh, spirits, &c., forming part of the Vāmācāra ceremonies.
वामाचारिन्: वामाचारिन् m. (-री) A follower of the left hand portion of the Tantras. E. वामाचार, and इनि aff.
वामापीडन: वामापीडन m. (-नः) A tree, (Salvadora Persica, &c.:) see पीलु ।
वामावर्त: वामावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A conch-shell with the spiral turn running from right to left.  E. वाम, and आवर्त्त a turn.
वामावर्त्त: वामावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A conch-shell with the spiral turn running from right to left.  E. वाम, and आवर्त्त a turn.
वामिल: वामिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Proud, haughty, intolerant. 	 2. Handsome, beautiful. 	 3. Deceitful.  E. वम् to eject from the mouth, (the faults of others,) aff. इलच् ।
वाय: वाय m. (-यः) Weaving.  E. वे to weave, घञ् aff.
वाय(प)दण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A weaver's loom.  E. वाय or वाप weaving, दण्ड a stick.
वायक: वायक m. (-कः) 	 1. A number, a multitude, a heap. 	 2. A weaver.  E. वय् to go, ण्वुल् aff.
वायन: वायन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sweetmeats or cakes, forming a light refreshment, which is not supposed to be any breach of a religious fast. 	 2. Sweetmeats or cakes, part of an offering to a deity, or prepared on particular occasions, as marriages, &c., and sent as presents to friends and acquaintances.  E. वा to go, ल्युट् aff.; also with कन् added वायनक n. (-कं) ।
वायव: वायव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Windy, relating or belonging to wind. 	 f. (-वी) The north-west quarter or region of the wind.  E. वायु air, wind, and अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीप् ।
वायव्य: वायव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Relating to the wind, sacred to the deity of the wind, &c.  E. वायु wind, and यत् aff.
वायस: वायस m. (-सः) 	 1. A crow. 	 2. Agallochum, (Amyris Agallocha.) 	 3. Turpentine. 	 f. (-सी) 	 1. A species of fig, (Ficus oppositifolia, Rox.) 4. A vegetable, (Solanum Indicum.)  E. वय् to go, Unadi aff. असच्, and the radical vowel made long.
वायसाराति: वायसाराति m. (-तिः) An owl.  E. वायस a crow, and आराति an enemy; also similar compounds, as वायसारि ।
वायसेक्षु: वायसेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A sort of long grass, “काशतृणे ।” (Saccharum spon-taneum.)  E. वायस a crow, and इक्षु the sugar-cane.
वायसोली: वायसोली f. (-ली) A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli.  E. वायस a crow, उलच् aff.
वायु: वायु m. (-युः) 	 1. Air, wind, or its personified deification. 	 2. The air of the body, of which five are enumerated, viz. PRĀṆA, SAMĀNA, APĀNA, UDĀNA, and VYĀNA. 	 3. Morbid affection of the windy humour.  E. वा to go, उण् Unādi aff., and युक् augment.
वायुकेतु: वायुकेतु m. (-तुः) Dust.  E. वायु wind, and केतु a symbol, a sign.
वायुकोण: वायुकोण m. (-णः) The north west.  E. वायु, and कोण corner.
वायुगण्ड: वायुगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Flatulence, indigestion.  E. वायु wind, गडि to be a part of, aff. अच् ।
वायुगति: वायुगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Quick, swift, as the wind.  E. वायु, गति going.
वायुगुल्म: वायुगुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 	 1. A whirlpool, an eddy. 	 2. A whirlwind, a hurricane. E. वायु, गुल्म a cluster: see वातगुल्म ।
वायुग्रस्त: वायुग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Affected by wind, flatulent, epileptic.  E. वायु, अस्त seized.
वायुघ्न: वायुघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Destroying or curing windy disorders.
वायुजात: वायुजात m. (-तः) HANUMĀNA.  E. वायु, and जात born.
वायुदारु: वायुदारु m. (-रुः) A cloud.  E. वायु wind, दृ to scatter, aff. उण् ।
वायुनिवृत्ति: वायुनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Calm, lull. 	 2. Cure of windy disorders.  E. वायु, निवृत्ति stop.
वायुपुत्त्र: वायुपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A name of BHIMA. 	 2. A name of HANUMĀNA.  E. वायु the god of wind, and पुत्त्र a son; also similar compounds, as वायुतनय, &c.
वायुफल: वायुफल n. (-लं) 	 1. The rainbow. 	 2. Hail.  E. वायु wind, and फल fruit.
वायुभक्ष: वायुभक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Eating air, fasting. 	 m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A snake. 	 2. An ascetic who lives on air.  E. वायु wind, and भक्ष who eats.
वायुभक्षण: वायुभक्षण n. (-णं) Fasting, living on air.  E. वायु and भक्षण eating.
वायुभूत: वायुभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Becoming as the wind, going every where at will.  E. वायु and भूत become.
वायुरोषा: वायुरोषा f. (-षा) Night.  E. वायु wind, रुष् to rage, aff. अच् ।
वायुवर्त्मन्: वायुवर्त्मन् m. (-र्त्मा) The atmosphere, sky, heaven.  E. वायु, वर्त्मन् path or road.
वायुवाह: वायुवाह m. (-हः) Smoke, vapour.  E. वायु the wind, and वाह vehicle.
वायुवाहिनी: वायुवाहिनी f. (-नी) A vessel of the body, supposed, as the arteries were once imagined, to convey the aerial humour.  E. वायु, वाहिनी bearing.
वायुवेगसम: वायुवेगसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Swift as the wind.  E. वायु, वेग speed, सम equal.
वायुष: वायुष m. (-षः) A sort of fish. “काल्वोस् माछ ।”
वायुसख: वायुसख m. (-खः) Fire.  E. वायु wind, सखि friend, aff. टच्; also without the aff. वायुसखि ।
वायुसम: वायुसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Like wind, unsubstantial. 	 2. Swift.  E. वायु, सम same.
वायुसम्भव: वायुसम्भव m. (-वः) HANUMĀNA.  E. वायु, सम्भव born.
वाय्वास्पद: वाय्वास्पद n. (-दं) Ether, atmosphere.  E. वायु wind, आस्पद place, site.
वार्: वार् n. (-वाः) Water.  E. वृ to surround, aff. क्विप् ।
वार: वार m. (-रः) 	 1. A multitude, a quantity, a flock or herd, a heap. 	 2. Occasion, opportunity. 	 3. A day of the week. 	 4. A moment. 	 5. A name of ŚIVA. 	 6. A door-way, a gate. 	 7. Achyranthes aspera. 	 8. A cover. 	 9. A turn. 	 10. The opposite bank of a river. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. A vessel for holding spirituous liquor. 	 2. Bile. 	 2. Water. Adv. A time, as वारं बारं many a time, repeatedly, often: see वारम्बारं. E. वृ to cover, to choose, &c., aff. घञ् ।
वारक: वारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Opposing, obstructing, an obstacle or agent of resistance. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A horse's paces. 	 2. A horse. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. The seat of pain. 	 2. A sort of fragrant grass: see वाल.  E. वृ to choose, &c., ण्वुल् aff.
वारकिन्: वारकिन् m. (-की) 	 1. The ocean. 	 2. Aihorse with good marks. 	 3. An ene-my. 	 4. An ascetic, one living upon leaves, &c.  E. वारक an obstacle, &c., इनि aff.
वारकीर: वारकीर m. (-रः) 	 1. A wife's brother. 	 2. Submarine fire. 	 3. A louse. 	 4. A small comb. 	 5. A horse of high spirit, a war-horse, a charger. 	 6. A bearer of burthens, a porter.  E. वार an obstacle, कॄ to scatter, aff. अच् ।
वारङ्क: वारङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A bird in general.  E. वार् water, अकि to go, aff. अच् ।
वारङ्ग: वारङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The handle of a sword or knife, &c.  E. वृ to select, aff. अङ्गच्, and the radical vowel changed to the Vriddhi form.
वारट: वारट n. (-टं) 	 1. A field. 	 2. A number of fields. 	 f. (-टा) A goose; also वरटा.  E. वार् water, अट् to go, aff. अच्; or वृ-अटच् ।
वारण: वारण n. (-णं) 	 1. Resistance, opposition, prohibition, obstacle or impe-diment. 	 2. Defence, protecting, guarding. 	 3. Warding off a blow, guarding, warding. 	 m. (-णः) 	 1. Armour, a cuirass or mail for the body. 	 2. An elephant.  E. वॄ to cover or screen, to defend, aff. ल्युट् ।
वारणबुषा: वारणबुषा f. (-षा) The plantain or banana, (Musa sapientum.)  E. वारण an elephant, बुष् or बुस् to cast off, aff. क; hence it is written also वारणबुसा; also वार्बुषा ।
वारणवल्लभा: वारणवल्लभा f. (-भा) The plantain tree.  E. वारण an elephant, वल्लभ beloved.
वारत्र: वारत्र n. (-त्रं) Leather fit for or made into thongs.  E. वरत्रा, अण् aff.
वारनारी: वारनारी f. (-री) A harlot.  E. वार and नारी a woman.
वारबधू: वारबधू f. (-धूः) The chief of a set of harlots.  E. वार a number, and बधू wife.
वारबुषा: वारबुषा f. (-षा) A Banāna; also वारबूषा ।
वारमुख्या: वारमुख्या f. (-ख्या) The head of a set of harlots.  E. वार a troop, मुख्या a chief.
वारम्बारम्: वारम्बारम् Ind. Repeatedly, again and again.  E. वार a day, a time, repeated.
वारला: वारला f. (-ला) 	 1. A wasp. 	 2. A goose.  E. वार a flock, a flight, ला to get, and क and टाप् affs.; also बरला &c.
वारवाण: वारवाण mn. (-णः-णं) Armour for the body or breast, an iron cuirass, or a thick quilted jacket worn for the same purpose.  E. वार opposing, वाण an arrow; also वाणवार.
वारवाणि: वारवाणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. A player on the flute. 	 2. A singer, a musician. 	 3. A judge. 	 4. A year. 	 f. (-णिः or णी) 	 1. The chief of a set of harlots. 2. A whore.  E. वार् a multitude, वाणी speech.
वारविलासिनी: वारविलासिनी f. (-नी) A harlot, a whore.  E. वार a multitude, विलासिनी a wanton.
वारवृषा: वारवृषा f. (-षा) 	 1. Grain. 	 2. Plantain.  E. वारं जलसङ्घं वर्षत्यत्र वृष्-क ।
वारवेला: वारवेला f. (-ला) A portion of the day in which any act religious or secular is suspended.  E. वार and वेला time.
वारसुन्दरी: वारसुन्दरी f. (-री) A whore, a prostitute.  E. वार the multitude, सुन्दरी a beauty.
वारसेवा: वारसेवा f. (-वा) 	 1. A set of courtezans. 	 2. Prostitution, harlotry.  E. वार the multitude, and सेवा service.
वारस्त्री: वारस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A whore.  E. वार the many, स्त्री a woman, a common woman.
वारांनिधि: वारांनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean.  E. वारां of water, and निधि receptacle.
वाराङ्गना: वाराङ्गना f. (-ना) A harlot.  E. वार and अङ्गना a woman.
वाराणसी: वाराणसी f. (-सी) The holy city Benares.  E. वर best, अनस् water, affs. अण् and ङीष् i. e. the Ganges on which it stands; also वराणसी ।
वाराणसेय: वाराणसेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Produced at or born in Benares,  E. वाराणसी the city, ढक् aff.
वारासन: वारासन n. (-नं) A large water-jar, a cistern, a reservoir.  E. वार् water, आसन place of abiding.
वाराह: वाराह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Relating to a boar, belonging to, derived from, &c. 	 f. (-ही) 	 1. An esculent root, a Yam, (Dioscorea.) 	 2. One of the divine mothers. 	 3. A measure. 	 4. The earth. 	 5. A sow. E. वराह a hog or VISHṆU in that form, &c., अण् aff. and ङीप्, fem. form.
वारि: वारि n. (-रि) 	 1. Water. 	 2. A vegetable perfume, commonly Bālā. 	 f. (-रिः) 	 1. A name of SARASWATĪ; the goddess of speech. 	 2. The place where an elephant is tied or fastened. 	 3. A captive, a prisoner. 	 f. (-रिः or री) 	 1. A water-pot, whether large or small, pitcher, a jar. 	 2. The rope that fastens an elephant. 	 3. A hole or trap for catching elephant.  E. वृञ् to surround, Unādi aff. इन् ।

वार्षुक: वार्षुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sprinkling, wetting, that which sprinkles, &c. E. वृष् to sprinkle, उकञ् aff.
वार्हत: वार्हत n. (-तं) The fruit of the solanum jacquini.  E. वृहति the plant, with अण् aff.
वार्हद्रथ: वार्हद्रथ m. (-थः) A name of JARĀSANDHA.  E. वृहद्रथ the father of this prince, and अण् patronymic; also with इञ् aff. वार्हद्रथि ।
वार्हस्पत: वार्हस्पत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Sacred to VRIHASPATĪ.  E. वृहस्पति and अण् aff.
वार्हस्पत्य: वार्हस्पत्य n. (-त्यं) Ethics, morality.  E. वृहस्पति the supposed original au-thor of this science, and ण्य aff.
वालक: वालक m. (-कः) 	 1. A bracelet. 	 2. A finger-ring.  E. वल् to surround, aff. ण्वुल् ।
वाल्क: वाल्क mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्की-ल्कं) Made of the bark of trees.  E. वल्क bark, aff. अण्.
वाल्कल: वाल्कल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Made of bark. 	 f. (-ली) Spirituous liquor. 	 n. (-लं) A dress made of the bark of trees worn by ascetics.  E. वल्कल bark, and अण् aff.
वाल्मिकि: वाल्मिकि m. (-किः) The author of the Rāmāyaṇa; also वाल्मीकि ।
वाल्मीक: वाल्मीक m. (-कः) VĀLMĪKA or VĀLMĪKI, the first poet and the famous author of the Rāmāyaṇa. Though a Brāhmana by birth he led a depraved life and was a notorious cut-throat, but was reclaimed by Nārada. One day while he was engaged in his devotions, he saw a fowler in the act of shooting at a pair of curlews and a curse fell from his mouth in the shape of a regular stanza. The sage discovered that it was a new mode of composition and by the advice of BRAHMĀ he composed the Rāmāyaṇa in that style. SITĀ when repudiated by her husband, took refuge with this sage who brought up her twin sons.  E. वल्मीक an ant-hill, aff. अण्, or with इञ् aff. वाल्मीकि; so immersed in abstraction as to be overrun with ant's nests.
वावदूक: वावदूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Talking much, gabbling, prattling.  E. वद् to speak, Unādi aff. ऊक, the root reiterated.
वावदूकता: वावदूकता f. (-ता) Garrulity, loquaciousness.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, वावदूकत्वं ।
वावय: वावय m. (-यः) A sort of Basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)
वावहि: वावहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Who or what bears or carries much.  E. वह् to bear, कि aff.
वावृत्: वावृत्(उ)वावृतु r. 4th cl. (वावृत्यते) 	 1. To choose or select. 	 2. To serve.
वावृत्त: वावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Chosen, appointed.  E. वृत् to be, aff. क्त, and the root reiterated.
वावृत्यमान: वावृत्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Choosing, preferring.  E. वावृत to choose, शानच् aff.
वाश्: वाश्(ऋ)वाशृ r. 4th cl. (वाश्यते) 	 1. To sound. 	 2. To cry as a bird. 	 3. To call. 	 4. To howl, to growl, to roar.
वाशत्: वाशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) 	 1. Crying or singing like a bird. 	 2. Growling, roaring.  E. वाश् to cry, aff. शतृ ।
वाशन: वाशन n. (-नं) The cry or song of birds, bees, and the like.  E. वाश् to sound as a bird, ल्युट् aff.
वाशा: वाशा f. (-शा) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa:) see वास and वासक; also with कन् added वाशिका । “वाकस गाछ ।”
वाशि: वाशि m. (-शिः) Fire.  E. वाश् to sound, Unādi aff. इञ् ।
वाशित: वाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Perfumed, scented. 	 2. Sung, called, cried. 	 n. (-तं) The cry of birds or animals. 	 f. (-ता) 	 1. A woman. 	 2. A female-elephant.  E. वाष् to call, or वास् to perfume, aff. क्त, and ष or स changed to श ।
वाशिष्ठ: वाशिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Relating to the sage VASISHṬHA. 	 f. (-ष्ठी) The Goomti river, which rising in the Kumaun hills, pursues a winding and south-easterly course, and passing Lucknow and Jonpur falls into the Ganges, below Benares.  E. वशिष्ठ the saint, अण् aff., derived from him; also read वासिष्ठ ।
वाशुरा: वाशुरा f. (-रा) Night.  E. वाश् to sound, Unādi aff. उरच् ।

वाष्कल: वाष्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Large, great. 	 m. (-लः) A warrior.
वाष्प: वाष्प(स्प) m. (-ष्पः or स्पः) 	 1. Vapour, hot mist, steam, &c. 	 2. A tear. 	 3. Iron. 	 f. (-ष्पी) A drug.  E. वा to go, or वै to dry, aff. प, form irr., also बाष्प, as derived from बाध् to oppose, and ध changed to ष ।
वाष्पका: वाष्पका f. (-का) A drug, commonly Hingupatri.  E. कन् added to वाष्प vapour; also वाष्पिका ।
वाष्पाकल: वाष्पाकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Uttered or articulated with tears.  E. वाष्प, and आकल what sounds.
वाष्पाकुल: वाष्पाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Interrupted by tears.  E. वाष्प, आकुल perplexed.
वाष्पिका: वाष्पिका f. (-का) A drug, commonly Hingupatri.  E. वाष्प a tear, कन् aff.
वाष्पोद्भव: वाष्पोद्भव m. (-वः) Starting of tears.  E. वाष्प and उद्भव production.

वासःकुटी: वासःकुटी f. (-टी) A tent.  E. वासस् cloth, and कुटी a hut.
वासक: वासक mf. (-कः-सका or सिका) 	 1. A shrub, (Justicia ganderussa.) 	 2. Perfuming.  E. वास् to perfume, aff. ण्वुल् ।
वासकसज्जा: वासकसज्जा f. (-ज्जा) A woman dressed with all her ornaments, and hav-ing her apartments, &c. decorated to receive her lover.  E. वास clo-thes, कन् pleonasm, and सज्जा accoutrements; also with कन् added, वासकसज्जिका ।

वासत: वासत m. (-तः) An ass.  E. वास, अतच् aff.
वासताम्बूल: वासताम्बूल n. (-लं) Betel with other fragrant substances.
वासतेय: वासतेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Habitable, fit or proper to be dwelt in. 	 f. (-यी) Night.  E. वसति abode, or night, ढक् aff.

Knowledge. 	 6. A water-jar. 	 7. A box, a basket, a vessel, &c. 	 8. An envelope. 	 9. Any receptacle. 	 10. Steep-ing, infusing. 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. वासनस्थ: वासनस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Packed, folded, enveloped.  E. वासन a box, &c., and स्थ what stays or is.

The southern wind, zephyr. 	 6. A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) 	 7. The black kind of Moong or bean. 	 8. A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) 	 f. (-न्ती) 	 1. A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held in the month of Chaitra. 	 6. A species of the Sarkarī metre.  E. वस् to dwell, aff. झच्, and the vowel made long; or वसन्त spring, and अण् aff.
वासन्तक: वासन्तक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Sown or growing in spring. 	 2. Suitable to the spring season. 	 3. Relating or belonging to it, vernal.  E. वसन्त spring, and वुञ् aff.

वासर: वासर mn. (-रः-रं) A day. 	 m. (-रः) One of the Nāgas or serpents.  E. वस् to abide, in the causal form, Unādi aff. अरन् ।
वासरसङ्ग: वासरसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. INDRA. 	 2. The morning.  E. वासर, सङ्ग connection.
वासव: वासव m. (-वः) INDRA. 	 f. (-वी) The mother of VYĀSA.  E. वसु a VASU, अण् aff.
वासवि: वासवि m. (-विः) An epithet of ARJUNA.
वासस्: वासस् n. (-सः) Cloth, clothes.  E. वस् to cover or clothe, aff. असुन् ।
वाससज्जा: वाससज्जा f. (-ज्जा) A woman drest in all her ornaments to receive her lover.  E. वास clothes, सज्ज armed, accoutred.
वासागार: वासागार n. (-रं) The inner or sleeping apartment.  E. वास abiding, आगार a house.
वासि: वासि mf. (-सिः-सी) A small hatchet or chopper, an adze. 	 m. (-सिः) Abiding.  E. वस् to abide, Unādi aff. इञ् ।
वासिका: वासिका f. (-का) A plant, (Justicia:) see वासक ।
वासित: वासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Perfumed, scented. 	 2. Clothed, dressed. 	 3. Famous, celebrated. 	 4. Steeped, infused. 	 5. Spiced, seasoned, (sau-ces, &c.) 	 6. Peopled, populous, flourishing, (a country.) 	 7. Having, possessing. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. The cry of birds. 	 2. Knowledge in general, but especially that derived from memory. 	 3. Sound. 	 4. Rendering a country populous and flourishing, causing it to be inhabited. 	 f. (-ता) 	 1. A woman. 	 2. A female-elephant.  E. वस् to dwell, or clothes, cansal form, or वास् to call, (as a bird,) aff. क्त ।
वासिन्: वासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Abiding, staying. 	 f. (-नी) A white sort of Jhiṇṭī. (Barleria.)  E. वस् to dwell, घिनुण् aff.; or वास-इनि aff.
वासिष्ठ: वासिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Explained or composed by the sage VAAISHṬHA, a part of the Vedas or a particular prayer, &c.  E. वसिष्ठ, अण् aff.
वासु: वासु m. (-सुः) 	 1. A name of VISHṆU. 	 2. The soul, or the Supreme Being considered as the soul of the universe.  E. वस् to abide, (eternally,) उण् Unādi aff.
वासुकि: वासुकि m. (-किः) The serpent VĀSUKI, sovereign of the snakes and worn by ŚIVA on his person.  E. वसु a jewel, क the head, or वसुक here said to be a name of KAŚYAPA, aff. of descent इञ् ।

वासुपूज्य: वासुपूज्य m. (-ज्यः) The twelfth Jina or Jaina teacher of the present æra.
वासुभद्र: वासुभद्र m. (-द्रः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. वासु the soul, भद्र auspicious.
वासुरा: वासुरा f. (-रा) 	 1. Night. 	 2. The earth. 	 3. A woman. 	 4. A female ele-phant.  E. वास् to perfume, or वस् to abide, causal form, aff. उरन् ।

वासोद: वासोद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives clothes.  E. वासस्, द what gives.

वासौकस्: वासौकस् n. (-कः) The inner or private apartments.  E. वास dwelling, ओकस् a house.
वास्त: वास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ती-स्तं) Made or derived from a goat.  E. वस्त and अण् aff.
वास्तव: वास्तव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 	 1. Determined, demonstrated, fixed, substantia-ted. 	 2. Real, substantial. 	 n. (-वं) An appointment, anything fixed. f. (-वा) Dawn.  E. वस्तु thing, substance, अण् aff.
वास्तविक: वास्तविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Real, material, substantial, genuine. 	 2. Determinate.  E. वस्तु and ठक् aff.
वास्तवोषा: वास्तवोषा f. (-षा) Night.  E. वास्तव an appointment, and ऊषा a libidinous woman: the season in which she makes an assignation.

वास्तु: वास्तु mn. (-स्तुः-स्तु) 	 1. The site of a habitation. 	 2. A house, a habitation. E. वस् to dwell, Unādi aff. तुन्, and the radical vowel made long.
वास्तुक: वास्तुक n. (-कं) A potherb: see वास्तूक ।

वास्तूक: वास्तूक n. (-कं) A potherb, (Chenopodium album, and other edible spe-cies.)  E. वास्तु the site of a house, ठक् aff., and form irr. (growing there;) also with the vowel unaltered वास्तुक ।
वास्तेय: वास्तेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 	 1. Abdominal, relating or belonging to the belly. 2. Fit to be inhabited.  E. वस्ति and ढक् aff.
वास्तोष्पति: वास्तोष्पति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA.  E. वास्तु the site of a dwelling, in the sixth case, पति master.
वास्त्र: वास्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Cloth, made of or covered with cloth, &c.  E. वस्त्र cloth, अण् aff.
वास्प: वास्प m. (-स्पः) 	 1. Vapour. 	 2. Tears; more correctly वाष्प, q. v.
वास्पविक्लव: वास्पविक्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Weeping, bursting into tears.  E. वास्प, विक्लव distressed.
वास्पाविलेक्षण: वास्पाविलेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Suffused with tears, weeping.  E. वास्प, and आविल turbid, ईक्षण the sight.

E. वह्ल् to be pre-eminent, इकन् or ईकन् aff., वह्लिक or वह्लीक; again, अण् pleonastic or derivative added, वाह्लिक or वाह्लीक; the conjunct letters of the root being trans-posed; saffron, &c. are supplied still to India, especially from Kāshmir, Khorāsān, and the countries in that direction.
वि: वि mf. (-विः-वी) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. The eye. 	 3. Heaven. 	 4. The region of the wind. 	 5. A horse. Ind. A particle and prefix, implying:--1. Certain-ty, ascertainment, as विवेक्तुं to determine, to judge. 	 2. Separation, disjunction, as वियोक्तुं to disjoin. 	 3. Aversion, repugnance, as विरोद्धुं to oppose. 	 4. Impatience, intolerance, as विमृष्टुं to be impatient. 	 5. Variety, difference, विशेष्टुं to distinguish. 	 6. Cause, motive, विधातुं to prescribe or order. 	 7. Motion, progress, विचरितुं to go. 	 8. Pri-vation, विणीतुं to take away. It generally corresponds to the Eng-lish adjuncts, a, ex, de, dis, in, un, &c. and is frequently an expletive.  E. वा to go, Unādi aff. इन् with the effect of डित् or ड, which ejects the final syllable; or वा-कि aff.

One of the persons named ŚUKLA BĀLAS by the Jainas. 	 6. The god of Hades, YAMA. 	 f. (-या) 	 1. An epithet of the goddess DURGĀ. 	 2. One of the female friends or attendants of DURGĀ. 	 3. One of the wives of YAMA. 	 4. Hemp, (Cannabis sativa,) or the tops of the plant used as a narcotic. 	 5. Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 	 6. Orris root. 	 7. A peculiar lunar day; the third, eighth, or thirteenth of a fortnight; it is also applied to the tenth day of the light-half of the month Āshwin, (Sept-Oct.) on which the image of DURGĀ, set up during the great festival in honour of her, is cast into the water.  E. वि before, जि to conquer, aff. अच् ।
विजयकुञ्जर: विजयकुञ्जर m. (-रः) A royal or war-elephant.  E. विजय victory, कुञ्जर an elephant.
विजयच्छन्द: विजयच्छन्द m. (-न्दः) A kind of necklace, one of 504 rows or strings. E. विजय triumph, &c. and छन्द covering, from छदि, aff. अच् ।
विजयनन्दन: विजयनन्दन m. (-नः) A sovereign of the race of IKSHWĀKU.  E. विजय victory or a proper name, and नन्दन the son.
विजयमर्दल: विजयमर्द्दल m. (-लः) A large military drum.  E. विजय victory, मर्द्दल a drum.
विजयमर्द्दल: विजयमर्द्दल m. (-लः) A large military drum.  E. विजय victory, मर्द्दल a drum.
विजयमान: विजयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Victorious, triumphant.  E. वि before, जि to conquer, शानच् aff.
विजयसिद्धि: विजयसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Success, victory.  E. विजय, सिद्धि accomplishment.
विजयासप्तमी: विजयासप्तमी f. (-मी) The seventh day of the light-half of a month fall-ing on a Sunday.  E. विजया victory, सप्तमी the seventh.
विजयिन्: विजयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Victorious, triumphant, conquering, a con-queror.  E. विजय and इनि aff.
विजयिन: विजयिन n. (-नं) Sauce mixed with the water of boiled-rice; also विजिन.
विजल: विजल n. (-लं) Sauce, &c. mixed with rice-water or gruel.  E. विज् to shake, aff. कलच्; also विजिल, विज्जन, &c.
विजल्प: विजल्प m. (-ल्पः) 	 1. Talk, speech. 	 2. A malicious speech.
विजात: विजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Born severally. 	 2. Base-born, of mixed origin. 3. Transformed. 	 f. (-ता) The mother of children, a matron.  E. वि severally, जात born, (from whom.)
विजाति: विजाति f. (-तिः) A different species or tribe.  E. वि and जाति sort.
विजातीय: विजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Of a different caste. 	 2. Of mixed origin. 	 3. Dissimilar, of a different sort or nature.  E. वि, जाती caste, छ aff.
विजानत्: विजानत् mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्) 	 1. Possessing various or extended know-ledge. 	 2. Knowing, understanding  E. वि, ज्ञा to know, शतृ aff.
विजिगीष: विजिगीष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Desirous of victory, emulative, anxious to overcome or conquer, &c.  E. वि before, जि to conquer, in the desiderative form, aff. अच् ।
विजिगीषा: विजिगीषा f. (-षा) Competition, emulation, wish to surpass, or subdue. E. जि to conquer, with वि prefixed, desid. v., अङ्, and टाप् affs.
विजिगीषु: विजिगीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous to conquer or overcome. 	 m. (-षुः) 	 1. A warrior. 	 2. An invader, an antagonist. 	 3. A disputant. 	 4. An opponent in general, &c.  E. वि before, जि to conquer, desiderative form, उ aff.
विजिग्राहयिषु: विजिग्राहयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to excite to war.  E. वि before, ग्रह् to take, desid of the causal v., उ aff.
विजिघृक्षु: विजिघृक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Determined or wishing to encounter, oppose, fight with, overcome, &c.  E. वि before, ग्रह to take, desid. v., उ aff.
विजित: विजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Defeated, conquered.  E. वि before, जित conquered.
विजितवत्: विजितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Victorious, conquering.  E. वि before, जि to conquer, क्तवतु aff.
विजितव्य: विजितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be apprehended or feared.  E. विज् to fear, तव्य aff.
विजितात्मन्: विजितात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-subdued.  E. विजित and आत्मन् self.
विजिति: विजिति f. (-तिः or ती) Victory, conquest.
विजितृ: विजितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what separates, divides, &c. 	 m. (-ता) 1. A judge, a discriminator, a distinguisher. 	 2. A partner or co-heir.  E. विज् to separate, &c., aff. तृच् and इट् augment.
विजितेन्द्रिय: विजितेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of subdued organs or passions.  E. विजित and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
विजित्य: विजित्य Ind. Having conquered.  E. वि before, जि to conquer, ल्यप् aff.
विजिन: विजिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mixed with rice-gruel, &c. (sauce or condiments.) E. विज् to shake, aff. इनच् ।
विजिल: विजिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice-water or gruel, (sauce or condi-ments, &c.)  E. विज् to shake, aff. इलच् ।
विजिविल: विजिविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice-water, sauces, &c.
विजिहीर्षा: विजिहीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Wish or intention to take pleasure or sport.  E. वि before, हृ to take, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
विजिहीर्षु: विजिहीर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) Wishing or speaking for sport or amusement. E. वि before, हृ to take, desid. v., उ aff.
विजिह्म: विजिह्म mfn. (-ह्मः-ह्मा-ह्मं) 	 1. Curved, bent. 	 2. Awry, crooked in mind or purpose, dishonest, depraved.  E. वि privative, and जिह्म straight.
विजिह्मता: विजिह्मता f. (-ता) 	 1. Crookedness. 	 2. Craftiness.  E. विजिह्म and तल् aff.
विजुल: विजुल m. (-लः) The silk-cotton tree.  E. विज-उलच् aff.
विजृम्भण: विजृम्भण n. (-णं) 	 1. Pastime, sport, especially amorous. 	 2. Budding, blossoming, expanding. 	 3. Yawning, gaping. 	 4. Exhibiting, dis-playing.  E. वि before, जृभि to yawn, aff. ल्युट् ।
विजृम्भित: विजृम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Blossomed, expanded, opened, unfolded. 	 2. Yawning, gaping. 	 3. Sported, wantoned. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Wish, desire. 2. Pastime, sport.  E. वि before, जृभि to yawn or open, क्त aff.
विजेतृ: विजेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Victorious, a victor.  E. वि, जि to conquer, तृच् aff.
विज्जन: विज्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mixed with rice-water or gruel, (sauce, gravy, &c.): see विजिल; it is also occurs विज्जल ।
विज्जल: विज्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice-water, &c.: see विजिल. 	 n. (-लं) An arrow.
विज्जुल: विज्जुल n. (-लं) Cinnamor.  E. विज-उलच् aff. “दारुचिनि ।”
विज्ञ: विज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 	 1. Skilful, able, clever, conversant. 	 2. Wise, learned.  E. वि implying separation, discrimination, ज्ञ who knows.
विज्ञता: विज्ञता f. (-ता) Wisdom, learning.  E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, विज्ञत्वं ।
विज्ञप्त: विज्ञप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Stated, reported, represented.  E. वि, ज्ञा to know, causal v., क्त aff.
विज्ञप्ति: विज्ञप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 	 1. Information, representation, respectful communica-tion or information, or opinion on any subject. 	 2. An announce-ment.  E. वि before, ज्ञा to know, causal form, aff. क्तिन् ।
विज्ञात: विज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Celebrated, famous, known. 	 2. Known, under-stood.  E. वि before, ज्ञा to know, aff. क्त ।
विज्ञान: विज्ञान n. (-नं) 	 1. Knowledge, science, learning, worldly knowledge or wisdom, that which comprehends any subject, except an under-standing of the true nature of GOD or BRAHMA, acquirable by abstract meditation and the study of the Vedas; it is also des-cribed as conversancy with the arts of painting, &c., and with books, as the Smriti-Shāstras or works on law, and other bran-ches of science or literature. 	 2. Business, employment. 	 3. Music. E. वि implying variety, and ज्ञान knowledge.
विज्ञानपाद: विज्ञानपाद m. (-दः) An epithet of VYĀSA.
विज्ञानमातृक: विज्ञानमातृक m. (-कः) A name of BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha religion.  E. विज्ञान knowledge, मातृक parent.
विज्ञानिक: विज्ञानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Clever, skilful, conversant; also वैज्ञानिक. E. विज्ञान, ठक् aff.
विज्ञापक: विज्ञापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what makes known. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. An informant. 	 2. An instructor.  E. वि, ज्ञा to know, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
विज्ञापन: विज्ञापन n. (-नं) 	 1. Teaching, instruction, communication of knowledge not religious, &c. 	 2. Representing, informing.  E. वि before, ज्ञा to know, causal form, aff. ल्युट् ।
विज्ञापनीय: विज्ञापनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be made known, represented, taught, &c. E. वि before, ज्ञा to know, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
विज्ञापित: विज्ञापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Apprised, informed. 	 2. Instructed.  E. वि be-fore, ज्ञा to know, causal v., क्त aff.
विज्ञाय: विज्ञाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Cognizable, comprehensible, what is to be or may be known or understood.  E. वि implying discrimination, ज्ञा to know, यत् participle aff.
विज्वर: विज्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Exempt from decay. 	 2. Free from fever.  E. वि, ज्वरा decay, or ज्वर fever.
विझर्झर: विझर्झर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Harsh, disagreeable, (as sound.)  E. वि before, झर्झर clanging.
विञ्जामर: विञ्जामर n. (-रं) The white of the eye.
विञ्जोली: विञ्जोली f. (-ली) A line, a row, a range.
विट्: विट् r. 1st cl. (वेटति) 	 1. To sound. 	 2. To curse. (इ) विटि r. 10th cl. (विण्टयति-ते) To decay.
विट: विट m. (-टः) 	 1. A catamite, a pathic. 	 2. A rogue, a cheat. 	 3. An attendant on a dissolute character or courtezan, he is represented as on familiar terms with his associate and accomplished in the arts of singing and poetry. 	 4. A paramour, a gallant. 	 5. A mountain. 	 6. The Khayer-tree, (Mimosa catechu.) 	 7. A medi-cinal salt: see विड्लवण. 	 8. A rat. 	 9. The orange tree. 	 10. A branch and its shoot.  E. विट् to sound, aff. क ।
विटङ्क: विटङ्क mn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्कं) 	 1. A dove-cot, an aviary. 	 2. The highest point. E. वि variously, टकि to bind, aff. अच्; also with कन् added विटङ्कक ।
विटप: विटप mn. (-पः-पं) 	 1. The branch of a tree or creeper with its new sprout or shoot. 	 2. A new shoot. 	 3. A branch. 	 4. Expansion, spreading. 	 5. A clump, a cluster. 	 6. A bush. 	 7. The perinæum or septum of the scrotum. 	 m. (-पः) The keeper of pathics.  E. विट a branch, &c., and पा to cherish, aff. क; or विट् to sound, Unādi aff. अप, with the radical vowel unchanged.
विटपिन्: विटपिन् m. (-पी) 	 1. A tree. 	 2. The large Indian fig-tree, (Ficus Indica.) E. विटप a branch or shoot, and इनि aff.
विटमाक्षिक: विटमाक्षिक m. (-कः) A kind of mineral: see माक्षिक ।
विटलवण: विटलवण n. (-णं) A medicinal salt. see विट; also विट्लवण ।
विटि: विटि f. (-टिः or टी) Yellow saunders.
विट्कारिका: विट्कारिका f. (-का) A kind of bird, probably a variety of the Turdus Salica of Buchannan.)  E. विट् from विट् fæces, कारिका working.
विट्खदिर: विट्खदिर m. (-रः) A fetid Mimosa.  E. विट् fæces, खदिर Mimosa catechu.
विट्चर: विट्चर m. (-रः) The tame or village hog.  E. विट् filth, &c. चर who goes.
विट्पण्य: विट्पण्य n. (-ण्यं) Goods, merchandise.  E. विट् a Vaiśya, पण्य wares.
विट्पति: विट्पति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A son-in-law, a daughter's husband. 	 2. A head merchant.  E. विश् a Vaiśya, &c., and पति master.
विट्लवण: विट्लवण n. (-णं) A fetid salt: see विड.  E. विट् ordure, लवण salt.
विट्सङ्ग: विट्सङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Constipation.  E. विट् and सङ्ग aggregate.
विट्सारिका: विट्सारिका f. (-का) A bird, a sort of thrush; a variety of the bird, usually though inaccurately called Maina in Bengal.  E. विट् fæces, सारिका the same bird, or another species of the same. “गुयेसालिक ।”
विड्: विड् r. 1st cl. (वेडति) 	 1. To divide, to break. 	 2. To curse, to revile. 	 3. To cry out against.
विड् f. (-विड्) A bit, a fragment.  E. विड् to break, क्विप् aff.
विड: विड n. (-डं) 	 1. Factitious salt, or salt procured by boiling soil found near the sea-shore, or any earth impregnated with saline particles. 2. A particular fetid kind of salt, used as a tonic aperient, com-monly called black salt or Vit-lavaṇ, prepared by fusing fossile-salt with a small portion of Emblic myrobalans; the produce is muriate of soda with small quantities of muriate of lime, sulphur and oxid of iron. 	 3. A part, a fracture, a bit.  E. विड् to divide, aff. क ।
विडगन्ध: विडगन्ध n. (-न्धं) The medicinal salt called Vit-lavaṇ: see the last. E. विड salt, गन्ध smell.
विडङ्ग: विडङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Clever, able, skilful, conversant. 	 mn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गं) A vegetable and medicinal substance, considered of great efficacy as a vermifuge.  E. विड् to break, to curse, Unādi aff. अङ्गच् ।
विडम्बन: विडम्बन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Afflicting, distressing. 	 2. Vexation, mortification. 3. Frustrating, rendering vain. 	 4. Imitation, copying, especially assuming a similar appearance or dress, disguise, masquerade. 5. Deception, fraud. 	 6. Ridiculousness. 	 7. The supernatural assumption of a borrowed form, transformation.  E. वि before, डवि to heap, aff. ल्युट् ।
विडम्बनीय: विडम्बनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be distressed or annoyed. 	 2. To be assumed as a disguise.  E. वि before, डवि to heap, अनीयर् aff.
विडम्बयत्: विडम्बयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Assuming, putting on, (as a borrowed dress or appearance. 	 2. Imitating.  E. वि before, डवि to heap, aff. शतृ ।
विडम्बित: विडम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Low, poor, abject, distressed. 	 2. Vexed, mortified. 	 3. Assumed, put on, (as a borrowed form, &c.) simu-lated, transformed. 	 4. Copied, imitated. 	 5. Ridiculed, derided. 	 6. Deceived.  E. वि before, डिवि to heap, aff. क्त ।
विडारक: विडारक m. (-कः) A cat. E. See the next, the ल being changed to र ।
विडाल: विडाल m. (-लः) 	 1. cat. 	 2. The eye-ball.  E. विड् to divide, to tear, (rats,) Unādi aff. कालन्; also with कन् added, विडालक, and ल being changed to र, विडारक ।
विडालक: विडालक n. (-कं) 	 1. Yellow orpiment. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. Application of oint-ment to the external part of the eye, especially to the eye-lids, of which the lashes have fallen off or been ulcerated. 	 2. A cat.  E. कन् added to the last.
विडालपद: विडालपद m. (-दः) A measure of weight, the same as the Karsha or weight of sixteen Māshas.  E. विडाल a cat, पद the foot.
विडीन: विडीन n. (-नं) One of the different modes of flight attributed to birds, imitative flight.  E. वि severally, and डीन flying.
विडुल: विडुल m. (-लः) A sort of cane, (Calamus rotang.)  E. विड-कुलन् । “वेतस वृक्षे ।”
विडोजस्: विडोजस् m. (-जाः) A name of INDRA.  E. विड् a fragment; (splitting mountains, &c. with his thunderbolt,) or विट् from विश् a Vaiśya, (here meaning a subject or man in general,) and ओजस् strength, splendour; also विडौजस्
विडग्रह: विडग्रह m. (-हः) Constipation.  E. विट् and ग्रह taking.
विड्ज: विड्ज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced from ordure. 	 n. (-जं) A fungus.  E. विट्, ज born.
विड्भव: विड्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced from ordure.  E. विट्, भव born.
विड्भुज्: विड्भुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Feeding on ordure.  E. विष् and भुज् who eats.
विड्लवण: विड्लवण n. (-णं) A medicinal salt, commonly black salt, Vitlaban: see विड.  E. विड् to divide, aff. क्विप्, and लवण salt; also विट्लवण ।
विड्वराह: विड्वराह m. (-हः) A village or tame hog.  E. विट् fæces, वराह a hog.
वितंस: वितंस m. (-सः) A cage, a net, a chain or any apparatus for confining beasts or birds.  E. वि before, तसि to adorn, aff. अच्; also वीतंस ।

विद्ध: विद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Pierced, perforated. 	 2. Thrown, cast, directed, sent. 	 3. Like, resembling. 	 4. Opposed, impeded. 	 5. Beaten, whip-ped. 	 m. (-द्धः) A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 	 n. (-द्धं) A wound.  E. विध् to pierce, or व्यध् to beat, aff. क्त ।
विद्धकर्ण: विद्धकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Having the ears pierced or slit. 	 mf. (-र्णः-र्णा or -र्णी) A plant, commonly Ākanādi, (Cissampelos hexandra, Rox.) E. विद्ध pierced, and कर्ण the ear; also in the latter sense, with कन् added विद्धकर्णिका; also अविद्धकर्ण, &c.
विद्यमान: विद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Being present or in existence. 	 2. Actual, real, in possession, (as property.)  E. विद् to be, 4th cl. and शानच् aff.
विद्या: विद्या f. (-द्या) 	 1. Knowledge, learning, science, whether sacred or profane, though more especially the former: it is sometimes classed into fourteen divisions; viz:--the four Vedas; the six Angas, or gram-mar, astronomy, &c.; the Purāṇas as the eleventh class; and the Mimānsā or theology, Nyāya or logic, and Dharma or law, as the remaining three. 	 2. The goddess DURGĀ. 	 3. A tree, (Premna spinosa.) 	 4. A magical pill or bolus, by putting which into the mouth a person has the power of ascending to heaven. 	 5. Spell, incantation.  E. विद् to know, aff. क्यप् ।
विद्याकर: विद्याकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Giving wisdom or science. 	 m. (-रः) A learned man.  E. विद्या, कर what makes, or आकर a mine: see विद्याधर ।
विद्यागम: विद्यागम m. (-मः) Acquirement of knowledge.  E. विद्या, आगम coming.
विद्याचण: विद्याचण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Famous for learning or knowledge.  E. विद्या knowledge, and चणप् aff. in this particular meaning; also विद्याचन ।
विद्याचुञ्चु: विद्याचुञ्चु mfn. (-ञ्चुः-ञ्चुः-ञ्चु) Famous for knowledge.  E. विद्या knowledge, and चुञ्चुप् aff. implying celebrity.
विद्यादल: विद्यादल m. (-लः) The Bhurja-patra tree.  E. विद्या, दल a leaf: being used for writing on.
विद्यादान: विद्यादान n. (-नं) Giving knowledge or science.  E. विद्या, दान giving.
विद्यादेवी: विद्यादेवी f. (-वी) A female divinity, one of a class of sixteen peculiar apparently to the mythological system of the Jainas.  E. विद्या science, देवी a goddess; a goddess of learning or science, a muse.
विद्याधन: विद्याधन n. (-नं) Property acquired by science, as by instruction, &c. E. विद्या knowledge, and धन wealth.
विद्याधर: विद्याधर m. (-रः) A demigod of a particular order or class, a spirit of the air.  E. विद्या a magical pill, as above, and धर who has or holds.
विद्यानुपालन: विद्यानुपालन n. (-नं) 	 1. Patronising learning. 	 2. Studying, acquiring learning.  E. विद्या and अनुपालन encouraging.
विद्यानुपालिन्: विद्यानुपालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Studied, acquiring or having acquired learning.  E. विद्या and अनुपालिन् who prosecutes.
विद्यानुसेवन: विद्यानुसेवन n. (-नं) Cultivating science or learning.  E. विद्या, अनुसेवन pursuing.
विद्यानुसेविन्: विद्यानुसेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Cultivating learning, engaged in study. E. विद्या and अनुसेविन् addicted to.
विद्याप्राप्ति: विद्याप्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 	 1. Acquirement of knowledge. 	 2. Acquisition made by or through learning.  E. विद्या and प्राप्ति gain.
विद्याभ्यास: विद्याभ्यास m. (-सः) Study, diligent application.  E. विद्या, अभ्यास exercise.
विद्यार्जन: विद्यार्ज्जन n. (-नं) 	 1. Acquiring knowledge. 	 2. Acquiring anything by knowledge, as by teaching, &c.  E. विद्या, अर्ज्जन gaining.
विद्यार्ज्जन: विद्यार्ज्जन n. (-नं) 	 1. Acquiring knowledge. 	 2. Acquiring anything by knowledge, as by teaching, &c.  E. विद्या, अर्ज्जन gaining.
विद्यार्जित: विद्यार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained by or through knowledge.  E. विद्या, अर्ज्जित obtained.
विद्यार्ज्जित: विद्यार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained by or through knowledge.  E. विद्या, अर्ज्जित obtained.
विद्यार्थ: विद्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) Seeking for knowledge.  E. विद्या and अर्थ object.
विद्यार्थिन्: विद्यार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Seeking for knowledge. 	 m. (-र्थी) A pupil, a student.  E. विद्यार्थ and इनि aff.
विद्यालब्ध: विद्यालब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Gained by or through learning.  E. विद्या, लब्ध gained.
विद्यालय: विद्यालय m. (-यः) A school, a college.  E. विद्या and आलय a house.
विद्यालाभ: विद्यालाभ m. (-भः) 	 1. Acquisition of learning. 	 2. Acquirement by or through learning.  E. विद्या and लाभ gain.
विद्यावत्: विद्यावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Learned, possessed of learning or science. E. विद्या learning, and मतुप् poss. aff.
विद्याविशिष्ट: विद्याविशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Possessed of learning or science.  E. विद्या, विशिष्ट endowed with.
विद्याविहीन: विद्याविहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ignorant, uninstructed.  E. विद्या, विहीन deprived of.
विद्याव्रतस्नातक: विद्याव्रतस्नातक m. (-कः) The Brāhmana who has finished his studies and period of studentship.  E. विद्या, व्रत a religious obligation, स्नातक a householder.
विद्यास्नातक: विद्यास्नातक m. (-कः) The student who has finished his religious studies.  E. विद्या, स्नातक a householder.
विद्याहीन: विद्याहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ignorant, uninstructed.  E. विद्या, हीन void of.
विद्युत्: विद्युत् f. (-द्युत्) 	 1. Lightning. 	 2. A thunderbolt.  E. वि intensitive or privative, and द्युत light, lustre, aff. क्विप् ।
विद्युत्प्रिय: विद्युत्प्रिय n. (-यं) Bell-metal.  E. विद्युत् lightning, and प्रिय beloved.
विद्युत्वत्: विद्युत्वत् mfn. (-त्वन्-त्वती-त्वत्) Having or containing lightning, electri-cal, (a cloud, &c.)  E. विद्युत् lightning and मतुप् aff.
विद्युलता: विद्युलता f. (-ता) Zigzag lightning.  E. विद्युत् and लता a creeper.
विद्योतमान: विद्योतमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining, blazing.  E. वि before, द्युत् to shine, शानच् aff.
विद्योपार्जन: विद्योपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquisition of knowledge.  E. विद्या, उपार्ज्जन collecting.
विद्योपार्ज्जन: विद्योपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquisition of knowledge.  E. विद्या, उपार्ज्जन collecting.
विद्योपार्जित: विद्योपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquired by or through learning, &c. E. विद्या and उपार्ज्जित obtained.
विद्योपार्ज्जित: विद्योपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquired by or through learning, &c. E. विद्या and उपार्ज्जित obtained.
विद्र: विद्र n. (-द्रं) 	 1. A hole, a chasm. 	 2. Piercing, perforating.  E. विध् to pierce, aff., रक् form irr.; or वि before, द्रा to sleep, aff. क ।
विद्रधि: विद्रधि m. (-धिः) Phlegmonoid inflammation; especially deep-seated, or internal abscess.  E. विद्र piercing, धा to have, कि aff.
विद्रधिनाशन: विद्रधिनाशन m. (-नः) A tree, (Hyperanthera Morunga.)  E. विद्रधि bile or abscess, नाशन destroying, discussing.
विद्रव: विद्रव m. (-वः) 	 1. Flight, escape, retreat. 	 2. Fear, agitation, panic. 	 3. Intellect, understanding. 	 4. Censure, abuse, reproach. 	 5. Lique-faction. 	 6. Flowing out, oozing.  E. वि before, द्रु to fly, aff. अप् ।
विद्राव: विद्राव m. (-वः) 	 1. Flight, retreat, running away. 	 2. Liquefaction.  E. वि before, द्रु to go, causal v., aff. घञ् ।
विद्रावक: विद्रावक mfn. (-कः-विका-कं) 	 1. Liquefying, causing to flow or melt. 	 2. Driving away.  E. वि before, द्रु to flow, &c., causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
विद्रावण: विद्रावण n. (-णं) 	 1. Causing to flow or melt, fusing. 	 2. Driving away, chasing, defeating.  E. वि before, द्रु to run, &c., causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विद्रावित: विद्रावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Liquefied, fused. 	 2. Driven away, put to flight.  E. वि before, द्रु to flow, &c., causal v., क्त aff.
विद्रुत: विद्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Liquid, liquefied, fluid as an oily or metallic substance upon being heated. 	 2. Flown, fled. 	 3. Running, going fast. 	 4. Agitated, alarmed.  E. वि before, द्रु to ooze, &c., aff. क्त ।
विद्रुम: विद्रुम m. (-मः) 	 1. Coral. 	 2. A tree bearing precious gems. 	 3. A young sprout or shoot.  E. वि implying species, द्रुम a tree.
विद्रुमलता: विद्रुमलता f. (-ता) A sort of vegetable perfume.  E. विद्रुम coral, लता a creeper.
विद्वत्कल्प: विद्वत्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Less learned, a little learned.  E. विद्वस् learned and कल्पप् aff. of diminution or inferiority; also with the similar affs. देशीयर् and देश्य, विद्वद्देशीय and विद्वद्देश्य ।
विद्वस्: विद्वस् mfn. (-द्वान्-दुषी-द्वत्) 	 1. Intelligent, wise. 	 2. Learned. 	 m. (-द्वान्) A sage, a seer, one who knows the true nature of the soul and of GOD.  E. विद् to know, क्वसु aff. in lieu of शतृ, the usual affix of the present participle.
विद्विष्: विद्विष् mfn. (-द्विट्) An enemy.  E. वि before, द्विष् to hate, क्विप् aff.
विद्विष: विद्विष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Hating, adverse, inimical. 	 m. (-षः) An enemy. E. वि before, द्विष् to hate, aff. क ।
विद्विष्ट: विद्विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Hated, disliked.  E. वि before, द्विष् to hate, क्त aff.
विद्वेष: विद्वेष m. (-षः) Enmity, hatred.  E. वि before, द्विष् to hate, aff. घञ् ।
विद्वेषण: विद्वेषण m. (-णः) A hater. 	 n. (-णं) Causing hatred or enmity. E. वि + द्विष्-ल्युट् aff.
विद्वेषणी: विद्वेषणी f. (-णी) A woman of a resentful temperament.
विद्वेषिन्: विद्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Inimical, hostile, hating. 	 m. (-षी) An enemy. E. विद्वेष enmity, इनि aff.
विद्वेष्टृ: विद्वेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who or what hates, adverse, inimical.  E. विद्विष् to hate, तृच् aff.
विध्: विध् r. 6th cl. (विधति) 	 1. To administer, to govern, to rule or command. 2. To pierce, to perforate. 	 3. To divide. 	 4. To honour or worship.
विध: विध mf. (-धः-धा) 	 1. Form, formula, rule. 	 2. Manner, kind, sort. 	 3. Fodder, the food of horses, elephants, &c. 	 4. Prosperity, thriving. 5. Hire, wages. 	 6. Act, action. 	 7. Piercing.  E. वि before, धा to have, aff. क or अङ्, and fem. aff. टाप्; or विध् to rule, &c., aff. क or अच्; the masculine form, though it does occur, is not common, except in composition, when the word is used attributively, as द्विविध of two sorts. 	 mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) &c.
विधवन: विधवन n. (-नं) Shaking, trembling.  E. वि before, धू to shake, aff. ल्युट् ।
विधवा: विधवा f. (-वा) A widow.  E. वि privative, धव a husband.
विधवागामिन्: विधवागामिन् m. (-मी) One who has intercourse with a widow.  E. विधवा and गामिन् who approaches, (carnally.)
विधवावेदन: विधवावेदन n. (-नं) Marrying a widow.  E. विधवा, आवेदन marrying.
विधव्य: विधव्य n. (-व्यं) Trembling, tremor.  E. वि before, धू to shake, aff. यत् ।
विधस्: विधस् m. (-धाः) BRAHMĀ.  E. वि severally or every kind, धा to have, Unādi aff. असुन्, and the radical vowel dropped.
विधातव्य: विधातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be done or performed. 	 2. To be done according to rule, to be observed as a rite or ceremony. 	 3. To be ruled or regulated.  E. वि before, धा to have, तव्य aff.
विधातृ: विधातृ m. (-ता) 	 1. BRAHMĀ. 	 2. Love or KĀMA. 	 3. Fate.  E. वि severally, धा to have or contain, (all things,) aff. तृच् ।
विधातृभू: विधातृभू m. (-भूः) NĀRADA, the Muni and son of BRAHMĀ.  E. विधातृ BRAHMĀ, भू offspring, क्विप् aff.
विधात्री: विधात्री f. (-त्री) Long-pepper.  E. वि before, धा to have, तृच् aff., fem. aff. ङीष् ।
विधान: विधान n. (-नं) 	 1. Act, action, general or particular, though more especially the performance of such acts or rites as are prescribed in the sacred books of the Hindus. 	 2. Rule, precept, ordinance, injunction. 	 3. An elephant's fodder. 	 4. Form, mode, manner. 	 5. Sending, ordering. 	 6. Means, expedient. 	 7. Wealth. 	 8. Wor-ship. 	 9. Active enmity or act of hostility. 	 10. Gaining, getting, taking. 	 11. Conflict or contrast of opposite feelings. 	 12. (In gram-mar.) Affixing, prefixing, taking as an affix, &c. 	 13. Pain, sorrow, distress. 	 14. Arranging, disposing. 	 15. Creating, forming. 	 16. Doing, performing, using. 	 17. Enjoying, prescribing.  E. वि before, धा to have, aff. ल्युट् ।
विधानक: विधानक n. (-कं) Pain.  E. वि before, धा to have, ल्युट् aff. कन् added.
विधानग: विधानग m. (-गः) A Paṇḍit, a wise or learned man or teacher.  E. विधान action, the performance of those acts prescribed by the Shāśtras, and ग who goes or performs.
विधानज्ञ: विधानज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A Paṇḍit, &c.: see the last.  E. विधान, ज्ञ who knows.
विधाय: विधाय Ind. Having taken, assumed, put on, placed, &c.  E. वि before, धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
विधायक: विधायक mfn. (-कः-यिका-कं) Consigning, delivering, one who entrusts or deposits anything, or causes it to be fixed or secure. 	 2. Arrang-ing, disposing. 	 3. Doing, performing. 	 4. Enjoining.  E. वि before, धा to have, (causal form,) aff. ण्वुल् ।
विधायकत्व: विधायकत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Consignment or delivery of anything, making anything firm or secure.  E. त्व added to the last.
विधायिन्: विधायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 	 1. Causing, occasioning, making. 	 2. Pla-cing, fixing, securing. 	 3. Delivering, entrusting. 	 4. Establishing as a rule or law.  E. वि before, धा to have, causal form, aff. घिनुण् ।
विधाव्य: विधाव्य n. (-व्यं) Shaking, agitation.  E. वि before, धू to shake, ण्यत् aff.
विधास्यत्: विधास्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) 	 1. Purposing or willing to do, make, cause, &c. 	 2. Intending to direct, enjoin, prescribe, &c. वि before, धा to have, शतृ aff., in the future tense.
विधि: विधि m. (-धिः) 	 1. A sacred precept, an act or rite prescribed by the Vedas, for effecting certain consequences. 	 2. Rule, form, formula. 3. Fate, luck, destiny. 	 4. BRAHMĀ. 	 5. Time. 	 6. Order, injunction, command. 	 7. A name of VISHṆU. 	 8. Act, action, general or parti-cular. 	 9. A text, a sentence in some authority of law or religion, prescribing any particular act or observance. 	 10. Kind, sort, manner. 	 11. Fodder, food for elephants or horses. 	 12. A sacred work, a Shāśtra, scripture, the law, (by metonymy.) 	 13. Creation. 14. A physician.  E. वि before, घा to have; or विध् to rule, aff. कि ।
विधिघ्न: विधिघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Who or what deviates from, disregards, or dis-turbs rules or modes of proceeding.  E. विधि, घ्न what destroys.
विधिज्ञ: विधिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Who or what knows the prescribed mode, form, &c. 	 m. (-ज्ञः) A Brāhmana who knows the ritual.  E. विधि and ज्ञ who knows.
विधितस्: विधितस् Ind. According to rule.  E. विधि and तसि aff.
विधित्सा: विधित्सा f. (-त्सा) Wish to do or make, design, purpose, desire.  E. वि before, धा to have, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
विधित्सु: विधित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सु-त्सु) Wishing to make, produce, &c.  E. वि before, धा to have, desid. v., उ aff.
विधिदर्शिन्: विधिदर्शिन् m. (-र्शी) A priest whose business at a sacrifice is to see that every thing is done according to the prescribed rules, and to correct any deviation from them.  E. विधि a sacred precept, and दर्शिन् who sees; also विधिदर्शक, &c.
