विपाण्डुर: विपाण्डुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Pale, pallid, white.  E. वि पाण्डुर pale.
विपादन: विपादन n. (-नं) Destroying, killing.  E. वि before, पद् to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विपादनीय: विपादनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be killed, fit or proper to be destroyed. E. वि before, पद् to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also विपाद्य and विपादयितव्य ।
विपादिका: विपादिका f. (-का) 	 1. A kibe, a sore or blister on the foot. 	 2. A riddle, an enigma.  E. वि before, पद् to go, aff. ण्वुल् ।
विपादित: विपादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Killed, destroyed.  E. वि before, पद् to go, causal v., क्त aff.
विपाल: विपाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Unattended, unguarded.  E. वि priv., पल a keeper.
विपाश्: विपाश् f. (-पाट्) The Vipās or Vipāsā river. E. See the next.
विपाश: विपाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Unnoosed, unfettered, freed from a noose or tie. 	 f. (-शा) 	 1. The Vipāsā or the Beyāh river in the Punjāb. E. वि privative, and पाश or पाशा a noose, from पश् to bind, causal form, with अच् and टाप् or क्विप् aff.; hence also विपाश्; the name applies to the river as having destroyed the cord which the Muni VAAISHṬHA had tied round his neck, when about to hang himself through grief for the death of his sons slain by VISWĀMITRA.
विपिन: विपिन n. (-नं) A wood, a forest.  E. वेप् to shake, Unādi aff. इनन्.
विपुल: विपुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Large, great. 	 2. Broad. 	 3. Deep, profound. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. The mountain MERU, or rather the western branch of it. 2. The Himālaya mountain. 	 3. A respectable man. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. The earth. 	 2. A form of the Āryā metre in which the line is irregular-ly divided by the Cæsura or pause: three species of this form are reckoned; the Ādi-vipulā with the pause in the first line, Antya-vipulā in the second, and Ubhaya-vipulā in both lines.  E. वि be-fore, पुल् to be large or lofty, aff. क ।
विपुलक: विपुलक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Free from horripilation.  E. वि privative and पुलक erection of the hair of the body.
विपुलजघना: विपुलजघना f. (-ना) A woman with large hips.
विपुलता: विपुलता f. (-ता) Magnitude, extent.  E. विपुल and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विपुलत्वं ।
विपुलमति: विपुलमति Adj. Endowed with great power of understanding.
विपुलरस: विपुलरस m. (-सः) The sugar-cane.  E. विपुल much, and रस juice.
विपुलेक्षण: विपुलेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Large-eyed.  E. विपुल and ईक्षण sight.
विपूय: विपूय m. (-यः) The Munja grass, (Saccharum Munja.)  E. वि before, पुञ् to cleanse, aff. क्यप्; that which is to be cleaned before making into ropes, &c.
विप्र: विप्र m. (-प्रः) 	 1. A Brāhman. 	 2. The Aśwattha tree. 	 3. (In prosody,) A foot of four short syllables.  E. वि before, प्रा a Sautra root, to fill or complete, (the essential observances,) and क aff.; or वप् to shave, Unādi aff. रन्, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
विप्रकर्ष: विप्रकर्ष m. (-र्षः) Distance.  E. वि + प्र, कृष् to attract, घञ् aff.
विप्रकार: विप्रकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Injury, contumely, abuse. 	 2. Wickedness. 	 3. Oppo-sition, counteraction. 	 4. Retaliation.  E. वि and प्र depreciative pre-fixes, and कार making.
विप्रकारिन्: विप्रकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Opposed to, treating with contempt. 	 2. Retaliating.  E. वि and प्र, before कृ to do, णिनि aff.
विप्रकीर्ण: विप्रकीर्ण f. (-र्णा) Adj. 	 1. Scattered, dispersed. 	 2. Loose, dishevelled. 3. Broad, expanded.
विप्रकृत: विप्रकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Reviled, abused, treated with contempt. 	 2. Opposed, counteracted. 	 3. Injured, offended. 	 4. Retaliated, requit-ed.  E. वि and प्र, before कृत made; made little or nothing of.
विप्रकृति: विप्रकृति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Abuse, injury, contumely. 	 2. Retaliation, retort. E. वि and प्र implying depreciation or mutuality, and कृति action.
विप्रकृष्ट: विप्रकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Remote, distant. 	 f. (-ष्टा) 	 1. Drawn away, removed. 	 2. Protracted, lengthened.  E. वि and प्र, before कृष् to attract, aff. क्त; also with कन् added, विप्रकृष्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) ।
विप्रतिकार: विप्रतिकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Contradiction, counteraction, opposition. 	 2. Reverse. 	 3. Retaliation.  E. वि and प्रति, before कृ to do, घञ् aff.
विप्रतिकृत: विप्रतिकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Opposed, counteracted. 	 2. Requited.  E. वि and प्रति, before कृ to do, क्त aff.
विप्रतिपत्ति: विप्रतिपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Perplexity, confusion. 	 2. Various acquirement. 	 3. Mutual connexion with or relation to. 	 4. Conversancy. 	 5. Con-tradiction, difference, discrepancy. 	 6. Contest, dispute. 	 7. Oppo-sition of interests.  E. वि privative, or implying variety, and प्रति-पत्ति knowledge.
विप्रतिपद्य: विप्रतिपद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 	 1. To be opposed, contradicted, contested. 2. To be acquired.  E. वि and प्रति, before पद् to go, यत् aff.
विप्रतिपद्यमान: विप्रतिपद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Being disputed or contested. 	 2. Being in course of acquirement.  E. वि and प्रति, before पद् to go, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विप्रतिपन्न: विप्रतिपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Bewildered, perplexed, confused, uncer-tain. 	 2. Conversant or acquainted with in various ways, severally or mutually. 	 3. Connected with. 	 4. Contested, disputed. 	 5. Con-tradicted. 	 6. Opposed, (as interests.)  E. वि and प्रतिपन्न ascertained.
विप्रतिषेध: विप्रतिषेध m. (-धः) 	 1. The conflict of two courses of equal importance. 2. The conflict of two rules by which two different operations can be undertaken, (in gram.)
विप्रतिसिद्ध: विप्रतिसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Contradicted, opposed. 	 3. Prohibited, for-bidden.  E. वि and प्रति implying opposition, सिद्ध proved, perfected.
विप्रतीसार: विप्रतीसार m. (-रः) 	 1. Repentance. 	 2. Evil, wickedness, evil action. 	 3. Hate, enmity. 	 4. Rage, wrath.  E. वि implying reverse, प्रति to or towards, सृ to go, घञ् aff.; the इ of प्रति optionally long; otherwise विप्रतिसार ।
विप्रदह: विप्रदह m. (-हः) Dried fruit or roots, &c.
विप्रदुष्ट: विप्रदुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Spoiled, vitiated, defiled. 	 2. Bad corrupt. E. वि and प्र, before दुष्ट the same.
विप्रदुष्टभाव: विप्रदुष्टभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Bad, vicious, sensual, corrupt.  E. विप्रदुष्ट and भाव disposition or nature.
विप्रमुक्त: विप्रमुक्त f. (-क्ता) 	 1. Set free, liberated. 	 2. Shot, discharged.
विप्रमोच्य: विप्रमोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be liberated or freed from.  E. वि and प्र, before मुच् to loose, यत् aff.
विप्रयाण: विप्रयाण n. (-णं) Flight, retreat.  E. वि and प्र, before या to go, aff. ल्युट् ।
विप्रयुक्त: विप्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Separated, disjoined, sundered, away or absent from. 	 2. Released from. 	 3. Deprived of.  E. वि implying separation, प्रयुक्त joined.
विप्रयोग: विप्रयोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Separation, absence, especially the separation of lovers. 	 2. Disunion, disjunction. 	 3. Quarrel, disagreement. 	 4. De-serving.  E. वि before, प्रयोग union, contiguity.
विप्रलब्ध: विप्रलब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 	 1. Tricked, cheated, deceived. 	 2. Disappoint-ed. 	 f. (-ब्धी) A mistress whose lover is not true to his appointment, (considered as a character in drama.)  E. वि and प्र, before लब्ध gained.
विप्रलम्भ: विप्रलम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. Tricking, deceiving, disappointing, deceiving by a false affirmation or by not keeping a promise. 	 2. Separation, es-pecially of lovers. 	 3. Disunion, disjunction. 	 4. Quarrel, disagree-ment. 	 5. The sentiment of love in separation, (opposite to सम्भोग.) E. वि and प्र implying reverse, लभि to get or gain, aff. घञ् ।
विप्रलाप: विप्रलाप m. (-पः) 	 1. Quarrel, wrangling, mutual contradiction. 	 2. Idle or unmeaning discourse, nonsense. 	 3. Infraction of a promise. E. वि and प्र implying contradiction or reciprocity, and लाप talk.
विप्रलुप्त: विप्रलुप्त f. (-प्ता) 	 1. Snatched away. 	 2. Disturbed, interrupted.
विप्रलुम्पक: विप्रलुम्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Rapacious, exacting, avaricious.  E. वि and प्र, before लुपि to cut, ण्वुल् aff.
विप्रवास: विप्रवास m. (-सः) Residence in a foreign country.  E. वि and प्र implying separation, वस् to abide, and घञ् aff.
विप्रवासन: विप्रवासन n. (-नं) 	 1. Residence abroad. 	 2. Banishment.  E. वि and प्र, before वस् to dwell, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विप्रश्निका: विप्रश्निका f. (-का) A female fortune-teller.  E. वि variously, पृच् to ask, aff. इञ्, with नङ् augment, and ठन् added.
विप्रसात्: विप्रसात् Ind. As, like as, one with, a Brāhmaṇa.  E. विप्र, and साति aff.
विप्रस्व: विप्रस्व n. (-स्वं) The property of a Brāhmaṇa.  E. विप्र, and स्व own.
विप्रहीण: विप्रहीण f. (-णा) Deprived of, destitute of.
विप्रापवाद: विप्रापवाद m. (-दः) Abuse of a Brāhmaṇa.  E. विप्र, and अपवाद reviling.
विप्रिय: विप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Disliked, unbeloved, disagreeable. 	 n. (-यं) Offence, transgression.  E. वि privative, and प्रिय fond of.
विप्रुष्: विप्रुष् f. (-प्रुट्) 	 1. A drop of water, &c. 	 2. A spot, a mark, a dot.  E. वि privative, प्रुष् to burn, aff. क्विप्; also विप्लुष् ।
विप्रोषित: विप्रोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Absent, away from. 	 2. Banished.  E. वि and प्र, before वस् to dwell, aff. क्त, the semi-vowel changed to उ ।
विप्रोषितभर्तृका: विप्रोषितभर्त्तृका f. (-का) A woman whose husband or lover is absent. E. विप्रोषित absent, भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् aff.
विप्रोषितभर्त्तृका: विप्रोषितभर्त्तृका f. (-का) A woman whose husband or lover is absent. E. विप्रोषित absent, भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् aff.
विप्रोष्य: विप्रोष्य Ind. Having been absent, returning, coming home.  E. वि and प्र, before वस् to dwell, ल्यप् aff.
विप्लव: विप्लव m. (-वः) 	 1. Tumult, confusion, trouble. 	 2. Evil, calamity. 	 3. Ra-pine, extortion. 	 4. Sin, wickedness. 	 5. Predatory or irregular warfare. 	 6. Affray, scuffle. 	 7. Terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures. 	 8. Confusion, perplexity, (of thought or speech.) 	 9. Floating about. 	 10. The rust, (of a mirror.) 	 11. Loss, destruction. E. वि before, प्लु to go, aff. अप् ।
विप्लाव: विप्लाव m. (-वः) 	 1. Deluging, inundating. 	 2. Devastating. 	 3. Causing tumult or public disturbance. 	 4. A horse's canter or gallop.  E. वि, and प्लु to go, aff. घञ् ।
विप्लाव्य: विप्लाव्य Ind. 	 1. Having cast away, defiled, contaminated. 	 2. Having taught at improper seasons. 	 3. Having caused to be deluged, devastated, &c.  E. वि before, प्लु to go, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
विप्लुत: विप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Depraved, wicked, addicted to evil practices, as gaming, whoring, &c. 	 2. Committing any crime. 	 3. Contrary, adverse, averse. 	 4. Inundated, immersed. 	 5. Devastated, ravaged. 6. Disturbed, confounded. 	 7. Ruined, disgraced. 	 8. Disappeared. 9. Disfigured, obscured.  E. वि before, प्लु to go, aff. क्त ।
विप्लुष्: विप्लुष् f. (प्लुट्) 	 1. A drop of any fluid. 	 2. A spot, a dot.  E. वि before, प्लुष् to burn, aff. क्विप्; also विप्रुष् ।
विप्सा: विप्सा f. (-प्सा) Repetition, succession: see वीप्सा ।
विफल: विफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Vain, idle, unmeaning, fruitless, useless.  E. वि privative, and फल fruit.
विफलता: विफलता f. (-ता) Unprofitableness, fruitlessness.  E. विफल, and तल् added; also विफलत्वं ।
विफलीकरण: विफलीकरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Frustrating, foiling, defeating. 	 2. Doing any thing in vain.  E. विफल, and करण making, च्वि augment.
विफलीकृत: विफलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Rendered vain, frustrated. 	 2. Done in vain. E. विफल, and कृत done, च्वि augment.
विफलीभविष्णु: विफलीभविष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Become unprofitable.  E. विफल, and भविष्णु become, च्वि augment.
विफलीभविष्णुता: विफलीभविष्णुता f. (-ता) Unprofitableness.  E. तल् added to the last; also विफलीभविष्णुत्वं ।
विफलीभूत: विफलीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become useless.  E. विफल and भूत become, च्वि augment.
विबन्ध: विबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Ischury or constipation.  E. वि before, बन्ध् to bind, aff. अच् ।
विबाधा: विबाधा f. (-धा) Pain, agony, anguish.  E. वि various, बाधा pain.
विबुद्ध: विबुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Awake, aroused. 	 2. Unconscious. 	 3. Blossomed, expanded. 	 4. Clever, skilful.  E. वि, and बुद्ध wakened.
विबुध: विबुध m. (-धः) 	 1. A god, an immortal. 	 2. A Paṇḍit, a learned man, a teacher. 	 3. The moon.  E. वि variously, बुध् to know, aff. क ।
विबोध: विबोध m. (-धः) 	 1. Inattention, absence. 	 2. Intelligence. 	 3. Awaking. 	 4. Discovering any circumstance. 	 5. Becoming conscious, (considered as one of the thirty-three subordinate feelings in rhetoric.)  E. वि privative or intensitive, and बोध understanding.
विबोधित: विबोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Awakened. 	 2. Instructed.  E. वि before, बुध् to know, causal v., क्त aff.
विभक्त: विभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Divided, portioned, partitioned. 	 2. Separa-ted, parted. 	 3. Dividing, sharing, a partner. 	 4. Distinct. 	 5. Dif-ferent, multifarious. 	 6. Retired, isolated. 	 7. Symmetrical. 	 8. Orna-mental.  E. वि severally, भज् to divide, aff. क्त ।
विभक्तज: विभक्तज m. (-जः) A son born after partition of the family property be-tween his parents and brethren.  E. विभक्त divided, (being or having been,) and ज born.
विभक्ति: विभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Part, portion, inheritance or share of inheritance, &c. 	 2. A division, a partition. 	 3. Inflexion of nouns, declension. E. वि before, भज to divide, aff. क्तिन् ।
विभङ्ग: विभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. Breaking, fracture. 	 2. Division. 	 3. Bending, con-tracting, (especially of the eye-brows.) 	 4. Expression or play of features. 	 5. Obstruction, stoppage.  E. वि, भजि to break, aff. घञ् ।
विभजनीय: विभजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be portioned or partitioned.  E. वि before, भज् to divide, अनीयर् aff.
विभज्य: विभज्य Ind. Having divided, portioned, &c.  E. वि before, भज् to divide, ल्यप् aff.
विभज्यमान: विभज्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Divisible, portionable, to be or being divided or parted.  E. वि before, भज् to divide, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विभव: विभव m. (-वः) 	 1. Substance, thing, property, wealth. 	 2. Emancipation from existence. 	 3. Supreme or superhuman power. 	 4. Magnani-mity, lofty-mindedness.  E. वि implying variety, privation, &c., and भव being.
विभा: विभा f. (-भा) 	 1. A ray of light. 	 2. Light, lustre. 	 3. Beauty.  E. वि va-riously, भा to shine, aff. अच् ।
विभाकर: विभाकर m. (-रः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. Fire.  E. विभा light, and कर who makes.
विभाग: विभाग m. (-गः) 	 1. Part, portion, share. 	 2. The share or portion of an inheritance. 	 3. Partition of inheritance. 	 4. (In arithmetic.) The numerator of a fraction. 	 5. Separation, disjunction, (considered as a Guṇa in Nyāya Phil.  E. वि implying variously, भाग a portion.
विभागकल्पना: विभागकल्पना f. (-ना) Apportioning or allotment of shares or portions. E. विभाग a division, and कल्पना a making.
विभागतस्: विभागतस् Ind. Proportionately, according to a part or share.  E. विभाग, and तसि aff.
विभागधर्म: विभागधर्म m. (-र्मः) The law of inheritance.
विभागपत्रिका: विभागपत्रिका f. (-का) A deed of partition.
विभागभाक्: विभागभाक् m. (-भाक्) One who shares in a portion of property already distributed, applied especially to a son by a father and mother of the same tribe, born subsequent to a distribution of property amongst his parents and brethren, in which case he inherits the portion allotted or reserved to the parents.  E. विभाग a portion, and भाक् who shares.
विभागशस्: विभागशस् Ind. Proportionately, according to a part or share.  E. विभाग, and शसि aff.
विभाज्य: विभाज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Divisible, portionable, what may be divided or apportioned.  E. वि severally, भज् to divide, ण्यत् aff.
विभात्: विभात् mfn. (-भान्-भान्ती or भाती-भात्) Shining, splendid.  E. वि before, भा to shine, शतृ aff.
विभात: विभात n. (-तं) Dawn, day-break.  E. वि before, भा to shine, aff. क्त; also विभातक n. (-कं) ।
विभाव: विभाव m. (-वः) 	 1. A friend or acquaintance. 	 2. One of the Bhāyas or classes of properties into which the objects of poetical composi-tion are divided; the causative or exciting property, as dress, perfumes, &c. of amorous desire; extravagant gesture of mirth; distress or pain of tenderness; arms and tumult of wrath or heroism, &c.  E. वि various, and भाव property, disposition.
विभावक: विभावक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Discussing, shewing, illustrating.  E. वि before, भू to think, ण्वुल् aff.
विभावन: विभावन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Discussion, examination, discrimination. 	 2. Per-ceiving, seeing, distinguishing. 	 3. Conceiving, imagination. 	 4. Ascertaining or judging of facts. 	 5. Describing effects not arising. from the usual causes, (in rhetoric.)  E. वि before, भू in the 10th cl. to think, &c., aff. युच् ।
विभावनीय: विभावनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Distinguishable, ascertainable, to be judged or determined.  E. वि and भू to think, अनीयर् aff.
विभावरी: विभावरी f. (-री) 	 1. Night. 	 2. Turmeric. 	 3. A bawd. 	 4. A harlot. 	 5. The shreds of a garment torn in a scuffle.  E. वि before, भा to shine, (with stars,) क्वनिप् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्, and रच् substituted for the final; also विभाव amorous excitement, रच् aff.
विभावस्: विभावस् m. (-वान्) The sun.  E. विभा and क्वसु aff.
विभावसु: विभावसु m. (-सुः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. Fire. 	 3. The moon. 	 4. A sort of neck-lace or garland.  E. विभा light, वसु being, substance.
विभावित: विभावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Seen, perceived, marked. 	 2. Judged, discri-minated. 	 3. Conceived, imagined. 	 4. Known, understood. 	 5. Proved, established.  E. वि before, भू in the 10th cl. to know or perceive, aff. क्त ।
विभावितत्व: विभावितत्व n. (-त्वं) The state of being perceived or judged.  E. त्व added to the last.
विभाव्य: विभाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be seen or observed, remarkable, distin-guishable. 	 2. To be conceived or imagined.  E. वि before, भू to be, ण्यत् aff.
विभाषा: विभाषा f. or Ind. (-षा) Alternative, either of two ways.  E. वि alternative, and भाषा speech.
विभासा: विभासा f. (-सा) Light, shining.  E. वि before, भास् to be luminous, अङ् and टाप् affs.
विभासित: विभासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lighted, shining.  E. वि, भास् to shine, क्त aff.
विभित्सु: विभित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing or purposing to hit or pierce.  E. वि before भिद् to break, desid. v., उ aff.
विभिद्यमान: विभिद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Being wounded, pierced, broken. 	 2. Being divided or scattered.  E. वि before भिद् to break, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विभिन्न: विभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Pierced, wounded. 	 2. Broken. 	 3. Scattered, dispersed. 	 4. Mixed, intermixed, mingling. 	 5. Various, different. 6. Disappointed. 	 7. Bewildered, perplexed.  E. वि before भिद् to break, &c., क्त aff.
विभिन्नता: विभिन्नता f. (-ता) The state of being broken, scattered, &c.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विभिन्नत्वं ।
विभीत: विभीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fearless.  E. वि priv., भीत afraid.
विभीतक: विभीतक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) E. विभीत fearless, कन् aff. “वहेडा इति भाषा ।”
विभीषण: विभीषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Fearful, formidable, terrific, horrible. 	 nf. (-णं-णा) The property of exciting fear. 	 m. (-णः) The brother of RĀVANA.  E. वि, भी to fear, युच् aff. षुक् augment.
विभीषिका: विभीषिका f. (-का) 	 1. Terror. 	 2. A means of terrifying.  E. वि + भी-णिच्-सुक्-ण्वुल् ।
विभु: विभु mfn. (-भुः-भुः or भ्वी-भु) 	 1. Omnipresent, all-pervading. 	 2. Always, eternal. 	 3. Firm, solid, hard. 	 4. Powerful. 	 m. (-भुः) 	 1. A master, an owner. 	 2. ŚIVA. 	 3. BRAHMĀ. 	 4. VISHṆU. 	 5. A servant. 	 6. Æther. 	 7. Space. 	 8. Time. 	 9. The soul.  E. वि before भू to be, aff. डु ।
विभुग्न: विभुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Bent, bowed, crooked.  E. वि before भुज् to bend, क्त aff.
विभुता: विभुता f. (-ता) Power, supremacy.  E. विभु, तल् aff. also with त्व, विभुत्वं ।
विभूति: विभूति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Superhuman power, consisting of eight faculties especially attributed to ŚIVA, and supposed to be attainable by human beings, through a course of austere worship, attended with magical rites, in honor of that deity and his spouse DURGĀ: the eight properties thus supposed to be assumable at will are:-अणिमा extreme minuteness or invisibility; लघिमा extreme light-ness or incorporeality; प्राप्ति attaining or reaching any thing, as illustrated by the power of touching the moon with the tip of the finger; प्राकाम्यं the fulfilment of every wish; महिमा illimitable bulk; ईशिता supreme dominion over animate or inanimate na-ture; वशिता the power of enchanting or changing the course of nature, and कामावशायिता the accomplishment of every promise or engagement. 	 2. Power, dignity, dominion. 	 3. Ashes of cow-dung, &c. with which ŚIVA is said to have smeared his body, and thence used in imitation of him by devotees. 	 4. Prosperity. 	 5. Wealth.  E. वि implying change of form, &c., भू to be, aff. क्तिन् ।
विभूतिमत्: विभूतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 	 1. Superhuman. 	 2. Smeared with ashes. E. विभूति and मतुप् aff.
विभूषण: विभूषण n. (-णं) Ornament, decoration.  E. वि implying variety, and भूषण adorning.
विभूषा: विभूषा f. (-षा) 	 1. Lustre, splendour, beauty. 	 2. Ornament, decoration. E. वि before भूष् to adorn, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
विभूषित: विभूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Adorned, decorated.  E. वि variously, भूष् to adorn, क्त aff.
विभृत: विभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Held, retained. 	 2. Upheld, supported.  E. वि, भृत supported.
विभेद: विभेद m. (-दः) 	 1. Dividing, breaking. 	 2. Wounding, piercing. 	 3. Variety, distinction. 	 4. Bewildering, perplexing. 	 5. A division or separation. 	 6. Enmity, opposition. 	 7. Contradiction.  E. वि before भिद् to break, घञ् aff.
विभेदन: विभेदन n. (-नं) 	 1. Breaking, dividing. 	 2. Separating, literally or figur-atively, as setting at variance.  E. वि before भिद् to divide, ल्युट् aff.
विभ्रंश: विभ्रंश m. (-शः) 	 1. Falling away. 	 2. Decay, ruin. 	 3. A precipice.
विभ्रत्: विभ्रत् mfn. (-भ्रन्-भ्रती-भ्रत्) Having, possessing.  E. वि, भृ to support, शतृ aff.
विभ्रम: विभ्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. One of the classes of feminine actions proceeding from the passion of love, flurry, confusion. 	 2. Error, mistake blunder. 	 3. Hurry, flurry. 	 4. Doubt, apprehension. 	 5. Beauty. 	 6. Whirling, going round. 	 7. Wandering. 	 8. Whim, caprice. 	 9. Amorous gesture. 	 f. (-मा) Old age.  E. वि before भ्रम् to err, aff. घञ् ।
विभ्रष्ट: विभ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Lost, gone. 	 2. Broken off or from, fallen, separated.  E. वि before भ्रस्ज् to be broken, क्त aff.
विभ्राज्: विभ्राज् mfn. (-भ्राड् or भ्राट्) 	 1. Elegant, richly dressed or decorated. 	 2. Splendid, luminous, shining.  E. वि before भ्राज् to shine, aff. क्विप् ।
विभ्राजमान: विभ्राजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Resplendent, glittering.  E. वि, भ्राज् to shine, शानच् aff.
विभ्राण: विभ्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having, possessing.  E. वि before भृ to have, शानच् aff.
विभ्रान्त: विभ्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Hurried, flurried, erring, &c., through preci-pitation.  E. वि before भ्रम् to err, aff. क्त ।
विभ्रान्तशील: विभ्रान्तशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mad, drunk, intoxicated or insane. 	 m. (-लः) 1. A monkey. 	 2. The disk of the sun or moon.  E. विभ्रान्त wander-ing, and शील disposition.
विभ्रान्ति: विभ्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 	 1. Error, confusion. 	 2. Hurry, flurry, precipitation. 3. Whirling, going round.  E. वि before भ्रम् to err, aff. क्तिन् ।
विमत: विमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Disliking, averse or hostile to. 	 2. Disagreeing, of a different opinion. 	 m. (-तः) An enemy.  E. वि adverse, and मत disposed.
विमति: विमति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Dislike, aversion. 	 2. Difference of opinion, dissent. 3. Stupidity.  E. वि and मति mind.
विमत्सर: विमत्सर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unenvious, unambitious.  E. वि priv., मत्सर envious.
विमद: विमद f. (-दा) 	 1. Free from intoxication. 	 2. Joyless.
विमनस्: विमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) 	 1. Sad, perplexed, disordered, heart-broken. 2. Changed in mind or feeling. 	 3. Averse, disliking, displeased. 4. Absent-minded, thinking of something else.  E. वि privative and मनस् the mind; having no mind or heart.
विमनस्क: विमनस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Sad, bewildered, heart-broken, &c.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
विमनीकृत: विमनीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Altered in mind or feeling. 	 2. Sad, sorrow-ful. 	 3. Displeased, offended.  E. विमनस् and कृत made with च्वि aug.
विमनीभूत: विमनीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Changed in mind or feeling, &c.: see the last. E. विमनस् and भूत become, च्वि augment.
विमन्यु: विमन्यु Adj. 	 1. Free from anger. 	 2. Free from grief.
विमय: विमय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange.  E. वि before मि to scatter, aff. अच् ।
विमर्द: विमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 	 1. Rubbing, friction. 	 2. The trituration of perfumes. 3. Touch, contact. 	 4. Destroying, killing. 	 5. Crushing, bruising. 6. Rubbing the body with unguents. 	 7. Conjunction of the sun and moon. 	 8. War. 	 9. A plant, (Cassia esculenta.)  E. वि before मृद् to grind, aff. अच्, कन् or घञ् ।
विमर्द्द: विमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 	 1. Rubbing, friction. 	 2. The trituration of perfumes. 3. Touch, contact. 	 4. Destroying, killing. 	 5. Crushing, bruising. 6. Rubbing the body with unguents. 	 7. Conjunction of the sun and moon. 	 8. War. 	 9. A plant, (Cassia esculenta.)  E. वि before मृद् to grind, aff. अच्, कन् or घञ् ।
विमर्दन: विमर्द्दन n. (-नं) 	 1. Rubbing, pounding, grinding. 	 2. Killing, destroying. 3. The trituration of perfumes. 	 4. Conjunction of the sun and moon, or eclipse.  E. वि before मृद् to rub, &c. aff. ल्युट्; also विम-र्द्दक m. (-कः) and विमर्द्दना f. (-ना) ।
विमर्द्दन: विमर्द्दन n. (-नं) 	 1. Rubbing, pounding, grinding. 	 2. Killing, destroying. 3. The trituration of perfumes. 	 4. Conjunction of the sun and moon, or eclipse.  E. वि before मृद् to rub, &c. aff. ल्युट्; also विम-र्द्दक m. (-कः) and विमर्द्दना f. (-ना) ।
विमर्दार्ध: विमर्द्दार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) (In astronomy,) The time from the apparent conjunc-tion to the end of an eclipse.  E. विमर्द्द, and अर्द्ध half.
विमर्द्दार्द्ध: विमर्द्दार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) (In astronomy,) The time from the apparent conjunc-tion to the end of an eclipse.  E. विमर्द्द, and अर्द्ध half.
विमर्दोत्थ: विमर्द्दोत्थ m. (-त्थः) A pleasing scent.  E. विमर्द्द rubbing, and उत्थ what rises.
विमर्द्दोत्थ: विमर्द्दोत्थ m. (-त्थः) A pleasing scent.  E. विमर्द्द rubbing, and उत्थ what rises.
विमर्श: विमर्श m. (-र्शः) 	 1. Discussion, investigation, reasoning, examination by reason. 	 2. A conflicting judgment. 	 3. The impression on the mind of past good or evil actions.  E. वि implying discrimination, मृश् to perceive, aff. घञ् ।
विमर्शन: विमर्शन n. (-नं) Investigating, discussing.  E. वि, मृश् to judge, ल्युट् aff.
विमर्शिन्: विमर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Thinking, deliberating.  E. विमर्श, इनि aff.
विमर्ष: विमर्ष m. (-र्षः) 	 1. Irritation, impatience. 	 2. Displeasure, dissatisfaction. 3. Interruption of the prosperous course of a dramatic story, (one of the five Sandhis in a drama,) reverse.  E. वि before मृष् to en-dure, aff. घञ् ।
विमर्षिन्: विमर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) 	 1. Impatient, intolerant. 	 2. Averse, disliking.  E. विमर्ष and इनि aff.
विमल: विमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Clean, pure, (either literally, as clothes, &c. or figuratively, as the heart or mind.) 	 2. Beautiful. 	 3. White. 	 4. Transparent. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. A plant, commonly Charmaghās. 	 2. A sort of soil. 	 m. (-लः) An Arhat or Jaina deified sage. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. Silver-gilt. 	 2. Talc.  E. वि privative, मल dirt.
विमलमणि: विमलमणि m. (-णिः) Crystal.  E. विमल clean, clear, मणि a jewel.
विमलात्मक: विमलात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Clean, pure.  E. विमल clean, आत्मन् nature, aff. कन् ।
विमलात्मन्: विमलात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Pure, undefiled.  E. विमल, and आत्मन् self.
विमलाद्रि: विमलाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) A particular mountain.  E. विमल clean, or crystal, and अद्रि a mountain.
विमलार्थक: विमलार्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Clear, clean, pure.  E. विमल clean, अर्थ pur-pose, कन् added.
विमस्तकित: विमस्तकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beheaded, decapitated.  E. वि priv., मस्त the head, इतच् aff.
विमांस: विमांस mn. (-सः-सं) Unclean meat, as the flesh of dogs, &c.  E. वि depre-ciative prefix, and मांस flesh.
विमातृ: विमातृ f. (-ता) A step-mother, a father's wife.  E. वि different, मातृ mother.
विमातृज: विमातृज m. (-जः) A step-mother's son.  E. विमातृ, and ज born.
विमान: विमान mn. (-नः-नं) 	 1. A car or chariot of the gods, sometimes serving as a seat or throne, and at others carrying them through the skies self-directed and self-moving; hence it also applies to the sky. 2. Any car or vehicle. 	 3. A horse. 	 4. A palace, the palace of an emperor, or supreme monarch. 	 5. A seven-storied palace. 	 6. Disrespect, dishonour. 	 7. Measure.  E. वि before मन् to under-stand, with घञ् aff.; or मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्; to वि priv., मान honour.
विमानित: विमानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dishonoured.  E. विमान, and इतच् aff.
विमार्ग: विमार्ग m. (-र्गः) 	 1. A broom, a brush. 	 2. A bad road. 	 3. A wrong road, literally or figuratively, evil conduct.  E. वि before मृज् to clean, aff. घञ्; or वि privative, and मार्ग a road.
विमार्गण: विमार्गण n. (-णं) Searching, seeking.  E. वि before मृग् to search, ल्युट् aff.
विमुक्त: विमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Loosed, liberated. 	 2. Hurled, thrown. 	 3. Quitted, abandoned. 	 4. Issued or let loose from, given vent to. E. वि before मुक्त the same.
विमुक्ति: विमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Liberation, especially final emancipation from future existence. 	 2. Separation, parting.  E. वि, मुक्ति the same.
विमुख: विमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) 	 1. Averted, having the face cast down or turned away. 	 2. Opposed, averse, disinclined. 	 3. Void of.  E. वि reverse, and मुख the countenance.
विमुखता: विमुखता f. (-ता) 	 1. Disappearance, departure. 	 2. Turning away. 	 3. Oppo-sition.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विमुखत्वं ।
विमुखिता: विमुखिता f. (-ता) 	 1. Turning away from, enmity. 	 2. Departure. 	 3. Oppo-sition.  E. विमुखिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विमुखित्वं ।
विमुखिन्: विमुखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) 	 1. Averted, turned away. 	 2. Hostile, averse to or from.  E. विमुख, and इनि aff.
विमुखीकरण: विमुखीकरण n. (-णं) Turning away from, leaving.  E. विमुख, करण doing, च्वि augment.
विमुखीकृत: विमुखीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned away from, averted, departed. E. विमुख, कृत made, च्वि augment.
विमुग्ध: विमुग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Bewildered, absorbed.  E. वि, मुह् to be bewildered, क्त aff.
विमुच्यमान: विमुच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being let loose or liberated, in the act of spreading abroad.  E. वि before मुच् to be loosed, शानच् aff.
विमुद्र: विमुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 	 1. Blown, budded, opened as a bud or flower. 	 2. Unsealed, unclosed.  E. वि privative, मुद्रा a seal.
विमूढ: विमूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Bewildered, discomposed. 	 2. Foolish. 	 3. Be-guiled, led astray, seduced, tempted.  E. वि, मुह् to be foolish, aff. क्त ।
विमूढसंज्ञ: विमूढसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Senseless, unconscious.  E. विमूढ, संज्ञा sense.
विमूढात्मन्: विमूढात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Beguiled, foolish.  E. विमूढ, आत्मन् self.
विमृदित: विमृदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Rubbed. 	 2. Ground, pounded.  E. वि, मृद् to rub, क्त aff.
विमृश्य: विमृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) To be discussed or reflected upon. Ind. Hav-ing considered.  E. वि, मृश् to reflect, युच् or ल्यप् aff.
विमृश्यकारिन्: विमृश्यकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Acting after due deliberation.  E. विमृश्य and कारिन् who acts.
विमृष्ट: विमृष्ट f. (-ष्टा) 	 1. Rubbed of, cleansed. 	 2. Considered, reflected upon.
विमोक्ष: विमोक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. Liberation, freedom, being or letting loose. 	 2. Dis-charging, shooting. 	 3. Final emancipation.  E. वि before मोक्ष the same.
विमोक्षण: विमोक्षण nf. (-णं-णा) Quitting, abandoning, resigning.  E. वि before मोक्षण the same.
विमोचन: विमोचन n. (-नं) Liberating, unyoking.  E. वि, मुच् to set free, ल्युट् aff.
विमोचित: विमोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Liberated, set free.  E. वि before मुच् to liberate, causal v., aff. क्त ।
विमोहन: विमोहन mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं) 	 1. Fascinating, seducing, bewitching, tempting, (the instrument or agent.) 	 2. Name of a division of hell. 	 n. (-नं) Seducing, tempting, confounding the mind and exciting the passions, (the act.)  E. वि before मुह् to be foolish, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट् ।
विमोहित: विमोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fascinated, beguiled.  E. वि before मुह् to be foolish, causal v., क्त aff.
विम्ब: विम्ब mn. (-म्बः-म्बं) 	 1. The disk of the sun or moon. 	 2. An image, a picture, a shadow, a reflected or represented form. 	 3. The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha. 	 nf. (-म्बं-म्बा or -म्बी) A cucurbitaceous plant with red fruit, (Momordica monadelpha.)  E. वि to go, to shine, बन् Unādi aff., मुम् aug.; the radical vowel made short.
विम्बक: विम्बक n. (-कं) 	 1. The disk of the sun or moon. 	 2. The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha or the plant itself. “तेलाकुचा.”  E. कन् added to the last.
विम्बजा: विम्बजा f. (-जा) Momordica monadelpha or the gourd.  E. विम्ब the plant and ज born.
विम्बट: विम्बट m. (-टः) The mustard plant, (Sinapis dichotoma, Rox.)  E. विम्ब as above, अट् to go or grow, (like,) aff. अच् deriv. irr.
विम्बागत: विम्बागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reflected.  E. विम्ब and आगत arrived.
विम्बिका: विम्बिका f. (-का) 	 1. A cucurbitaceous plant bearing a bright red gourd, (Momordica monadelpha.) 	 2. The disk of the sun or moon.  E. कन् in the fem. form, added to विम्ब as above.
विम्बित: विम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pictured, imaged, reflected.  E. विम्ब, इतच् aff.
विम्बु: विम्बु m. (-म्बुः) The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.)
विम्बोष्ठ: विम्बोष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Red-lipped, having lips like the Vimba fruit. E. विम्ब as above, and ओष्ठ the lip; also विम्बौष्ठ ।
विम्लान: विम्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Fresh, pure, free from soil or decay. 	 2. Re-freshed.  E. वि priv., म्लान decayed.
विम्लापन: विम्लापन n. (-नं) 	 1. Cleaning, wiping. 	 2. Refreshing, reviving.  E. वि priv., म्ले to decay, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
वियच्चारिन्: वियच्चारिन् m. (-री) A kite.  E. वियत् the sky, and चारिन् who goes.
वियत्: वियत् n. (-यत्) Sky, heaven, æther, atmosphere.  E. वि privative, यम् to refrain or cause, aff. क्विप् and तुक् final.
वियति: वियति m. (-तिः) A bird.  E. वि, यत् to endeavour, कि aff.
वियद्गङ्गा: वियद्गङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Ganges or river of heaven.  E. वियत् heaven, गङ्गा the river.
वियद्गति: वियद्गति f. (-तिः) Moving in the air.  E. वियत्, गति motion.
वियद्भूति: वियद्भूति f. (-तिः) Darkness.  E. वियत् the sky, and भूति superhuman power.
वियन्मणि: वियन्मणि m. (-णिः) The sun.  E. वियत् the sky, and मणि a gem.
वियम: वियम m. (-मः) 	 1. Forbearance, restraint. 	 2. Rest, cessation, stop. 	 3. Pain or distress of various kinds.  E. वि before यम् to check or res-train, aff. अप्; also वियाम ।
वियात: वियात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Shameless, impudent, ill-behaved. 	 2. Bold. E. वि implying prevention, and यात wished; wishing for what is prohibited or improper.
वियाम: वियाम m. (-मः) 	 1. Forbearance, restraint. 	 2. Rest, stop, cessation. 	 3. Pain or distress of various kinds.  E. वि, यम् to restrain, aff. घञ् ।
वियुक्त: वियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Separated, sundered.  E. वि priv., युक्त joined.
वियुत: वियुत f. (-ता) Separated from, deprived of.
वियोग: वियोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Absence, separation, especially of lovers. 	 2. Disunion, disjunction. 	 3. Loss, absence.  E. वि privative, and योग union.
वियोगभाज्: वियोगभाज् mfn. (-भाक) Suffering separation.  E. वियोग separation, भज् to serve, to be subject to, causal form, aff. क्विप् ।
वियोगिन्: वियोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Separated, absent, remote, apart. 	 m. (-गी) The ruddy goose.  E. वि, युज् to join, घिनुण् aff.
वियोगिनी: वियोगिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A woman separated from her lover. 	 2. Name of a metre.
वियोजित: वियोजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Separated, disjoined, disunited. 	 2. Parted from, deprived of.  E. वि privative, योजित joined.
वियोनि: वियोनि f. (नि or नी) 	 1. Manifold birth. 	 2. An ignominious birth.
विरक्त: विरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Averse, indifferent, free from inclination or affection. 	 2. Stoical, void of attachment to worldly objects. 	 3. Impassioned, interested, feeling passion or regard for any person or any thing. 	 4. Discoloured.  E. वि privative or pleonastic, before रञ्ज् to feel passion, aff. क्त ।
विरक्तभाव: विरक्तभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Disinclined to, disliking.  E. विरक्त, भाव quality.
विरक्ति: विरक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Aversion, disinclination. 	 2. Absence of affection. E. वि before रञ्ज् to affect, क्तिन् aff.
विरचत्: विरचत् mfn. (-चन्-चन्ती-चत्) Making, composing, fabricating, embellish-ing, &c.  E. वि before रच् to make, aff. शतृ ।
विरचन: विरचन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Making, arranging. 	 2. Composing, Embellishing. 4. Embellishment, any artificial and ornamental fabric or contri-vance.  E. वि before रच to make, युच् aff.
विरचित: विरचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made, prepared, effected. 	 2. Written, com-posed. 	 3. Trimmed, ornamented. 	 4. Contrived, constructed, arranged. 	 5. Put on, worn. 	 6. Set, inlaid.  E. वि pleonasm, and रच् to be made, क्त aff.
विरच्य: विरच्य Ind. Having made.  E. वि, रच् to make, ल्यप् aff.
विरज: विरज m. (-जः) VISHṆU. 	 f. (-जा) Free from dust.
विरजस्: विरजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 	 1. Free from dust. 	 2. Free from passion. f. (-जाः) A woman who has ceased to menstruate.  E. वि privative, रजस् the menses, &c.
विरजस्तमस्: विरजस्तमस् m. (-माः) A virtuous man, one free from the two properties of ignorance and passion.  E. वि privative, रजस् the quality of pass-ion, and तमस् that of ignorance.
विरजा: विरजा f. (-जा) 	 1. A plant, commonly कवित्थानी 2. A sort of grass, commonly Durbā.
विरजीकृत: विरजीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Freed from passion. 	 2. Clean, freed from dust, &c.  E. वि priv., रजस् passion, &c., कृत made, च्वि augment.
विरजीभूत: विरजीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Free from passion, pure, holy. 	 2. Clean, clear.  E. वि priv., रजस् passion, भूत become, च्वि augment.
विरञ्च: विरञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) BRAHMĀ.  E. वि before रच् to create, aff. अच् and नुम् augment; more properly विरिञ्च ।
विरट: विरट m. (-टः) 	 1. The name of a king. 	 2. The shoulder. 	 3. A black kind of Agallochum.
विरण: विरण n. (-णं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schœnanthum.) E. See वीरण । “वेणार मूल ।”
विरत: विरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stopped, ceased, rested.  E. वि before रम् to stop or rest, aff. क्त ।
विरति: विरति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Stop, cessation, term, rest. 	 2. End, term.  E. वि be-fore रम् to play, क्तिन् aff.
विरमत्: विरमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) 	 1. Resting, stopping. 	 2. Sporting.  E. वि, रम् to sport, शतृ aff.
विरल: विरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Fine, delicate, thin, (but with interstices.) 2. Loose, relaxed. 	 3. Apart, wide, separated by an interval. 	 4. Remote, rare, occurring at distant or repeated intervals of time. n. (-लं) Sour curds.  E. वि apart, रा to go or be, aff. कलन् ।
विरलम्: विरलम् Ind. It is used as an indeclinable in the sense of “rarely,” “unfrequently.”
विरलजानुक: विरलजानुक m. (-कः) A man with bandy legs.  E. विरल wide, जानु the knee, कन् added.
विरलद्रवा: विरलद्रवा f. (-वा) Gruel made of rice or other grain, with the addition of Ghee, &c.  E. विरल apart, द्रु to ooze, aff. अच् ।
विरस: विरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 	 1. Insipid. 	 2. Painful. 	 m. (-सः) Pain.  E. वि, रस flavour.
विरह: विरह m. (-हः) 	 1. Separation, parting, absence, especially the separa-tion of lovers. 	 2. Forbearance, cessation, relinquishment.  E. वि be-fore रह् to abandon, aff. अच् ।
विरहज्वर: विरहज्वर m. (-रः) The anguish of separation.
विरहय्य: विरहय्य Ind. Having abandoned.  E. वि before, रह् to quit, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
विरहानल: विरहानल m. (-लः) The fire of separation.
विरहार्त: विरहार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained by the absence of a lover.  E. विरह, आर्त्त pained.
विरहार्त्त: विरहार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained by the absence of a lover.  E. विरह, आर्त्त pained.
विरहित: विरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Left, abandoned, deserted, relinquished. 	 2. Void of, exempt, or free from.  E. वि before रह् to abandon, aff. क्त ।
विरहिन्: विरहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Separate, sundered, absent or apart from. f. (-हिणी) 	 1. Wages, hire. 	 2. A woman absent from her husband or lover.  E. विरह absence, णिनि aff.
विरहोत्कण्ठ: विरहोत्कण्ठ Adj. Pining away in absence.
विरहोत्कण्ठिता: विरहोत्कण्ठिता f. (-ता) A woman whose lover or husband is absent. E. विरह separation, उत्कण्ठित afficted.
विराग: विराग m. (-गः) 	 1. The absence of desire or passion, indifference, philoso-phy, the disregard of all sensual enjoyment either in this world or the next. 	 2. Change of colour. 	 3. Dissatisfaction.  E. वि priva-tive, and राग passion, desire.
विरागार्ह: विरागार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Void of passion or desire.  E. विराग the absence of desire, and अह worthy.
विरागिन्: विरागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Void of passion or desire.  E. विराग and इनि aff.
विराज: विराज m. (-राट्) 	 1. A man of the regal or military class. 	 2. Splendour, beauty. 	 3. The body. 	 4. The first progeny of BRAHMĀ, who having divided himself into male and female, produced from the female, VIRĀJ; VIRĀJ then by himself produced the first Manu or SWAYAMBHŪVA who was the progenitor of the Prajāpatis, and the secondary framer of the visible world: in other places VIRĀJ is the same as BRAHMĀ, and assumer of the androgynous form in his own person.  E. वि severally or separately, &c., राज् to shine, aff. क्विप् ।
विराजत्: विराजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Shining, splendid, handsome.  E. वि and राज् to shine, aff. शतृ ।
विराजमान: विराजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Splendid, brilliant, handsome.  E. वि before राज् to shine, शानच् aff.
विराजित: विराजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Illuminated, irradiated, splendid. 	 2. Ma-nifested, made visible.  E. वि before राज् to shine, क्त aff.
विराट: विराट m. (-टः) 	 1. A country, one of the midland division of India, pro-bably Berār. 	 2. A sovereign.  E. वि before रट् to sound, aff. घञ् ।
विराटक: विराटक m. (-कः) An inferior kind of diamond.
विराटज: विराटज m. (-जः) An inferior sort of diamond, said to be found in the country Virāṭa.  E. विराट the country, ज produced.
विराणिन्: विराणिन् m. (-णी) An elephant.  E. वि before रण battle, aff. अण् and इनि added.
विराद्ध: विराद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Treated with disrespect, reviled, abused. 	 2. Opposed. 	 3. Offended.  E. वि before राध् to accomplish, क्त aff.
विराद्धृ: विराद्धृ mfn. (-द्धा-द्ध्री-द्धृ) 	 1. Thwarting, opposing. 	 2. Offending, injuring. 3. Abusive, calumnious.  E. वि before राध् to accomplish, aff. तृच् ।
विराध: विराध m. (-धः) 	 1. Opposition, prevention. 	 2. Vexation, annoyance. E. वि before राध् to accomplish, घञ् aff.
विराधन: विराधन n. (-नं) Pain, agony, anguish.  E. वि, राध to accomplish, ल्युट् aff.
विराध्यत्: विराध्यत् mfn. (-ध्यन्-ध्यन्ती-ध्यत्) 	 1. Opposing, thwarting. 	 2. Offending, annoying, injuring.  E. वि before राध् to accomplish, शतृ aff.
विराम: विराम m. (-मः) 	 1. End, conclusion, cessation, term. 	 2. Rest, cessation from labour. 	 3. Stop, pause of the voice. 	 4. Interval between words or sentences.  E. वि before रम् to stop, aff. घञ् ।
विराल: विराल m. (-लः) A cat.  E. विडाल as above, and ड changed to र ।
विराव: विराव m. (-वः) Sound, noise.  E. वि before रु to make a noise, aff. घञ् ।
विराविन्: विराविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Shouting, roaring, crying, &c. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. A broom. 	 2. The name of a river. 	 3. Weeping, crying.  E. विराव noise, इनि and ङीप् affs.
विरिक्त: विरिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Purged.  E. वि before रिच् to void by stool, क्त aff.
विरिञ्जन: विरिञ्जन m. (-नः) BRAHMĀ. see the next.
विरिञ्चि: विरिञ्चि m. (-ञ्चिः) 	 1. BRAHMĀ. 	 2. VISHṆU. 	 3. ŚIVA.  E. वि implying vari-ous kind, (of beings,) रच् to make or create, इन् aff., the radical vowel changed to इ and नुम् augment; also with अच् aff. विरिञ्च, and with युच्, विरिञ्चन; some authorities omit the change of the radical vowel, and write विरञ्च and विरञ्चि, but these seem to be less accurate.
विरिब्ध: विरिब्ध m. (-ब्धः) A note, a tone.  E. वि before रेभ् to sound, क्त aff., इट् aug.; form irr.
विरुग्न: विरुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 	 1. Broken, bent. 	 2. Blunted. 	 3. Destroyed.  E. वि before रुज् to be sick, क्त aff.
विरुत: विरुत f. (-ता) 	 1. Screamed. 	 2. Resounding. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Singing, chirp-ing. 	 2. Din, noise, clamour.
विरुद: विरुद m. (-दः) 	 1. Crying. 	 2. Proclaiming.  E. वि, रुद् to cry, क aff.
विरुद्ध: विरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Opposed, hindered. 	 2. Reverse, contrary, oppo-site. 	 3. Inconsistent, (in argument,) incongruous, a non sequitur. 4. Opposed in quality. as sweet with sour, &c. 	 5. Disagreeing with each other, (as articles of medicine or food.) 	 6. Hostile, ad-verse. 	 7. Excluded, disqualified. 	 8. Surrounded, blockaded. 	 9. Proving the reverse, as a Hetu, (in logic.)  E. वि before रुध् to stop, aff. क्त ।
विरुद्धता: विरुद्धता f. (-ता) 	 1. Opposition, contrariety. 	 2. Incongruity. 	 3. Enmity. E. तल् added to विरुद्ध; also with त्व, विरुद्धत्वं ।
विरुद्धभुज्: विरुद्धभुज् mfn. (-भुक) Eating incompatible things.  E. विरुद्ध and भुज् who eats.

विरुद्धान्न: विरुद्धान्न n. (-न्नं) Incompatible food.  E. विरुद्ध and अन्न food.
विरुक्षण: विरुक्षण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Astringent, drying. 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. Censure, blame, reviling, abuse. 	 2. Oath, imprecation. 	 3. Contracting, roughening, acting as an astringent.  E. वि before रूक्ष् to be rough, aff. ल्युट्.
विरूढ: विरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Budded, blossomed. 	 2. Born. 	 3. Ascended, mounted.  E. वि before रुह् to grow, aff. क्त ।
विरूप: विरूप mfn. (-पः-पा or -पी-पं) 	 1. Deformed, monstrous. 	 2. Unusual in form or nature, unnatural. 	 n. (-पं) 	 1. Irregular or monstrous shape. 	 2. Difference of nature or character. 	 f. (-पा) The wife of YAMA.  E. वि implying variety, and रूप form.

विश्रमित: विश्रमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wearied, exhausted.  E. विश्रम, and इतच् aff.
विश्रम्भ: विश्रम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. Trust, confidence. 	 2. Affection, affectionate inquiry. 3. Festive or sportive noise or tumult, amorous quarrel. 	 4. Rest, repose. 	 5. Killing.  E. वि before श्रम्भ् to trust, aff. घञ्, and the initial optionally changed; also विस्रम्भ ।
विश्रम्य: विश्रम्य Ind. Having rested.  E. वि before, श्रम् to be weary, ल्यप् aff.
विश्रय: विश्रय m. (-यः) 	 1. Abode, asylum. 	 2. Dependence upon.  E. वि, श्री to serve, श aff.
विश्रयिन्: विश्रयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिणी-यि) 	 1. Living or dwelling in. 	 2. Serving, depending on.  E. वि before श्री to serve, घिनुण् aff.
विश्राणन: विश्राणन n. (-नं) Gift, giving donation.  E. वि before श्रण् to give, r. 10th cl., aff. ल्युट् ।
विश्राणित: विश्राणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bestowed, given away.  E. वि before श्रण् to give, r. 10th cl., क्त aff.
विश्रान्त: विश्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Rested, reposed. 	 2. Ceasing, desisting from. 3. Calm, composed.  E. वि before श्रान्त the same.
विश्रान्ति: विश्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Rest, repose, cessation from toil or occupation.  E. वि before श्रम् to be weary, aff. क्तिन् ।
विश्राम: विश्राम m. (-मः) 	 1. Rest, repose. 	 2. Pause, stop, cessation. 	 3. Tranquility, composure.  E. वि before श्रम् to be weary, aff. घञ् ।
विश्राव: विश्राव m. (-वः) 	 1. Fame, celebrity. 	 2. Flowing, dropping.  E. वि before श्रु to hear or drop, aff. घञ् ।
विश्रावण: विश्रावण n. (-णं) 	 1. Causing to flow or drop. 	 2. Bleeding. 	 3. Apprising, causing to hear.  E. वि before श्रु to ooze, &c., causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विश्रुत: विश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Famous, celebrated, renowned. 	 2. Known. 3. Pleased, happy. 	 4. Dropped, flowing.  E. वि before श्रुत heard.
विश्रुति: विश्रुति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Celebrity, fame, notoriety. 	 2. Oozing, flowing.  E. वि before श्रु to hear, aff. क्तिन् ।
विश्लथ: विश्लथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Languid, relaxed, untied.  E. वि before श्लथ loose.
विश्लथाङ्ग: विश्लथाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Weak, relaxed.  E. विश्लथ, अङ्ग the body.
विश्लिष्ट: विश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Separated, disunited.  E. वि, श्लिष् to unite, क्त aff.
विश्लेष: विश्लेष m. (-षः) 	 1. Separation, distance, especially of lovers, or husband and wife. 	 2. Disunion, disjunction, separation in general. 	 3. Absence, bereavement. 	 4. A chasm. 	 5. (In arithmetic,) The converse of addition.  E. वि before श्लिष् to unite, aff. घञ् ।
विश्लेषजाति: विश्लेषजाति f. (-तिः) (In arithmetic,) The assimilation of difference, the reduction of fractional difference.  E. विश्लेष, and जाति kind.
विश्व: विश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं) All, entire, whole, universal. 	 n. (-श्वं) The world, the universe. 	 m. Plu. (-श्वः) A deity of a particular class in which ten are enumerated; their names are VASU, SATYA, KRATU, DAKSHA, KĀLA, KĀMA, DHRITI, KURU, PURURAVAS, MĀDRAVAS: they are worshipped particularly at the funeral obsequies in honour of deceased progenitors in general, and receive an oblation of clarified butter at the daily and domestic Śrāddha. 	 nf. (-श्वं-श्वा) Dry ginger. f. (-श्वा) A tree, the bark of which is said to be used in dyeing red, commonly Atis, (Betula.)  E. विश् to enter, to pervade, Unādi aff. व ।
विश्वकद्रु: विश्वकद्रु mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु) Wicked, vile. 	 m. (-द्रुः) 	 1. A dog trained for the chase. 	 2. Sound, noise.  E. विश्व all, कन् pleonasm, द्रु to run, to pur-sue, aff. डु; or विश्व with कदि to cry or call, aff. डु and र augment.
विश्वकर्मन्: विश्वकर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. The son of BRAHMĀ, and artist of the gods. 	 3. A saint.  E. विश्व universal, कर्म्म work, act.
विश्वकर्म्मन्: विश्वकर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. The son of BRAHMĀ, and artist of the gods. 	 3. A saint.  E. विश्व universal, कर्म्म work, act.
विश्वकर्मसुता: विश्वकर्म्मसुता f. (-ता) SAṂJÑĀ, one of the wives of the sun.  E. विश्वकर्म्मन् the artist of the gods, and सुता the daughter; also विश्वकर्म्मजा, &c.
विश्वकर्म्मसुता: विश्वकर्म्मसुता f. (-ता) SAṂJÑĀ, one of the wives of the sun.  E. विश्वकर्म्मन् the artist of the gods, and सुता the daughter; also विश्वकर्म्मजा, &c.
विश्वका: विश्वका f. (-का) A sort of gull, (Larus ridibundus.) “गाङ्गचिल् इति भाषा ।” E. विश्व all, कै to cry, aff. क ।
विश्वकृत्: विश्वकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Who or what makes all. 	 m. (-कृत्) 	 1. The creator, the maker of all things. 	 2. The carpenter or architect, and artist of the gods.  E. विश्व all and कृत् who makes.
विश्वकेतु: विश्वकेतु m. (-तुः) ANIRUDDHA, an incarnation of KĀMA, as the son of PRADYUMNA.  E. विश्व universe, केतु a banner.
विश्वकसेन: विश्वकसेन m. (-नः) 	 1. VISHṆU. 	 2. A particular form of that deity, to whom the fragments of a sacrifice to VISHṆU are offered. 	 f. (-ना) A plant, commonly priyangu.  E. विश्वक् every way, and सेना an army; more properly विष्वक्सेन ।
विश्वगन्ध: विश्वगन्ध m. (-न्धः) An onion. 	 n. (-न्धं) Myrrh. 	 f. (-न्धा) The earth.  E. विश्व all, universal, and गन्ध fragrance.
विश्वगायत्: विश्वगायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Spreading or going in every direction. E. विश्वक, आयत् going.
विश्वगोप्तृ: विश्वगोप्तृ m. (-प्ता) 	 1. VISHṆU. 	 2. INDRA.  E. विश्व all, गोप्तृ preserver.
विश्वङ्कर: विश्वङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) All-creating, making all. 	 m. (-रः) The eye.  E. विश्व all, and कर making.
विश्वजन: विश्वजन n. (-नं) All men, mankind.  E. विश्व, जन people.
विश्वजनीन: विश्वजनीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Good for or suitable to all men.  E. विश्वजन, ख aff.
विश्वजनीय: विश्वजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Suitable or relating to all men.  E. विश्व all, जन mankind, छ aff.
विश्वजन्य: विश्वजन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Fit or good for all men.  E. विश्वजन, यत् aff.
विश्वजित्: विश्वजित् mfn. (-जित्) All-subduing. 	 m. (-जित्) 	 1. A particular ceremony or sacrifice. 	 2. The cord of noose of VARUṆA.  E. विश्व all, and जित् what subdues.
विश्वञ्च्: विश्वञ्च् mfn. (-श्वङ्-शुची-श्वक्) Going every where. Ind. Adv. or n. (-श्वक्) Every where, universally.  E. विश्व all, अञ्च् to go, aff. क्विप्; it is more usually written both in simple and compound forms विष्वञ्च्, from a different etymology.
विश्वतस्: विश्वतस् Ind. Every where, all around, universally.  E. विश्व all, तसि aff.
विश्वदेव: विश्वदेव m. (-वः) A Viśvadeva, a deity of a particular class: see विश्व. 	 f. (-वा) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)  E. विश्व all, दिव् to sport, aff. घञ् ।
विश्वद्र्यञ्च्: विश्वद्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्) Moving every where, or universally. E. विश्वक every where, अद्रि substituted for the final, अञ्च् to go, aff. क्विप्; also विष्वद्र्यञ्च् ।
विश्वधारिन्: विश्वधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) All-sustaining. 	 m. (-री) A deity. 	 f. (-रिणी) The earth.  E. विश्व all, and धारिन् upholding.
विश्वनाथ: विश्वनाथ m. (-थः) A name of Śiva, especially as the object of peculiar adoration at Benares.  E. विश्व the universe, नाथ lord.
विश्वपा: विश्वपा m. (-पाः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. The moon. 	 3. Fire. 	 4. The protector of all.  E. विश्व, and पा who nourishes.
विश्वप्सन्: विश्वप्सन् m. (-प्सा) 	 1. Fire, or the deity of fire. 	 2. The moon. 	 3. The sun. 	 4. A god. 	 5. The earth.  E. विश्व all, प्सा to eat, Unādi aff. कनिन् ।
विश्वबोध: विश्वबोध m. (-धः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint.  E. विश्व all, and बोध who explains.
विश्वभुज्: विश्वभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) 	 1. Enjoying or possessing all things. 	 2. Eating all things.  E. विश्व, and भुज् who possesses.
विश्वभू: विश्वभू m. (-भूः) The third of the seven Buddhas, according to some systems.  E. विश्व all, and भू being.
विश्वभेषज: विश्वभेषज n. (-जं) Dry ginger.  E. विश्व all, (diseases,) भेषज a medicament.
विश्वभोजन: विश्वभोजन n. (-नं) Eating all sorts of food.  E. विश्व, and भोजन food.
विश्वभोजस्: विश्वभोजस् m. (-जाः) One who enjoys all things.  E. विश्व all, भुज् to enjoy, Unādi aff. असि ।
विश्वमदा: विश्वमदा f. (-दा) One of the seven tongues of fire.  E. विश्व all, मद् to in-toxicate, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
विश्वम्मर: विश्वम्मर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) All-sustaining. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. VISHṆU. 	 2. INDRA. 	 f. (-रा) The earth.  E. विश्व all, (things,) भृ to support or nourish, अच् aff., मुम् augment.
विश्वम्भराधिप: विश्वम्भराधिप m. (-पः) A king.  E. विश्वम्भरा the earth, and अधिप ruler.
विश्वयु: विश्वयु m. (-युः) Air, wind.  E. विश्व all, यु to join, aff. क्विप् ।
विश्वराज्: विश्वराज् m. (-राट् or राड्) A universal sovereign.  E. विश्व all, राज् who rules.
विश्वरूप: विश्वरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Taking all forms, existing in all forms, universal, omnipresent. 	 m. (-पः) VISHṆU. 	 n. (-पं) Agallochum. E. विश्व all, रूप form.
विश्वरेतस्: विश्वरेतस् m. (-ताः) BRAHMĀ.  E. विश्व all, रेतस् seed.
विश्वरोचन: विश्वरोचन m. (-नः) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)  E. विश्व all, रोचन digestive.
विश्वविधायिन्: विश्वविधायिन् m. (-यी) A deity, a creator.  E. विश्व, विधायिन् who makes.
विश्ववेदस्: विश्ववेदस् m. (-दाः) 	 1. A sage, a saint, one who knows all things. 	 2. An epithet of AGNI.  E. विश्व all, विदि to know, aff. असि ।
विश्वव्यापक: विश्वव्यापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) All-pervading, every where diffused.  E. विश्व, and व्यापक what pervades.
विश्वव्यापिन्: विश्वव्यापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) All-diffused or pervading.  E. विश्व, and व्यापिन् what spreads.
विश्वव्याप्ति: विश्वव्याप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Universal diffusion or permeation.  E. विश्व, and व्याप्ति spreading.
विश्वसन: विश्वसन n. (-नं) Trusting, confiding in.  E. वि before श्वस् to breathe, ल्युट् aff.
विश्वसनीय: विश्वसनीय f. (-या) Capable of inspiring confidence.
विश्वसह: विश्वसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) All-enduring. 	 f. (-हा) 	 1. The earth. 	 2. One of the seven tongues of fire.  E. विश्व all, सह् to bear, affs. अच् and टाप् ।
विश्वसारक: विश्वसारक n. (-कं) The prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus, Rox.) “फणिमन्सा.” E. विश्व all, सार essence, and कन् added.
विश्वसित: विश्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trusted, believed or confided in.  E. वि before श्वस् to breathe, aff. क्त, with इट् augment.
विश्वसृज्: विश्वसृज् m. (-सृक्, सृग्, सृट् or सृड्) BRAHMĀ.  E. विश्व all, (the universe,) सृज् to create, aff. क्विन् ।
विश्वस्त: विश्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Trusted, confided in, faithful. 	 f. (-स्ता) A widow.  E. वि implying kind or sort, or in the fem. form, privation, and श्वस् to live or breathe, aff. क्त ।
विश्वस्रष्टृ: विश्वस्रष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) The creator of all.  E. विश्व, स्रष्टृ creator.
विश्वाची: विश्वाची f. (-ची) One of the Apsarās or courtezans of Swarga.  E. विश्वमञ्चति अन्च्-क्विप् ।
विश्वात्मन्: विश्वात्मन् m. (-त्मा) BRAHMĀ. 	 n. (-त्म) The soul of the world, the univer-sal spirit, GOD.  E. विश्व all, and आत्मन् soul.
विश्वाधायस्: विश्वाधायस् m. (-याः) A deity, a god.  E. विश्व all, आङ् before धा to hold or support, असि aff., form irr.
विश्वामित्र: विश्वामित्र m. (-त्रः) A Muni, the son of GĀDHĪ, originally of the military order, but who became by long and painful austerities a Brahmarshi, in which character he appears in the RĀMĀYAṆA, as the early preceptor and counsellor of RĀMA.  E. विश्व all, मित्र the friend, and the vowel of the prefix made long in this sense; if attributively used, the compound is विश्वमित्र ।
विश्वामित्रप्रिय: विश्वामित्रप्रिय m. (-यः) The cocoanut tree.  E. विश्वामित्र the saint VIŚWĀ-MITRA, and प्रिय beloved, having been created by the saint.
विश्वावसु: विश्वावसु m. (-सुः) One of the Gandharbas or celestial singers. 	 f. (-सुः) A particular night.
विश्वास: विश्वास m. (-सः) 	 1. Trust, faith, confidence. 	 2. A confidential commu-nication.  E. वि before श्वस् to breathe or live, aff. घञ् ।
विश्वासकारण: विश्वासकारण n. (-णं) Cause or motive of trust.  E. विश्वास, कारण cause.
विश्वासकृत्: विश्वासकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Inspiring confidence or faith.  E. विश्वास, and कृत् who or what makes.
विश्वासघात: विश्वासघात m. (-तः) Violation of trust, treachery.  E. विश्वास, and घात destroying.
विश्वासघातक: विश्वासघातक m. (-कः) A traitor, one who betrays confidence.  E. विश्वास, and घातक who destroys; also विश्वासघातिन् ।
विश्वासपात्र: विश्वासपात्र n. (-त्रं) A confidential agent, one worthy to be trusted. E. विश्वास, and पात्र person.
विश्वासप्रतिपन्न: विश्वासप्रतिपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Confiding, trusting.  E. विश्वास, and प्रतिपन्न possessed of.
विश्वासप्रद: विश्वासप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Inspiring confidence.  E. विश्वास, प्रद who gives.
विश्वासभङ्ग: विश्वासभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Breach of faith, violation of confidence.  E. विश्वास, and भङ्ग breaking.
विश्वासभूमि: विश्वासभूमि f. (-मिः) An object of trust, a person worthy of confidence. E. विश्वास, and भूमि place.
विश्वासस्थान: विश्वासस्थान n. (-नं) An object or person of trust or confidence.  E. विश्वास, and स्थान place.
विश्वासित: विश्वासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inspired with confidence.  E. वि before श्वस् to breathe, causal v., क्त aff.
विश्वासिन्: विश्वासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 	 1. Trusting, confiding in. 	 2. Honest, trusty. E. विश्वास, and इनि aff.
विश्वास्य: विश्वास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 	 1. To be trusted or depended on, to be believed. 	 2. To be encouraged or inspired with confidence. Ind. Having encouraged or inspired with confidence.  E. वि before श्वस् to breathe, ण्यत् aff; or causal v., and यत् or ल्यप् aff.
विश्वास्यता: विश्वास्यता f. (-ता) Trust-worthiness.  E. विश्वास्य, and तल् aff.
विश्वेश: विश्वेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA.  E. विश्व all, ईश lord: see the next.
विश्वेश्वर: विश्वेश्वर m. (-रः) ŚIVA, under a form or appellation in which espe-cially he is worshipped at Benares, where a celebrated temple is appropriated to him in the character of lord or god of the uni-verse.  E. विश्व the universe, and ईश्वर god; also similar compounds, as विश्वेश, विश्वनाथ, &c.
विष्: विष् r. 6th cl. (विषति) To pervade. (औ) औविष r. 9th cl. (विष्णाति) To have no occasion or use for, to separate or withdraw from, to disjoin. (उ) विषु r. 1st cl. (वेषति) To sprinkle. विषान्तक: विषान्तक m. (-कः) ŚIVA.  E. विष poison, अन्तक destroyer; having swallow-ed the poison that was produced at the churning of the ocean.
विषापह: विषापह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Antidotic, an antidote. 	 f. (-हा) A kind of birth-wort, (Aristolochia Indica.)  E. विष poison, and अपह removing.
विषायुध: विषायुध m. (-धः) A snake.  E. विष poison, and आयुध a weapon.
विषार: विषार m. (-रः) A snake.  E. विष poison, ऋ to go, aff. अच् ।
विषालु: विषालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Venomous, poisonous.  E. विष, and आलुच् aff.
विषास्य: विषास्य m. (-स्यः) A snake. 	 f. (-स्या) Marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.)  E. विष poison, and आस्य face.
विषीदत्: विषीदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Sorrowing, despairing.  E. वि before षद् to go, शतृ aff.
विषु: विषु Ind. 	 1. Many, various. 	 2. Equally, same, like.  E. विष, कु aff.
विषुण: विषुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having or possessing various or uniform motion or extension.  E. विष्वञ्च् going every where, न poss. aff., and the final consonant of the primitive rejected.
विषुप: विषुप n. (-पं) The equinox: see the next.
विषुव: विषुव n. (-वं) The first point of ARIES or LIBRA into which the sun enters at the vernal or autumnal equinox.  E. विषु equally, (the night and day,) and व or प aff.; also विषुप ।
विषुवच्छाया: विषुवच्छाया f. (-या) The shadow of the gnomon at noon when the sun is in the equinoctial points.  E. विषुव and छाया shade.
विषुवत्: विषुवत् n. (-वत्) The equinoctial point.  E. विषु equally, (long, the day and night,) and मतुप् poss. aff.
विषुवदिन: विषुवदिन n. (-नं) The day of the equinox.  E. विषुव and दिन day.
विषुवसङ्क्रान्ति: विषुवसङ्क्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) The passage of the sun to the next sign at the equinoxes.  E. विषुव, and सङ्क्रान्ति sun's entrance into a sign.
विष्क्: विष्क् r. 10th cl. (विष्कयति-ते) To see, to perceive. (विष्कयते) To injure or kill.
विष्कन्तृ: विष्कन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Going, going in various directions, dispersing. E. वि before स्कदि to go, तृन् aff.; also विस्कन्तृ ।
विष्कन्द: विष्कन्द m. (-न्दः) Going, dispersing.  E. वि before स्कदि to go, अच् aff.; also विस्कन्द ।
विष्कन्न: विष्कन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Gone. 	 2. Gone in various directions, dis-persed.  E. वि before स्कन्द् to go, क्त aff.
विष्कम्भ: विष्कम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. The first of the twenty-seven astronomical periods, called Yogās or Yoga star of the first lunar mansion. 	 2. Obstacle, hindrance, impediment, resistance. 	 3. Spreading, extension. 	 4. Act, doing any thing. 	 5. A posture of the devotees called Yogīs. 6. One of the performers at a dramatic entertainment, either an actor who in the intervals of the scenes explains to the audience the progress of the story, or one or two of the personages of the drama, who do the same in a soliloquy or dialogue. 	 7. A tree. 	 8. The bolt or bar of a door. 	 9. A post, the roof-tree of a house. 	 10. The diameter of a circle.  E. वि before ष्कभि to stop or hinder, aff. घञ्; or वि + स्कन्भ्-अच्; also with कन् added, विष्कम्भक ।
विष्कम्भक: विष्कम्भक m. (-कः) A Yoga, &c.: see the last.
विष्कम्भिन्: विष्कम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) Obstructive, impeding. 	 m. (-म्भी) The bolt or bar of a door.  E. विष्कम्भ obstruction, and इनि aff.
विष्किर: विष्किर m. (-रः) 	 1. A bird in general. 	 2. Pulling or tearing to pieces. 	 3. A cock.  E. वि before कॄ to scatter, and क aff., with सुट् aug.
विष्ट: विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Entered, penetrated, pervaded. 	 f. (-ष्टा) Fæces. E. विष् to pervade, aff. क्त ।
विष्टप: विष्टप mn. (-पः-पं) A world.  E. विश् to enter, (into which,) कपन् aff., तुट् aug.; also विष्टभ ।
विष्टभ: विष्टभ n. (-भं) A world.  E. विश् to pervade, अभच् aff., the vowel unchan-ged; deriv. irr.
विष्टब्ध: विष्टब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 	 1. Hindered, obstructed. 	 2. Stayed, fixed, firm, well-supported. 	 3. Placed in or upon. 	 4. Paralysed, made stiff or motionless.  E. वि before स्तभि to stop, क्त aff.
विष्टम्भ: विष्टम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. Impediment, hindrance, obstacle. 	 2. Stopping, stay-ing. 	 3. Placing in or upon. 	 4. A disease, obstruction of urine or fæces, ischury, constipation. 	 5. Paralysis, loss of motion.  E. वि before स्तभि to stop or hinder, aff. घञ् ।
विष्टम्भिन्: विष्टम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 	 1. Stopping, impeding, what hinders or obstructs. 	 2. Checking, (as perspiration,) chilling. 	 3. Making motionless.  E. वि before स्तभि to stop, णिनि aff.
विष्टर: विष्टर m. (-रः) 	 1. A tree. 	 2. A handful of Kuśa or sacred grass. 	 3. A seat, a stool, a chair, a couch, &c. 	 4. The seat of the Brāhman, either real or in effigy, as presiding at a sacrifice. 	 5. A bed. 	 6. A seat made of twenty-five straws of Kuśa grass tied up in a sheaf. E. वि before स्तृ to spread, aff. अप् and स changed to ष ।
विष्टरश्रवस्: विष्टरश्रवस् m. (-वाः) VISHṆU.  E. विष्टर a tree, श्रु to hear, aff. असुन् ।
विष्टरस्थ: विष्टरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Sitting on a seat, or reclining on a bed of leaves.  E. विष्टर and स्थ who stays.
विष्टार: विष्टार m. (-रः) A form of metre, a species of the order termed Panktī, consisting of a verse of four lines, the first and last of which consist of eight syllables each, and the second and third of twelve each.  E. वि before स्तृ to spread, aff. घञ्, and स changed to ष ।
विष्टि: विष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Working, labouring, a workman. 	 f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. Unpaid labour, working without wages. 	 2. Occupation, act, action. 3. Hire, wages. 	 4. The seventh of the variable Karaṇas, or astro-logical periods so termed, each answering to half a lunar day. 	 5. Sending, dispatching. 	 6. Consigning to torture, casting into hell, &c.  E. विश् to enter, (into pain by it,) and क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.
विष्ठल: विष्ठल n. (-लं) A place situated remote or apart.  E. वि implying apart, स्थल a place, and स changed to ष ।
विष्ठा: विष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) 	 1. Fæces, ordure, excrement. 	 2. The belly.  E. वि before स्था to stay, (in the intestines,) affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
विष्णु: विष्णु m. (-ष्णुः) VISHṆU, one of the three principal Hindu deities, and the preserver of the world: during the periods of temporary anni-hilation, he is supposed to sleep on the waters floating on the serpent Śesha: BRAHMĀ is fabled to have sprung from a lotus, which originally grew from the navel of VISHṆU, and the holy river Ganges is said to spring from his foot: the different Avatārs are considered as emanations of this deity, and in KRISHṆA, he is supposed to have been really and wholly incarnate: LAKSHMĪ is his wife, and he is usually represented as a mild and benevolent deity. 	 2. AGNI or fire. 	 3. One of the demigods called Vasus. 	 4. A pure or pious man. 	 5. The name of an ancient law-giver.  E. विश् to enter or pervade, (the universe,) नुक् Unādi aff.
विष्णुक्रान्ता: विष्णुक्रान्ता f. (-न्ता) A flower, (Clitorea ternatea.)  E. विष्णु VISHṆU, and क्रान्त overcome. “अपराजिता ।”
विष्णुगुप्त: विष्णुगुप्त m. (-प्तः) The saint KAUṆḌILYA.  E. विष्णु, गुप्त hidden, having been concealed by VISHṆU when pursued by ŚIVA, whom he had incensed.
विष्णुगृह: विष्णुगृह n. (-हं) The name of a city or country; also Stambapurī.  E. विष्णु, गृह residence.
विष्णुदैवत्या: विष्णुदैवत्या f. (-त्या) The eleventh and twelfth lunar day of each fort-night.  E. विष्णु VISHṆU, and दैवत्य divinity.
विष्णुपद: विष्णुपद n. (-दं) 	 1. The sky, heaven, atmosphere. 	 2. The sea of milk. 	 3. A lotus. 	 f. (-दी) 	 1. The Ganges. 	 2. One of the twelve Sankrāntis or periods, at which the sun enters a sign of the zodiac, especially the first sign after the equinox.  E. विष्णु, and पद abode, or foot; where VISHṆU resides or rests, or proceeding from his foot.
विष्णुप्रीति: विष्णुप्रीति f. (-तिः) Land granted rent-free to a BRĀHMANA for the main-tenance of VISHNU'S worship.
विष्णुरथ: विष्णुरथ m. (-थः) Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VISHṆU.  E. विष्णु, and रथ car or conveyance.
विष्णुलिङ्गी: विष्णुलिङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A quail.  E. विष्णु VISHṆU, and लिङ्ग a mark, ङीप् diminutive aff.
विष्णुवल्लभ: विष्णुवल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Beloved by VISHṆU. 	 f. (-भा) 	 1. A plant, (Echites caryophyllata.) 	 2. A small fragrant shrub, (Ocymum sanctum.) 	 3. LAKSHMĪ.  E. विष्णु VISHṆU, वल्लभ the beloved.
विष्णुवाहन: विष्णुवाहन m. (-नः) Garuḍa the bird and vehicle of VISHṆU.
विष्पन्द: विष्पन्द m. (-न्दः) Throbbing, beating.  E. वि before स्पन्दि to go, अच् aff.
विष्फार: विष्फार m. (-रः) The twang of a bow.  E. वि before स्फर् or स्फुर् to expand, aff. घञ्; in the latter, आ is substituted for the vowel, and स is changed to ष; also विस्फार ।
विष्य: विष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Deserving death by poison.  E. विष venom, यत् aff.
विष्यन्द: विष्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Flowing, issuing, trickling.  E. वि before ष्यदि to go, शानच् aff.; also read विस्यन्द ।
विष्यन्दमान: विष्यन्दमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flowing, trickling.  E. वि before ष्यदि to go, शानच् aff.; also read विस्यन्दमान ।
विष्व: विष्व mfn. (-ष्वः-ष्वा-ष्वं) Injurious, mischievous.  E. विष् to pervade, Unādi aff. व ।
विष्वक्: विष्वक् Ind. Every way, all around: see विष्वच् ।
विष्वक्सेन: विष्वक्सेन m. (-नः) VISHṆU. 	 f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Priyangu. E. विष्वक् every where, सेना an army.
विष्वक्सेनप्रिया: विष्वक्सेनप्रिया f. (-या) 	 1. A sort of yam, (Dioscorea.) 	 2. LAKSHMI. E. विष्वक्सेन VISHNU, and प्रिया beloved by, sacred to.
विष्वग्गत: विष्वग्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone all about, spread, extended.  E. विष्वक्, गत gone.
विष्वग्गति: विष्वग्गति f. (-तिः) Going all about.  E. विष्वक्, and गति going.
विष्वच्: विष्वच् or विष्वञ्च् mfn. (-ष्वङ्-षूची-ष्वक्) 	 1. Going every where, all-pervading. 	 2. Separating into parts, different. 	 n. (-ष्वक्) The equinox.  E. विषु variously, (in various directions,) or equally, अञ्च् to go, क्विन् aff.; it is also written, but less accurately विश्वच् ।
विष्वणन: विष्वणन n. (-नं) Food, eating.  E. वि before स्वन् to sound, (with the lips, to smack the lips,) and ल्युट् aff. “षत्वणत्वे ।”
विष्वद्र्यच्: विष्वद्र्यच् or द्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्) Going every where.  E. विष्वच् every where, with अद्री augment.
विष्वाण: विष्वाण m. (-णः) Eating, food.  E. वि, स्वन् to sound, aff. घञ् । “षत्वणत्वे ।”
विसञ्ज्ञ: विसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Lifeless, bereft of sense.  E. वि priv., संज्ञा sense.
विसंज्ञ: विसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Lifeless, bereft of sense.  E. वि priv., संज्ञा sense.
विसंयुक्त: विसंयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Separated. 	 2. Omitting.  E. वि, संयुक्त joined.
विसंयोग: विसंयोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Separation. 	 2. Omission.  E. वि priv., संयोग union.
विसंवाद: विसंवाद m. (-दः) 	 1. Disappointing, deceiving, falsifying one's word, deceiving by a false affirmation or not keeping a promise. 	 2. Con-tradiction, disagreement.  E. वि implying reverse, संवाद agreement.
विसंवादिन्: विसंवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 	 1. Cunning, crafty, fraudulent. 	 2. Dis-puting.  E. विसंवाद, and इनि aff.
विस्: विस् r. 4th cl. (विस्यति) 	 1. To throw, to send. 	 2. To put forth.
विस: विस n. (-सं) The film or fibres of the stalk of the water-lily.  E. विस् to send, to put forth, aff. क ।
विसकण्ठिका: विसकण्ठिका f. (-का) A small crane.  E. विस the fibres of the lotus-stalk, aff. अच्, कण्ठ the throat, कन् aff., fem. form, implying comparison.
विसङ्कट: विसङ्कट m. (-टः) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. The Ingudi tree.  E. वि and सम before कट् to encompass, अच् aff.
विसङ्गत: विसङ्गत f. (-ता) Inconsistent, not in harmony.
विसच्छेद: विसच्छेद m. (-दः) A part of the fibres of the lotus.  E. विस, छेद section.
विसज: विसज n. (-जं) A lotus.  E. विस the fibres of the stalk, and ज born.
विसनाभि: विसनाभि m. (-भिः) A quantity of lotuses.  E. विस, नाभि navel.
विसनासिका: विसनासिका f. (-का) A sort of crane.  E. विस, नासिका the nose or beak.
विसपुष्प: विसपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A lotus.  E. विस the stalk, and पुष्प flower.
विसप्रसून: विसप्रसून n. (-नं) A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.)  E. विस, प्रसून a flower.
विसर: विसर m. (-रः) 	 1. A multitude, an assemblage, a flock, a herd, a crowd, 2. Spreading, going forth or abroad.  E. वि before सृ to go, aff. अप् ।
विसर्ग: विसर्ग m. (-र्गः) 	 1. Abandoning, relinquishment, getting rid of or free from any thing. 	 2. Departure, going away. 	 3. Separation. 	 4. Gift, donation. 	 5. Final emancipation or beatitude, exemption from worldly existence. 	 6. Evacuation of excrement, voiding by stool, &c. 	 7. The soft aspirate or Visarga, marked by two perpendicular dots, (ः), and as the substitute for the letters स or र, the termination of various inflections both of nouns and verbs. 	 8. A division of the sun's course, the southern course. 	 9. Light, splendour.  E. वि before सृज् to let go, aff. घञ् ।
विसर्जन: विसर्जन n. (-नं) 	 1. Gift, donation. 	 2. Quitting, relinquishing. 	 3. Send-ing, dispatching. 	 4. Dismissing, sending away. 	 5. Throwing the image, &c. into holy water, as the concluding rite of the festival of a deity.  E. वि before सृज् to let go, aff. ल्युट् ।
विसर्जनीय: विसर्ज्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be left, abandoned, given away, &c. (pro-per or fit to.)  E. वि, सृज् to leave, अनीयर् aff.
विसर्ज्जनीय: विसर्ज्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be left, abandoned, given away, &c. (pro-per or fit to.)  E. वि, सृज् to leave, अनीयर् aff.
विसर्जित: विसर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Abandoned, left. 	 2. Given, given away. 	 3. Dismissed.  E. वि before सृज् to let go, क्त aff.
विसर्ज्जित: विसर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Abandoned, left. 	 2. Given, given away. 	 3. Dismissed.  E. वि before सृज् to let go, क्त aff.
विसर्पण: विसर्पण n. (-णं) 	 1. Spreading, extending. 	 2. Going gently. 	 3. Flying. E. वि before सृप् to go, aff. ल्युट् ।
विसर्पत्: विसर्पत् mfn. (-र्पन्-र्पन्ती-र्पत्) 	 1. Going, going along. 	 2. Flying gently. E. वि before सृप् to go, शतृ aff.
विसर्पिन्: विसर्पिन् mfn. (-र्पी-र्पिणी-र्पि) Spreading over or along, gliding, going gently.  E. वि before, सृप् to go, घिनुण् aff.
विसल: विसल n. (-लं) A shoot, a sprout.  E. वि variously, सल् to go, aff. अच् ।
विसार: विसार m. (-रः) 	 1. A fish. 	 2. Going smoothly, creeping, gliding. 	 n. (-रं) Wood, timber. 	 f. (-री) The region of the winds.  E. वि before सृ to go, and घञ् or ण aff.; or वि priv., and सार pith.
विसारित: विसारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Effected, performed. 	 2. Set on foot, occa-sioned.  E. वि before सृ to go, causal form, aff. क्त ।
विसारिन्: विसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 	 1. Flowing, gliding, creeping. 	 2. Spreading, diffusing. 	 m. (-री) A fish.  E. विसार going smoothly, and इनि aff.
विसिनी: विसिनी f. (-नी) An assemblage of lotus flowers.  E. विस the fibres of the lotus, इनि and ङीप् affs.
विसूचिका: विसूचिका f. (-का) 	 1. Spasmodic cholera. 	 2. Symptom of a disease.  E. वि, सूच् to apprise, ण्वुल् aff.; or विशिष्टा सूचीव इवार्थे कन् ।

वीक्षणीय: वीक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Visible, perceptible.  E. वि, ईक्ष् to see, अनीयर् aff.

वीक्षापन्न: वीक्षापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Astonished, surprised.  E. वीक्ष sight, आपन्न disturbed.
वीक्षित: वीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. 	 n. (-तं) A look, a glance.  E. वि, ईक्ष् to see, aff. क्त ।
