वीङ्खा: वीङ्खा f. (-ङ्खा) 	 1. Going, moving, locomotion, progress, proceeding. 	 2. Dancing. 	 3. A particular mode of moving. 	 4. Cowach, (Carpopo-gon pruriens.) 	 5. One of a horse's paces.  E. वि, इखि to go, aff. घञ् ।
वीचि: वीचि mf. (-चिः-चिः or ची) 	 1. A wave. 	 2. A small or rippling wave. 	 3. Pleasure, delight, happiness. 	 4. Leisure, interval, rest. 	 5. A ray of light. 	 6. Small, little. 	 7. Thoughtlessness.  E. वेञ् to weave, Unādi aff. ईचि, and the radical vowel rejected.
वीचिमालिन्: वीचिमालिन् m. (-ली) The ocean.  E. वीचि a wave, माला a necklace, aff. इनि ।
वीज्: वीज् r. 10th cl. (वीजयति-ते) To fan, to cool by fanning.
वीज: वीज n. (-जं) 	 1. Seed, (of plants, &c.) 	 2. Cause, origin in general. 	 3. Semen virile. 	 4. Receptacle, place of deposit or preparation. 	 5. Truth, divine truth, as the seed or cause of being. 	 6. Marrow. 	 7. Algebra, analysis. 	 8. The mystical letter or syllable which forms the essential part of the Mantra of any deity. 	 9. The origin of the business of a drama.  E. वि variously, जन् be born or produced, (from it,) aff. ड, and the vowel made long; or व्येञ् to cover, aff. क्विप्, वी covering, जन् to be born, aff. ड; or वि implying possession, ई LAKSHMĪ or prosperity, जन् to be produced, (by it,) with the same affix: there are other derivations.
वीजक: वीजक m. (-कः) The common citron, (Citrus medica.) 	 n. (-कं) Seed. E. वीज seed, and कन् aff.
वीजकोश: वीजकोश m. (-शः) 	 1. The seed-vessel of the lotus. 	 2. Any seed-vessel. 	 f. (-शी) A Pod, a legume.  E. विज seed, and कोश or कोष receptacle; whence also वीजकोष m. (-षः) वीजकोषी f. (-षी) &c.
वीजगणित: वीजगणित n. (-तं) Algebra.  E. वीज, and गणित calculation.
वीजगुप्ति: वीजगुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) A legume, a pod.  E. वीज seed, गुप्ति concealment.
वीजतस्: वीजतस् Ind. From or according to the seed.  E. वीज, and तसि aff.
वीजन: वीजन n. (-नं) 	 1. A fan. 	 2. Fanning. 	 3. Thing, substance. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A sort of pheasant. 	 2. The ruddy goose.  E. वीज, ल्युट् aff.
वीजपुष्प: वीजपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 	 1. Common citron. 	 2. A thorny plant, (Vangueria spinosa.)  E. वीज a seed, and पुष्प a flower.
वीजपुष्पिका: वीजपुष्पिका f. (-का) A sort of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus sorghum.) E. वीज a seed, पुष्प a flower, कन् aff., fem. form.
वीजपूर: वीजपूर m. (-रः) Common citron or a variety, (Citrus medica.)  E. वीज a seed, and पूर what is full of.
वीजपूर्ण: वीजपूर्ण m. (-र्णः) Common citron, or according to some authorities, a large kind of lime.  E. वीज seed, and पूर्ण filled.
वीजप्रद: वीजप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Sowing seed, &c. 	 m. (-दः) Generating, or a generator.  E. वीज, and प्रद what gives.
वीजप्ररोह: वीजप्ररोह m. (-हः) Growing from seed.  E. वीज, and प्ररोह growing.
वीजमातृका: वीजमातृका f. (-का) The pericarp or seed-vessel of the lotus.  E. वीज seed, and मातृका parent.
वीजरुह: वीजरुह mfn. (-हः-हा-र्हं) Growing from seed. 	 m. (-हः) Grain, corn. E. वीज seed, and रुह what grows.
वीजवत्: वीजवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Who or what has seed.  E. वीज, and मतुप् aff.
वीजवर: वीजवर m. (-रः) Kidney-bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.)  E. वीज seed, and वर what screens.
वीजसू: वीजसू f. (-सूः) The earth.  E. वीज seed, and सू parent.
वीजा: वीजा Ind. By or with seed, sowing with seed.  E. वीज, and डाच् aff.
वीजाकृत: वीजाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ploughed or harrowed after sowing, (a field, &c.)  E. वीज a seed, and कृत made, with डाच् added to the first.
वीजित: वीजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sown with, having for seed. 	 2. Fanned, cooled by the wind proceeding from a fan.  E. वीज, इतच् aff.; or वीज् to fan, क्त aff.
वीजिन्: वीजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Having seed, origin, &c. 	 m. (-जी) A father, a progenitor.  E. वीज semen, and इनि aff.
वीजोत्कृष्ट: वीजोत्कृष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Good seed.  E. वीज, and उत्कृष्ट excellent.
वीजोदक: वीजोदक n. (-कं) Hail.  E. वीज origin or original, उदक water.
वीज्य: वीज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) 	 1. Sprung from a respectable family. 	 2. Sprung from seed.  E. वीज seed or origin, and यत् aff.
वीज्यमान: वीज्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fanned.  E. वीज् to fan, pass. v., शानच् aff.
वीटा: वीटा f. (-टा) A small piece of wood struck with a stick in kind of game played by boys.
वीटिका: वीटिका f. (-का) 	 1. The betel-plant, (Piper betel.) 	 2. The preparation of the Areca nut with spices and chunam, and enveloped in the leaf of the Piper betel, Betel, Pāun. 	 3. A tye, a fastening.  E. वि, इट् to go, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form; also with इन् or ङीप् aff. वीटि or वीटी ।
वीणा: वीणा f. (-णा) 	 1. The Vīṇā, or Indian lute, a fretted instrument of the guitar kind, usually having seven wires or strings, and a large gourd at each end of the finger board; the extent of the instru-ment is two octaves: it is supposed to be the invention of NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and has many varieties, enumer-ated according to the number of strings, &c. 	 2. Lightning.  E. वी to go, &c., Unādi aff. न, form irr.; or अज्-नक् वीभावः पृषो० णत्वम् ।
वीणादण्ड: वीणादण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The neck of a Vina.  E. वीणा a lute, दण्ड a stick.
वीणानुबन्ध: वीणानुबन्ध m. (-न्धः) The tie of a lute or lower part of the tail piece, where the wires are fixed.  E. वीणा the lute, अनुबन्ध appendage, tie,
वीणावाद: वीणावाद m. (-दः) A player on the Vīṇā, a lutanist.  E. वीणा a lute, and वाद who causes to speak or sound; also with कन् added, वीणावादक ।
वीणास्य: वीणास्य m. (-स्यः) NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and inventor of the Vīṇā or lute.  E. वीणा, and आस्य the countenance.
वीत: वीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Gone, departed. 	 2. Exempt or freed from. 	 3. Loosed, let go, unbound. 	 4. Tranquil, quiet, tame. 	 5. Excepted. 	 6. Approved, liked, accepted. 	 7. Unfit for war. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A horse or elephant, untrained to or unfit for war. 	 2. Goading an ele-phant.  E. वी to go, aff. क्त ।
वीतंस: वीतंस m. (-सः) 	 1. A cage, a chain or net, &c. for confining birds or beasts. 	 2. An enclosure for tranquillising or taming them, an aviary, a menagerie. 	 3. A place for keeping game, a preserve.  E. वि before तसि to adorn, aff. घञ्; the vowel of the prefix made long.
वीतकल्मष: वीतकल्मष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Free from sin or soil.  E. वीत, and कल्मष sin.
वीतकाम: वीतकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Free from desire.  E. वीत, काम desire.
वीतदम्भ: वीतदम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) Humble, lowly.  E. वीत gone, दम्भ pride, &c.
वीतन: वीतन m. DU. (-नी) The sides of cartilages of the larynx.  E. वि + तन्-अच्-पृषो० दीर्घ ।
वीतभय: वीतभय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fearless, undaunted.  E. वीत and भय fear.
वीतराग: वीतराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 	 1. Exempt from passions or affections. 	 2. Bleached, colourless. 	 m. (-गः) 	 1. Any sage with subdued passions. 2. A Bauddha deified sage.  E. वीत gone, and राग passions, desire.
वीतविरुद्धबुद्धि: वीतविरुद्धबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Peaceable, without hostile intentions. E. वीत, विरुद्ध opposed, and बुद्धि fear.
वीतशङ्क: वीतशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearless.  E. वीत, and शङ्क fear.
वीतशोक: वीतशोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Free from care or sorrow. 	 m. (-कः) The Aśoka tree, (Jonesia Aśoka.)  E. वीत gone, and शोक sorrow.
वीतस्पृह: वीतस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Free from desire.  E. वीत, and स्पृहा desire.
वीति: वीति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Going, moving, motion. 	 2. Eating. 	 3. Engendering, producing. 	 4. Cleaning, cleansing. 	 5. Light, lustre. 	 6. Enjoyment. m. (-तिः) A horse.  E. वी to go, क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.
वीतिहोत्र: वीतिहोत्र m. (-त्रः) 	 1. AGNI. 	 2. The sun.  E. वीति a horse, होत्र clarified butter, the usual offering or oblation with fire; also वीतिहात्रक ।
वीतोत्तर: वीतोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unable or disinclined to reply, having no answer.  E. वीत, and उत्तर answer.
वीथि: वीथि f. (-थिः or थी) 	 1. A road. 	 2. A row, a line. 	 3. A terrace in front of a house. 	 4. A stall, a shop. 	 5. A sort of drama, in one act, and by one or by two performers, the dramatic narration of an amatory story or intrigue.  E. विथ् to ask or beg, aff. इन्, and the vowel made long; also ङीष् optionally added, with कन् aff., fem. form, वीथिका ।
वीथ्यङ्ग: वीथ्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Dialogue, &c., suited to, and constituting the dramatic entertainment called Vithi, though employed in other kinds, as quibble, equivoque, jest, abuse, and the like.  E. वीथि, अङ्ग a part.
वीध्र: वीध्र mfn. (-ध्रः-ध्रा-ध्रं) Clean, clear, pure. 	 n. (-ध्रं) 	 1. The sky. 	 2. Wind. 	 3. Fire.  E. वि, इन्ध् to shine, Unādi aff. रक्, the first consonant rejected.
वीनाह: वीनाह m. (-हः) The top or cover of a well.  E. वि before नह् to bind, aff. घञ्; also विनाह ।

The last Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present æra. 	 4. An actor, a mime. 	 5. A flower, (Nerium odorum.) 	 6. Fire. 	 7. Sacrificial fire. 	 8. An epithet of VISHṆU. 	 9. A son. 	 10. A husband. 	 f. (-रा) 	 1. A matron, a wife and mother. 	 2. A sort of perfume, commonly Murā. 	 3. A medicinal root, commonly Kshira-kākolī. 	 4. A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) 	 5. A drug (Elabāluka.) 	 6. Plantain tree. 	 7. A sort of Asclepias, (A rosea.) 	 8. Opposite-leaved fig tree. 	 9. A sort of Convolvulus, (C. paniculatus, the white and dark kind.) 	 10. A small tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 	 11. Spirituous liquor or a particular kind of it. 	 12. The aloe. 	 13. A plant, commonly Atis. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. A reed, (Arundo tibialis.) 	 2. The root of the ginger plant. 	 3. Pepper. 	 4. Rice-gruel. 	 5. The root of the Costus speciosus. 	 6. The root of the Andropogon muricatum.  E. अज् to go, and वी substi-tuted for the root, रक् Unādi aff.; or वीर् to be powerful, aff. अच् ।
वीरजयन्तिका: वीरजयन्तिका f. (-का) 	 1. A war-dance, a dance performed by soldiers after a victory or on going to battle. 	 2. War, battle.  E. वीर a hero, जि to conquer, झच् aff., fem. form, and कन् added.
वीरण: वीरण n. (-णं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. A side glance. 	 2. A deep place.  E. वि a bird, ईर् to go, ल्युट् aff.
वीरतर: वीरतर n. (-र) 	 1. A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) 	 m. (-रः) 1. An arrow. 	 2. A great hero.  E. वीर powerful, तरप् aff.
वीरतरु: वीरतरु m. (-रुः) 	 1. A large tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna, Rox.) 	 2. A shrub, (Barleria longifolia, Rox.)  E. वीर a hero, and तरु the tree.
वीरत्रा: वीरत्रा f. (-ता) Heroism.  E. तल् added to वीर; also with त्व aff. वीरत्वं ।
वीरधन्वन्: वीरधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) KĀMA or CUPID.  E. वीर a hero, and धन्वन् a bow.
वीरन्धर: वीरन्धर m. (-रः) 	 1. A peacock. 	 2. Fighting with wild beasts. 	 3. A lea-ther cuirass or jacket. 	 4. The name of a river.  E. वीर a hero, धृ to hold, खच् aff.
वीरपत्नी: वीरपत्नी f. (-त्नी) The wife of a hero.  E. वीर a hero, and पत्नी the wife.
वीरपाण: वीरपाण n. (-णं) The drink of warriors, taken during the battle for re-freshment, or before it, to elevate courage.  E. वीर a hero, and पान drink; the न is optionally changed whence it also occurs वीरपान ।
वीरभद्र: वीरभद्र m. (-द्रः) 	 1. A horse fit for the Aśwamedha sacrifice. 	 2. A distinguished hero. 	 3. A fragrant grass, “वीरण” 4. One of ŚIVA'S attendants. 	 5. One of the RŪDRAS.  E. वीर a hero, भद्र auspicious.
वीरभद्रक: वीरभद्रक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
वीरभार्या: वीरभार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) The wife of a hero.  E. वीर a hero, and भाय्या a wife.
वीरभार्य्या: वीरभार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) The wife of a hero.  E. वीर a hero, and भाय्या a wife.
वीरमातृ: वीरमातृ f. (-ता) The mother of a hero.  E. वीर and मातृ mother.
वीरमुद्रिका: वीरमुद्रिका f. (-का) An ornament or ring worn on the middle toe. E. वीर a hero, मुद्रा a seal, कन् aff.
वीररेणु: वीररेणु m. (-णुः) A name of BHIMASENA.  E. वीर a hero, and रेणु dust.
वीरवत्: वीरवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a champion or hero. 	 f. (-ती) A woman whose husband and sons are living.  E. वीर, मतुप् poss. aff.
वीरवत्सा: वीरवत्सा f. (-त्सा) The mother of a hero.  E. वीर, वत्स a child, (of whom.)
वीरविप्लावक: वीरविप्लावक m. (-कः) A Brāhmana who performs his oblations with money, procured from the lower or Sūdra tribe.  E. वीर sacrificial fire, वि before प्लु to go, ण्वुल् aff.
वीरवृक्ष: वीरवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. The marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.) 2. A large tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.) 	 3. A sort of grain, (Andro-pogon or Holcus sorghum.)  E. वीर strong, वृक्ष a tree.
वीरसू: वीरसू f. (-सूः) 	 1. The mother of a hero. 	 2. The mother of a male child. E. वीर a hero, and सू mother.
वीरसेन: वीरसेन m. (-नः) The father of NALA Rājā.  E. वीर a hero, सेना a host.
वीरसेनज: वीरसेनज m. (-जः) NALA, a prince and hero of several celebrated poems as the Naishadha, Nalodaya, &c.  E. वीरसेन, and ज born.
वीरस्कन्ध: वीरस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A buffalo.  E. वीर powerful स्कन्ध the shoulder.
वीरहन्: वीरहन् m. (-हा) A Brāhman, who has suffered the sacred domestic fire to become extinct, either from carelessness, impiety, or absence.  E. वीर sacrificial fire, and हन् who destroys.
वीराशंसन: वीराशंसन n. (-नं) 	 1. The post of danger, the place in battle which is most perilous and exposed. 	 2. Keeping watch. 	 3. A forlorn hope. E. वीर a hero, आङ् before शसि to wish, aff. ल्युट् ।
वीरासन: वीरासन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sleeping out in the open air, a bivouac. 	 2. A field of battle. 	 3. A kneeling posture.  E. वीर and आसन sitting.

वेगानिल: वेगानिल m. (-लः) 	 1. Breeze caused by velocity. 	 2. Violent gust.

वेणि: वेणि f. (-णिः-णी) Unornamented and braided hair; the hair as worn especially by widows and woman whose husbands are absent, when it is simply collected from the forehead and temples as well as the back of the head, and twisted together into a single braid, which is when suffered to fall like a tail down the back, no sort of ornament being worn on the head; the term is also applied gene-rally to any braid of hair, or to a braid of the long hair, of which many are made, and the whole are then twisted together, and worn as a sort of rose or flower at the back of the head. 	 f. (-णिः) 	 1. Assemblage of water, as the conflux of rivers, &c., in that case it rather implies their parallel course, ending in a common point of union; as at Allāhābād, where the GANGĀ, YAMUNĀ, and as is supposed, the SARASWATĪ, all coming from the north, unite; this and other similar places, thence receive the name of Trivenī. 	 2. Weaving. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. Stream, current. 	 2. A ewe. 	 3. A sort of grass, (Andropogon serratum.)  E. वी to go, Unādi aff. नि, and in some cases ङीप् added; or वेण-इन् ।
वेणिका: वेणिका f. (-का) Braided hair.  E. वेणी as above, कन् fem. form, added.
वेणीर: वेणीर m. (-रः) The soap-berry, (Sapindus detergens.)  E. वेण-इरन् aff.
वेणु: वेणु m. (-णुः) 	 1. A bamboo. 	 2. A flute. 	 3. A king so named.  E. वी substi-tuted for अज् to go, aff. नु, or वन् to sound, कु aff.; or वेण्-उण् ।

वेणुकर्कर: वेणुकर्क्कर m. (-रः) A thorny plant, commonly Karir or Karabira.  E. वेणु a bamboo, कर्क्वर hard.
वेणुकर्क्कर: वेणुकर्क्कर m. (-रः) A thorny plant, commonly Karir or Karabira.  E. वेणु a bamboo, कर्क्वर hard.
वेणुध्म: वेणुध्म m. (-ध्मः) A player on a fife or flute.  E. वेणु a bamboo, ध्मा to blow, aff. क ।
वेणुनिस्रुति: वेणुनिस्रुति m. (-तिः) The sugar-cane.  E. वेणु a bamboo, निस्रुति oozing.
वेणुपत्री: वेणुपत्री f. (-त्री) A plant, one synonime of which, Hingupatri, appears to relate to the Asafœtida or some similar plant, whilst the cor-responding compound Bānspatra both in Hindi and Bengali, is applied to a species of Amaranthus, (A lanceifolius, Rox., or or A. atro-purpureus, Rox.)  E. वेणु a bamboo, and पत्र a leaf, fem. aff. ङीष्, having long slender leaves, like those of the bamboo.
वेणुवाद: वेणुवाद m. (-दः) A player on a flute.  E. वेणु a flute, &c. वाद who sounds.
वेतन: वेतन n. (-नं) 	 1. Hire, wages. 	 2. Livelihood, subsistence. 	 2. Silver. E. वी to go, तनन् Unādi aff.
वेतनदान: वेतनदान n. (-नं) Hiring, paying wages.  E. वेतन and दान giving.
वेतनादान: वेतनादान n. (-नं) Non-payment of wages.  E. वेतन and अदान not giving.
वेतस: वेतस mf. (-सः-सी) 	 1. The ratan, (Calamus rotang.) 	 2. The citron. E. वेञ् to sew or weave, Unādi aff. असच्, तुक् augment.
वेतसपत्र: वेतसपत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. The leaf of the ratan. 	 2. A lancet.  E. वेतस, पत्र a leaf.
वेतस्वत्: वेतस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Reedy, abounding in reeds or canes, (a place or soil, &c.)  E. वेतस् a cane, डवतुप् aff.
वेताल: वेताल m. (-लः) 	 1. A spirit, a goblin, especially one haunting cemeter-ies and animating dead bodies. 	 2. A door-keeper.  E. व in the seventh case वे in air, and ताल habitation, fixation, from तल् to fix, aff. घञ् ।

वेत्र: वेत्र m. (-त्रः) A reed, a cane, the ratan. 	 n. (-त्रं) A stick, a staff.  E. वि to go, Unādi aff. त्रल ।
वेत्रकीय: वेत्रकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Abounding with reeds or canes.  E. वेत्र a cane, छ aff., and कुकक् augment.
वेत्रधर: वेत्रधर m. (-रः) 	 1. A door-keeper, a warder. 	 2. A staff bearer, a mace-bearer.  E. वेत्र a staff, and धर having.
वेत्रधारक: वेत्रधारक m. (-कः) 	 1. A door-keeper, a warder, a porter. 	 2. A mace-bearer.  E. वेत्र a stick, and धारक having.

वेत्रासन: वेत्रासन n. (-नं) 	 1. A small cot or oblong low couch of basket work; when furnished with bamboo sticks and a pole, it forms the com-mon Duli or litter. 	 2. A cane-seat.  E. वेत्र a cane, आसन a seat.
वेत्रिन्: वेत्रिन् m. (-त्री) A porter, a door-keeper.  E. वेत्र a stick, and इनि aff.
वेथ्: वेथ्(ऋ)वेथृ r. 1st cl. (वेथते) To ask or beg.
वेद: वेद m. (-दः) 	 1. A Veda, the generic term for the sacred writings or scripture of the Hindus; supposed to have been revealed by BRAHMĀ, and after being preserved by tradition for a consider-able period, to have been arranged in the present from by VYĀSA; the principle Vedas are three in number, the RICH, YAJUS, and SĀMA, to which a fourth, the ATHARVA, is usually added, and the ITIHĀSA and PURĀNAS, or ancient history and mythology, are sometimes considered as a fifth. The Vedas are regarded as a direct revelation from the deity and are called Śhruti, (what is heard,) to distinguish them from Smritī or sacred lore of human origin; the several sages to whom verses or hymns of the Vedas are ascribed are regarded as seers. (द्रष्टारः) and not as composers, (स्रष्टारः) 	 2. Metre. 	 3. Gloss, comment, explanation. 	 4. Knowledge. 5. VISHṆU.  E. विद् to know, (duty and religion from it,) aff. घञ् ।
वेदकौलेयक: वेदकौलेयक m. (-कः) ŚIVA.  E. वेद the Vedas, and कुल race, ढक् aff.
वेदगर्भ: वेदगर्भ m. (-र्भः) 	 1. BRAHMĀ. 	 2. A Brāhman.  E. वेद the Vedas, and गर्भ embryo or womb, figuratively for origin.
वेदगुप्ति: वेदगुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) The preservation of the Vedas by the Brāhmanical tribe.  E. वेद a Veda, and गुप्ति concealment.
वेदज्ञ: वेदज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A Brāhman skilled in the Vedas.  E. वेद, ज्ञ who knows.
वेदतत्त्व: वेदतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The true doctrine or substance of the Vedas.  E. वेद and तत्त्व truth.
वेदत्रय: वेदत्रय nf. (-यं-यी) The three first Vedas.  E. वेद and त्रय triad.
वेदन: वेदन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Sensation, perception, knowledge conveyed by the senses. 	 2. Pain, smart, agony. 	 3. Knowledge. 	 4. The ceremony of holding the ends of a mantle, to be observed by a Śudra female, on her marriage with a man of either of the first three classes. 5. Presenting, delivering. 	 6. Acquisition, wealth. 	 f. (-नी) The true skin or cutis.  E. विद् to know, &c., ल्युट् aff.
वेदनाद: वेदनाद m. (-दः) Sound of chaunting or repeating the Vedas.  E. वेद, and नाद sound.
वेदनिन्दक: वेदनिन्दक m. (-कः) 	 1. An atheist, a disbeliever. 	 2. A Jaina or Bauddha, or any seceder from the belief of the divine origin and character of the Vedas.  E. वेद scripture, निन्दक defaming, disrespecting.
वेदनिन्दा: वेदनिन्दा f. (-न्दा) Reviling the Vedas, heresy.  E. वेद, निन्दा blame.
वेदनीय: वेदनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be known or perceived. 	 2. To be, or to be made known.  E. विद् to know, अनीयर् aff.
वेदपारग: वेदपारग m. (-गः) A Brāhman skilled in the Vedas.  E. वेद, पारग who crosses.
वेदपुण्य: वेदपुण्य n. (-ण्यं) The sanctity of the Vedas.  E. वेद, and पुण्य holiness.

वेदमुख्या: वेदमुख्या f. (-ख्या) A sort of insect, the winged-bug.
वेदय: वेदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who or what knows or obtains.  E. विद् to know, श aff.
वेदरक्षण: वेदरक्षण n. (-णं) The conservation of the Vedas, as a duty of the Brāh-manical order.  E. वेद a Veda, and रक्षण preserving.
वेदवचन: वेदवचन n. (-नं) A text of the Veda.  E. वेद, and वचन dictum.
वेदवाक्य: वेदवाक्य n. (-क्यं) Text of the Veda.  E. वेद, and वाक्य sentence.
वेदवास: वेदवास m. (-सः) A Brāhman.  E. वेद a Veda, and वास above.
वेदविद्: वेदविद् m. (-विद or वित्) A Brāhman versed in the Vedas.  E. वेद the Vedas, विद् to know, क्विप् aff.

वेदवृत्त: वेदवृत्त n. (-त्तं) The doctrine of the Vedas.  E. वेद, and वृत्त done.

वेदशब्द: वेदशब्द m. (-ब्दः) A word or term in the Vedas.  E. वेद, and शब्द a sound.
वेदशास्त्र: वेदशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) The Vedas or any part of them.  E. वेद, and शास्त्र an inspired writing, a scripture.
वेदसंहिता: वेदसंहिता f. (-ता) A collection of the formulæ of the Vedas.  E. वेद, and संहिता a compendium.
वेदस्: वेदस् m. (-दाः) The Vedas collectively.  E. विद् to know, असुन् aff.

वेदसम्मत: वेदसम्मत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conformable to the Vedas.  E. वेद, and सम्मत concurrent.

वेदाधिगम: वेदाधिगम m. (-मः) Perusal or study of the Vedas.  E. वेद, अधिगम going over or through.
वेदाध्ययन: वेदाध्ययन n. (-नं) Study of the Vedas.  E. वेद, and अध्ययन reading.
वेदाध्ययिन्: वेदाध्ययिन् m. (-यी) A student of the Vedas.  E. वेद, and अध्ययिन् who reads.
वेदाध्यापक: वेदाध्यापक m. (-कः) A teacher of the Vedas.  E. वेद and अध्यापक teacher.
वेदाध्यापन: वेदाध्यापन n. (-नं) Teaching the Vedas.  E. वेद and अध्यापन teaching.
वेदान्त: वेदान्त m. (-न्तः) The theological part of the Vedas; considered collec-tively it is contained in the many numerous passages or chapters of the Vedas termed Upanishads, which inculcate an abstract and speculative monotheistical worship, and these have been fur-ther explained and illustrated by later writers: the founder of the school is VYĀSA, and subsequently ŚANKARĀCHĀRYA is its most eminent teacher. वेदान्तग: वेदान्तग m. (-गः) A Vedāntī.  E. वेदान्त, and ग who goes over.
वेदान्तज्ञ: वेदान्तज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A Vedāntī.  E. वेदान्त, and ज्ञ who knows.
वेदान्तिन्: वेदान्तिन् m. (-न्ती) A Vedāntī, a follower of the Vedānta philosophy. E. वेदान्त the theism of the Vedas, and इनि aff.
वेदान्तोपगत: वेदान्तोपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Derived from or produced by the Vedānta. E. वेदान्त and उपगत derived from.
वेदाभ्यास: वेदाभ्यास m. (-सः) 	 1. The repetition of the mystical syllable Om. 	 2. Study of scripture.  E. वेद the Vedas, and अभ्यास exercise.
वेदार: वेदार m. (-रः) A chameleon, a lizard.
वेदि: वेदि f. (-दिः-दी) 	 1. Ground for placing the vessels used at an oblation, or for binding the victim, or lighting the sacrificial fire; it is more or less raised and of various shapes; an alter, &c. 	 2. (-दिः) A Pandit, a teacher. 	 f. (-दिः) A name of SARASWATĪ.  E. विद् to know, &c., Unādi aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added in the fem. form.

वेदिजा: वेदिजा f. (-जा) DRAUPADĪ.  E. वेदि an alter, and ज born; born from sacrificial fire.
वेदित: वेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Set forth, represented, made known.  E. विद् to know, causal from, aff. क्त ।
वेदितव्य: वेदितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be known or ascertained. 	 2. To be made known, to be explained or expounded.  E. विद् to know, causal form, aff. तव्यर् ।
वेदितृ: वेदितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Wise, learned.  E. विद् to know, तृच् aff., with the augment इट् ।
वेदित्व: वेदित्व n. (-त्वं) Knowledge, experience.  E. वेदिन् who knows, त्व aff.; also with तल्, वेदिता ।
वेदिन्: वेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what knows. 	 m. (-दी) 	 1. A Pandit, a learned Brāhman, a teacher. 	 2. BRAHMĀ. 	 n. (-दि) A plant, (Ciss-ampelos hexandra.)  E. विद् to know, aff. णिनि or घिनुण् aff.
वेदीश: वेदीश m. (-शः) BRAHMĀ.  E. वेदी SARASWATĪ, and ईश lord.
वेदोक्त: वेदोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Scriptural, taught or declared in the Vedas. E. वेद the Vedas, and उक्त said.
वेदोदय: वेदोदय m. (-यः) ŚURYA, or the sun.  E. वेद the Veda, (the Sāma Veda,) and उदयं rise, origin; being said to have proceeded from the sun.
वेदोदित: वेदोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taught in the Vedas, scriptural.  E. वेद the Vedas, and उदित spoken, from वद् to speak, with क्त aff.
वेदोपकरण: वेदोपकरण n. (-णं) A subordinate branch of the study of the Vedas: see वेदाङ्ग.  E. वेद्, and उपकरण implement.
वेद्य: वेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 	 1. To be known or ascertained. 	 2. To be explained or taught. 	 3. To be married.  E. विद् to know, ण्यत् aff.

वैजयि: वैजयि m. (-यिः) The third Chakravartī or emperor according to the Jainas.  E. विजया a proper name, and इञ् patronymic aff.
वैजात्य: वैजात्य n. (-त्यं) 	 1. Difference or deviation from ordinary character or conduct. 	 2. Exclusion from caste. 	 3. Difference of caste or species. 4. Looseness, wantonness.  E. वि before जाति species, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
वैजिक: वैजिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Seminal, relating to seed or origin. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. Cause, origin, motive. 	 2. Oil prepared from the Śigru or Morunga. 3. The spiritual cause of existence, soul, spirit. 	 m. (-कः) A young shoot.  E. वीज seed, ठञ् or ठक् aff.
वैज्ञानिक: वैज्ञानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Skilful, clever, proficient.  E. विज्ञान knowledge, &c., aff. ठक् ।
वैडालव्रतिक: वैडालव्रतिक m. (-कः) A hypocrite, a religious impostor, one who under the appearance of piety and virtue is covetous, malicious, and cruel.  E. विडाल a cat, व्रत observance, and ठन् aff.; acting like a cat.
वैण: वैण m. (-णः) A cutter of bamboos, a worker in bamboo-work.  E. वेणु a bamboo, अण् aff., and the primitive final rejected.
वैणव: वैणव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Produced by or made of a bamboo. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. A bamboo staff. 	 2. A worker in bamboo or wicker-work. 	 n. (-वं) Bamboo-seed. 	 f. (-वी) Bamboo-manna.  E. वेणु a bamboo, अण् aff.
वैणविक: वैणविक m. (-कः) A player on a flute.  E. वेणु a pipe, ठक् aff.
वैणिक: वैणिक m. (-कः) A lutanist, a player on a Vinā.  E. वीणा the Vinā, ठक् aff.
वैणुक: वैणुक n. (-कं) A goad or bamboo-pike headed with iron, used to drive an elephant. 	 m. (-कः) A player on a pipe or flute.  E. वेणु a flute, ठक् aff.
वैणुकेय: वैणुकेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Relating or belonging to a bamboo, &c.  E. वेणु a bamboo, and छण् aff., with कुक् augment.
वैण्य: वैण्य m. (-ण्यः) A name of PṚTHU, the fifth sovereign of the solar race. E. वेण the father of this monarch, and यञ् aff.; also read वैन्य.
वैतंसिक: वैतंसिक m. (-कः) A vendor of the flesh or meat, either of beasts or birds E. वीतंस a snare or net, and ठक् aff.
वैतनिक: वैतनिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A hireling, a hired labourer. 	 2. A stipendiary.  E. वेतन wages, ठक् aff.
वैतरणि: वैतरणि f. (-णिः-णी) 	 1. The river of hell. 	 2. Name of a river in the KALINGAS. 	 3. The mother of the Rākshasas.  E. वि various, तरण crossing, aff. इञ् or अण्, and ङीष् aff.; or वि prohibitive, तरणी crossing; or वितरण giving, (liberality in life securing a passage;) or वि priv., तरणी a boat, passed without a boat; the aff. is same.
वैतस: वैतस m. (-सः) A sort of cane, (Calamus fasciculatus.) 	 f. (-सी) 	 1. Per-taining to the cane. 	 2. Humble yielding.  E. वेतस, अण् pleonasm.
वैतान: वैतान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sacrificial, (as fire.) 	 n. (-नं) Oblation with fire. E. वितान the hole in the hearth in which sacred fire is kept, अण् aff.
वैतानिक: वैतानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sacrificial, sacred, (as fire.) 	 n. (-कं) Burnt-offering, especially of clarified butter, as presented daily by the Brāhmans.  E. वितान the hearth, ठक् aff.
वैतानोपासना: वैतानोपासना f. (-ना) The regular presentation of burnt-offering morning and evening.  E. वैतान sacrificial, (fire,) and उपासना service.
वैतालिक: वैतालिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A bard whose duty it is to awaken a chief or prince at dawn with music and song. 	 2. A singer out of tune. 	 3. One who has a demon for a familiar, the servant of a Vetāla.  E. वि privative, &c., ताल tune, अण् aff., and ठक् added.
वैतालीय: वैतालीय m. (-यः) A kind of metre, or tetrastich, the first and third lines of which contain the time of fourteen short syllables, and the second and fourth of sixteen; it admits of some varieties.
वैत्रक: वैत्रक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Cany, reedy, relating to a cane, &c.  E. वेत्र cane, छण् aff. with कुक् aug.; the final of the aff. rejected.
वैत्रकीय: वैत्रकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to a stick or cane.  E. वेत्र a stick, छण् aff.
वैद: वैद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Relating to or connected with a wise man, learned, knowing.  E. विद् who knows. अञ् aff.
वैदग्ध: वैदग्ध n. (-ग्धं) 	 1. Cleverness, skill, dexterity. 	 2. Acuteness, sharpness. 3. Craft, cunning.  E. विदग्ध clever, अण् aff.
वैदग्व्य: वैदग्व्य nf. (-ग्ध्य-ग्धी) 	 1. Cunning, craft. 	 2. Cleverness, dexterity, skill. 2. Knowingness, sharpness, wit.  E. विदग्ध clever, sharp, aff. ष्यञ् ।
वैदर्भ: वैदर्भ n. (-र्भं) Crafty or indirect speech. 	 m. (-र्भः) 	 1. The sovereign of VIDARBHA, the father of DAMAYANTĪ, &c. 	 2. Gum-boil, f. (-र्भी) 1. The law of VIDARBHA, as one by which cousins german were allowed to intermarry in that country, &c. 	 2. The wife of AGASTYA. 	 3. DAMAYANTĪ, the wife of NALA. 	 4. RUKMINĪ; one of KRISHṆA'S wives. 	 3. A particular style of composition.  E. विदर्भ the country so named. and अण् aff. of derivation or production.
वैदल: वैदल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Wicker, of cane, wicker or basket work. 	 n. (-लं) 1. A shallow cup or saucer made of clay usually, though some-times of metal, and sometimes of wood or wicker. 	 2. Any seat or vessel of basket or wicker-work. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A flat unleavened cake, made of flour, &c., with cumin or coriander seeds, and fried in Ghee. 	 2. Any leguminous vegetable or grain, as peas, beans, &c.  E. वि before दल् to divide, aff. अच्, and अण् added.
वैदिक: वैदिक mfn. (-कः-की or का-कं) Scriptural, derived from or conformable to the Vedas. 	 m. (-कः) A Brāhman well-versed in the Vedas. E. वेद, and ठञ् or जिठ् aff.
वैदिकत्व: वैदिकत्व n. (-त्वं) Scriptural character or origin.  E. वैदिक relating to the Vedas, and त्व aff. of the abstract.
वैदिकपाश: वैदिकपाश m. (-शः) One who possesses only a smattering knowledge of the Vedas.
वैदुष्य: वैदुष्य nf. (-ष्यं-षी) Learning, sapience.  E. विद्वस् a learned man, ष्यञ् aff.
वैदूर्य: वैदूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A gem of a dark colour, the lapis lazuli.  E. विदूर said to be the name of a mountain where the stone is found, or a city where it is polished, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैदूर्य्य: वैदूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A gem of a dark colour, the lapis lazuli.  E. विदूर said to be the name of a mountain where the stone is found, or a city where it is polished, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैदेशिक: वैदेशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Foreign, stranger.  E. विदेश, and ठक् aff.
वैदेह: वैदेह m. (-हः) 	 1. A trader by caste or profession. 	 2. An attendant on the women's apartments: see the next. 	 f. (-ही) 	 1. ŚITĀ, the daughter of JANAKA. 	 2. Long-pepper. 	 3. The wife of a trader or woman of the Vaideha caste. 	 4. A sort of pigment, commonly Rochanā.  E. विदेह the country, अण् aff. of origin or production.
वैदेहक: वैदेहक m. (-कः) 	 1. A trader by profession. 	 2. A man of a mixed caste, the offspring of a Vaiśya father and Brāhman mother, whose business is attendance in the women's apartments.  E. विदेह the country, वुञ्. aff.; or वि various, दिह् to collect, (goods, &c.,) aff. ण्वुल् and अण् added; or विदेह a king, the supposed author of rules for merchants, वुञ् aff., or with अण् aff. and ठक् added वैदेहिक ।
वैद्य: वैद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्यी-द्यं) 	 1. Medical, practising or relating to medicine. 	 2. Relating or conformable to the Vedas. 	 m. (-द्यः) 	 1. A physician. 	 2. A tree, (Justicia ganderussa, &c.) 	 3. A learned man. 	 4. A follower of the Vedas, or one well in them. 	 5. A man of a mixed class, the offspring of a Brāhmana by a Vaiśya woman. 	 f. (-द्या) A drug, commonly KĀKOLĪ.  E. वेद the medical or Āyur-Vedas or the Vedas in general, and यञ् or ष्यञ् aff.; or विद्याऽस्त्यस्य अण् ।
वैद्यक: वैद्यक m. (-कः) A physician. 	 n. (-कं) The science of medicine.
वैद्यक्रिया: वैद्यक्रिया f. (-या) The practice of medicine.
वैद्यनाथ: वैद्यनाथ m. (-थः) 	 1. ŚIVA. 	 2. DHANWANTARĪ.  E. वैद्य a physician, नाथ lord.
वैद्यबन्धु: वैद्यबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) Cassia fistula.  E. वेद्य a physician, बन्धु the friend.
वैद्यमातृ: वैद्यमातृ f. (-ता) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.) “वासके”.  E. वैद्य a physi-cian, and मातृ mother.
वैद्यसिंही: वैद्यसिही f. (-ही) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.)  E. वैद्य medical, सिंह pre-eminent, fem. aff. ङीष् ।
वैद्युत: वैद्युत f. (-ती) Proceeding from lightning, electric.
वैध: वैध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) According to rule, preceptive, ritual.  E. विधि, अण् aff.
वैधर्म्म्य: वैधर्म्म्य n. (-र्म्म्यं) 	 1. Irreligion, injustice, impropriety. 	 2. Difference of duty or obligation. 	 3. Difference of characteristic qualities.  E. वि before धर्म्म virtue, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
वैधवेय: वैधवेय m. (-यः) The son of a widow.
वधव्य: वधव्य n. (-व्यं) Widowhood.  E. विधवा, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैधात्र: वैधात्र m. (-त्रः) SANATKUMĀRA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and eldest of the progenitors of mankind.  E. विधातृ BRAHMĀ, and अण् aff. of descent; it is applicable also to the other three sons of the same deity.
वैधिक: वैधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ritual, according to rule, &c.  E. विधि, ठक् aff.
वैधेय: वैधेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 	 1. Foolish, ignorant, an idiot, a fool. 	 2. Pres-cribed.  E. विधेय performance of religious ceremonials, अण् aff.
वैध्यत: वैध्यत m. (-तः) YAMA'S porter or chamberlain.
वैध्रातक: वैध्रातक n. (-कं) A vessel for holding or pouring ghee, used at sacrifices with fire.
वैनतेय: वैनतेय m. (-यः) GARUDA or ARUṆA.  E. विनता their mother, ठक् aff.
वैनयिक: वैनयिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Ralating to morals or behaviour. 	 2. Enfor-cing proper conduct. 	 3. Magisterial. 	 m. (-कः) A chariot used formerly in battle, a war-carriage.  E. विनय, and ठक् aff.; or in the latter sense, वि before णी to get, अण् aff., and ठक् added.
वैनायिक: वैनायिक m. (-कः) A Bauddha, a follower of Buddha or a doctrine of that sect.  E. विनायक a Buddha or teacher of this sect, ठक् aff.
वैनाशिक: वैनाशिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A dependent, a subject, a slave. 	 2. A spider. 	 3. An astrologer.  E. विनाश loss, destruction, aff. ठक् or ठञ् ।
वैनीतक: वैनीतक mn. (-कः-क) 	 1. A mediate conveyance, as a proter carrying a letter, a horse dragging a chariot, &c.  E. वि variously, णी to take, aff. क्त, with कन् and अण् added.
वैपरीत्य: वैपरीत्य n. (-त्यं) Contrariety, opposition, reverse.  E. विपरीत contrary, aff. ष्यञ् ।
वैबोधिक: वैबोधिक m. (-कः) A watchman, a bell-man, one who announces the hours.  E. विबोध awakening, ठञ् aff.
वैभव: वैभव n. (-वं) 	 1. Grandour, wealth. 	 2. Power.  E. विभव and अण् added.
वैभाजित्र: वैभाजित्र n. (-त्रं) Apportioning, dividing.  E. विभाजयितृ one who makes a division or causes it to be made, अञ् aff.; the semi-vowel rejected.
वैभ्र: वैभ्र n. (-भ्रं) The heaven of VISHṆU.  E. वि variously, भ्राज् to shine, ड aff., अण् added.
वैभ्राज: वैभ्राज n. (-जं) A garden of the gods, a celestial grove or garden.  E. वि variously, भ्राज् to shine, aff. अच् and अण् added.
वैमात्र: वैमात्र m. (-त्रः) A step-mother's son. 	 f. (-त्रा-त्री) A step-mother's daughter. E. वि different, मातृ a mother, and अण् aff.
वैमात्रेय: वैमात्रेय m. (-यः) A step-mother's son. 	 f. (-यी) A half-sister, or one by a different mother.  E. विमातृ, ढक् aff.
वैमानिक: वैमानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a heavenly car, borne in one, &c.  E. विमान, ठक् aff.
वैमुक्त: वैमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Liberated, emancipated, being at liberty or loose. 	 n. (-क्तं) Liberation.  E. विमुक्त free, loose, अण् aff., implying property or possession.
वैमुख्य: वैमुख्य n. (-ख्यं) 	 1. Turning away the face. 	 2. Flight, retreat.  E. विमुख, ष्यञ् aff.
वैमेय: वैमेय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange.  E. वि, मेङ् to barter, यत् aff., अण् added.
वैयग्र: वैयग्र n. (-ग्रं) 	 1. Perplexity. 	 2. Exclusive attention to any thing.
वैयधिकरण्य: वैयधिकरण्य n. (-ण्यं) The having different substrata.
वैयर्थ्य: वैयर्थ्य n. (-र्थ्यं) Unprofitableness, uselessness.  E. व्यर्थ useless, ष्यञ् aff.
वैयाकरण: वैयाकरण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Grammatical, relating to grammar. 	 m. (-णः) A grammarian.  E. व्याकरण grammar, अण् aff.
वैयाघ्र: वैयाघ्र mfn. (-घ्रः-घ्री-घ्रं) Covered with a tiger-skin, (a car, &c.)  E. व्याघ्र a tiger, अण् aff.
वैयात्य: वैयात्य n. (-त्यं) Immodesty, boldness.  E. वियात and ष्यञ् aff.
वैयासकि: वैयासकि m. (-किः) A son of VYĀSA.
वैयुष्ट: वैयुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टी-ष्टं) Early, betimes, occurring or performed in the morning.  E. व्यष्ट morning, अण् aff.
वैर: वैर n. (-रं) 	 1. Enmity, hostility. 	 2. Heroism, prowess.  E. वीर a warrior, aff. अण् ।
वैरकर: वैरकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Causing or occasioning enmity, mischief-making. E. वैर and कर who or what makes.
वैरकार: वैरकार m. (-रः) An enemy.  E. वैर and कार who makes.
वैरक्त्य: वैरक्त्य n. (-क्त्यं) 	 1. Aversion, displeasure, dislike. 	 2. Absence of worldly attachment.  E. विरक्त and ष्यञ् aff.
वैरङ्गिक: वैरङ्गिक m. (-कः) An ascetic, a devotee, one who has subdued passion or desire.  E. वि privative, रङ्ग passion, aff. ठक् or ठञ् ।
वैरनिर्यातन: वैरनिर्य्यातन n. (-नं) Revenge, retaliation, requital of an injury.  E. वैर enmity, निर्य्यातन donation, return.
वैरनिर्य्यातन: वैरनिर्य्यातन n. (-नं) Revenge, retaliation, requital of an injury.  E. वैर enmity, निर्य्यातन donation, return.
वैरप्रतिक्रिया: वैरप्रतिक्रिया f. (-या) Revenge.  E. वैर enmity, प्रतिक्रिया return.
वैरशुद्धि: वैरशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Revenge, retaliation, requital.  E. वैर enmity, शुद्धि purification.
वैराग: वैराग n. (-गं) Absence of worldly passion or desire.  E. वि privative, राग passion, अण् aff.; with ष्यञ् aff. वैराग्य ।
वैरागिक: वैरागिक m. (-कः) An ascetic, one with subdued passions.  E. वि priv. राग passion, ठञ् aff.
वैरागिन्: वैरागिन् m. (-गी) An ascetic, a devotee, one who has subdued his world-ly desires: at present the term in common use is applied to a particular class of religious mendicants.  E. वैराग absence of passion, aff. इनि ।
वैराग्य: वैराग्य n. (-ग्यं) Subjection of the appetite and passions, absence of worldly desires.  E. विराग and ष्यञ् aff.: see वैराग ।
वैराट: वैराट m. (-टः) An earth-worm.  E. वि before राज् to shine, aff. क्विप्, अण् added.
वैराठ्या: वैराठ्या f. (-ट्या) One of the sixteen goddesses of the Bauddhas, termed Vidyā-devis or goddesses of learning.
वैरानुवन्धिन्: वैरानुवन्धिन् m. (-न्धी) 	 1. VISHṆU. 	 2. The solar ray which is charged with heat.  E. वैर heroism or strength, अनुवन्धिन् connected with.
वैरायमाण: वैरायमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Hostile, inimical, an enemy.  E. वैर enmity, used as a verb, with क्यङ् and शानच् affs.
वैरारोह: वैरारोह m. (-हः) Desperate or arduous combat.  E. वैर enmity, &c. आरोह ascending.
वैरिता: वैरिता f. (-ता) 	 1. Enmity. 	 2. Heroism.  E. वैरिन् and तल् aff.; also with त्व, वैरित्वं ।
वैरिन्: वैरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Hostile. 	 m. (-री) 	 1. An enemy. 	 2. A hero.  E. वैर enmity, इनि aff.
वैरूप्य: वैरूप्य n. (-प्यं) 	 1. Deformity. 	 2. Difference of form, &c.  E. विरूप, ष्यञ् aff.
वैरोचन: वैरोचन m. (-नः) 	 1. The third of the Buddhas, called Dhyāni Bud-dhas. 	 2. BALĪ, the sovereign so named. 	 3. The son of AGNI. 	 4. The son of ŚURYA, or the sun. 	 5. A Siddha, a sort of demi-god or deified mortal.  E. विरोचन the sun, &c. and aff. of descent अण् ।
वैरोचननिकेतन: वैरोचननिकेतन n. (-नं) Pātāla the intermediate region between the earth and Tartarus or Naraka, over part of which BALĪ presides. E. वैरोचन the prince BALĪ, and निकेतन abode; the sovereign of this name being an incarnate Daitya or hereditary foe of the gods, and being invested with a sovereignty in the lower regions after his humiliation by VISHṆU.
वैरोचनि: वैरोचनि m. (-निः) 	 1. A BUDDHA. 	 2. BALĪ. 	 3. The son of ŚURYA.  E. विरोचन, इञ् aff. of descent.
वैरोचि: वैरोचि m. (-चिः) The demon or Daitya VĀṆA.
वैरोद्धार: वैरोद्धार n. (-रं) Revenge, retaliation.  E. वैर enmity, and उद्धार a debt.
वैलक्षण्य: वैलक्षण्य n. (-ण्यं) Difference, contrariety.  E. विलक्षण, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैलक्ष्य: वैलक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) 	 1. Contrariety, reverse, inversion. 	 2. Contrary course or conduct to that which is usual or natural. 	 3. Absence of any characteristic. 	 4. Shame. 	 5. Sorrow.  E. विलक्ष, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैल्व: वैल्व mfn. (-ल्वः-ल्वी-ल्वं) Relating or belonging to the Vilwa-tree. 	 n. (-ल्वं) The fruit of the Vilwa, (Ægle marmelos.)  E. विल्व the tree, अण् aff.
वैल्वमय: वैल्वमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of the Vilwa, of the wood, &c. of that tree.  E. वैल्व relating to the Bel, and मयट् aff.
वैव: वैव(ब)धिक m. (-कः) A chandler, a vender of grain, oil, ghee, fruit, sweet-meats, &c.  E. विवध storing grain, &c., aff. ठक् ।
वैवर्ण्य: वैवर्ण्य n. (-र्ण्यं) 	 1. Change of colour or complexion. 	 2. Change of colour in general. 	 3. Deviation or secession from tribe or caste, &c. 	 4. Heterogeneousness, difference.  E. वि privative or contra-indicative, and वर्ण colour, tribe, &c., aff. ष्यञ् ।
वैवस्वत: वैवस्वत m. (-तः) 	 1. YAMA. 	 2. One of the RUDRAS. 	 3. The seventh MANU or the MANU of the present period. 	 4. The planet Saturn. 	 n. (-तं) The present age, presided over by the seventh MANU. E. विवस्वत् the sun, अण् aff.
वैवाहिक: वैवाहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Nuptial, matrimonial, relating to marriage. mn. (-कः-कं) A marriage. 	 m. (-कः) The bride or bridegroom's father-in-law.  E. विवाह marriage, ठक् aff. of reference or relation.
वैशद्य: वैशद्य n. (-द्यं) 	 1. Whiteness. 	 2. Cleanness, purity, (literally or figuratively.) 	 3. Composure.  E. विशद white, &c., ष्यञ् aff.
वैशम्पायन: वैशम्पायन m. (-नः) A sage, the original teacher of the Yajur-Veda, and narrator of the Mahābhārata to JANAMBJAYA.
वैशस: वैशस n. (-सं) 	 1. Hindrance, impediment. 	 2. Slaughter.  E. विशसस्य भावः स्वार्थे वा अण् ।
वैशस्त्र: वैशस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 	 1. Government, sway, rule. 	 2. The state of being dis-armed or defenceless.  E. विशस्तृ ruling, अञ् aff., and the pen. vowel changed; or वि private, शस्त्र a weapon, and अण् aff.
वैशाख: वैशाख m. (-खः) 	 1. The month in which the moon is full near the south-ern scale, (April-May,) the first month in the Hindu calendar. 	 2. A churning-stick. 	 n. (-खं) A particular attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart. 	 f. (-खी) The day of full-moon in the month of Vaiśākha.  E. विशाखा the constellation in which the moon is full in this month, अण् aff.; or विशाखा said to mean here, pervading, revolving, अण् aff.
वैशिक: वैशिक n. (-कं) Harlotry, allurement of harlots. 	 m. (-कः) A man who associates with courtezans.  E. वेश्या, and ठक् aff.
वैशिष्ट्य: वैशिष्ट्य n. (-ष्ट्यं) 	 1. Endowment with some distinguishing attributes. 2. Distinction, peculiarity. 	 3. Excellence.  E. विशिष्ट, ष्यञ् aff.
वैशेषिक: वैशेषिक m. (-कः) A follower of the Vaiśeshika doctrine. 	 n. (-कं) The Vaiśeshika doctrine, or branch of the Nyāya or logical school of philosophy, instituted by KANĀDA. It differs from GAUTAMA'S system in recognizing only seven categories instead of sixteen. E. विशेष difference, (from the original Nyāya of GAUTAMA,) ठञ् aff.
वैशेष्य: वैशेष्य n. (-ष्यं) 	 1. Specific or generic distinction. 	 2. Superiority, pre-eminence.  E. विशेष, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैश्य: वैश्य m. (-श्यः) The Vaiśya or man of the third or agricultural and mercantile tribe. 	 f. (-श्या) A woman of the Vaiśya caste.  E. विश् to enter, (fields, &c.) क्विप् aff., यञ् pleonasm added.
वैश्यक्रिया: वैश्यक्रिया f. (-या) 	 1. Trade, agriculture.  E. वैश्य, क्रिया act, business; also वैश्यकर्म्म, &c.
वैश्यवृत्ति: वैश्यवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Agriculture or trade.  E. वैश्य, and वृत्ति subsistence.
वैश्रवण: वैश्रवण m. (-णः) 	 1. KUVERA, the god of wealth. 	 2. RĀVAṆA.  E. विश्रवस् their father, aff. अण्, and the form irr.
वैश्रवणालय: वैश्रवणालय m. (-यः) The Indian-fig tree.  E. वैश्रवण KUVERA, आलय abode.
वैश्रवणावास: वैश्रवणावास m. (-सः) The Indian-fig tree.  E. वैश्रवण KUVERA, आवास abode.
वैश्रवणोदय: वैश्रवणोदय m. (-यः) The Indian-fig tree.  E. वैश्रवण, उदय prosperity.
वैश्वदेव: वैश्वदेव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 	 1. Sacred or dedicated to the Viśwadevas, offered to them, relating to them, &c. 	 2. Relating to all divinities. n. (-वं) Offering to all the divinities. 	 f. (-वी) Species of the Panktī metre.  E. विश्वदेव, and अण् aff.
वैश्वदेवकर्मन्: वैश्वदेवकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Oblation of offering to the deities collectively. E. वैश्वदेव, and कर्म्मन् act.
वैश्वदेवकर्म्मन्: वैश्वदेवकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Oblation of offering to the deities collectively. E. वैश्वदेव, and कर्म्मन् act.
वैश्वदेवहोम: वैश्वदेवहोम n. (-मं) Oblation to the Viśwadevas.  E. वैश्वदेव, and होम burnt-offering.
वैश्वानर: वैश्वानर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Relating to, fit for, &c., all men. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. AGNI or fire. 	 2. The digestive fire. 	 3. The supreme being. 	 f. (-री) A parti-cular sacrifice to be performed at the beginning of every year. E. विश्वानर a Muni, or विश्व all, नर mankind, अण् aff. of descent.
वैश्वी: वैश्वी f. (-श्वी) The second of the constellations called ĀSHĀDHĀ, and twenty-first of the whole.  E. विश्व Viśwadeva, अण् and ङीष् affs.; those deities presiding over the asterism.
वैषम्य: वैषम्य n. (-म्यं) 	 1. Inequality, unevenness. 	 2. Solitariness, singleness. 	 3. Difficulty. 	 4. Injustice.  E. विषम odd, uneven, &c., aff. ष्यञ् ।
वैषयिक: वैषयिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A sensualist, one addicted to the pleasures of sense. 2. One occupied with worldly objects or interests. 	 f. (-की) 	 1. Re-lating to any object. 	 2. Relating to an object of sense.  E. विषय an object of sense, and ठक् aff.
वैष्टुत: वैष्टुत n. (-तं) The ashes of a burnt-offering.  E. वि before स्तु to praise, aff. क्त and अण् added.
वैष्ट्र: वैष्ट्र n. (-ष्ट्रं) 	 1. A world. 	 2. Air. 	 3. Heaven.  E. विष् to extend, ष्ट्रन् Uṇadi aff.
वैष्णव: वैष्णव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating or belonging to VISHṆU. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. A follower of VISHṆU. 	 2. One of the modern Hindu sects, (the VAISHNABAS, the ŚAIVAS and the ŚĀKTAS are the three important modern Hindu sects.) 	 f. (-वी) 	 1. One of the Mātris, the personified energy or Śaktī of VISHṆU. 	 2. A name of DURGĀ. 	 3. A flower, (Clitoria ternatea.) 	 4. Sacred basil, (Ocymum sanctum.) 	 n. (-वं) The ashes of a burnt offering.  E. विष्णु VISHṆU, अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीष् ।
वैसारिण: वैसारिण m. (-णः) A fish.  E. वि before सृ to go, णिनि aff., and अण् added.
वैसूचन: वैसूचन n. (-नं) A man's assuming female attire, (in the drama.)  E. वि before सूच् to make known, क्युच् aff., and अण् added.
वैहायस: वैहायस f. (-सी) Being in the air.
वैहार्य: वैहार्य्य f. (-र्य्या) One on whom jokes are to be practised; (as to the brother of a wife.)  E. विहार joke, ष्यञ् aff.
वैहार्य्य: वैहार्य्य f. (-र्य्या) One on whom jokes are to be practised; (as to the brother of a wife.)  E. विहार joke, ष्यञ् aff.
वैहासिक: वैहासिक m. (-कः) A comic actor, a buffoon.  E. वि, हास laughter, aff. ठक् ।
वोटा: वोटा f. (-टा) A female servant or slave.  E. पुट् to contract, aff. अच्, and व being substituted for प; perhaps more correctly बोटा ।
वोड्र: वोड्र m. (-ड्रः) 	 1. A large snake, (Borā or Boa Constrictor.) 	 2. A sort of fish. 	 f. (-ड्री) The fourth part of a Pana.  E. वा-बा० उड्र ।
वोढव्य: वोढव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्यी-व्यं) 	 1. To be borne or carried. 	 2. Able to bear or carry.  E. वह् to bear, तव्यर् aff., form irr.
वोढु: वोढु m. (-ढुः) The son of a woman living in her father's house, and whose husband is absent.  E. वह् to bear, उ aff., form irr.
वोढृ: वोढृ m. (-ढा) 	 1. A bridegroom. 	 2. A porter, a bearer. 	 3. A charioteer. 4. A bull. 	 5. A guide, a leader. 	 6. A son. 	 7. A draught horse.  E. वह् to bear, aff. तृच्, ह changed to ढ, ओ substituted for the vowel.
वोण्ट: वोण्ट m. (-ण्टः) A stalk, a stem.
वोदाल: वोदाल m. (-लः) A sheat-fish, (Silurus Boalis, HAM.) “वोयाल माच् ।”
वोर: वोर m. (-रः) A sort of pulse, (Dolichos catjang.) E. Apparently not a Sanskrit word, though occurring in regular compounds.
वोरक: वोरक m. (-कः) A scribe, a writer. E. See वोलक ।
वोरट: वोरट m. (-टः) A sort of jasmine. “कुन्दपुष्पे ।”
वोरपट्टी: वोरपट्टी f. (-ट्टी) A sort of mat or mattress for sleeping on.  E. वोर Dolichos catjang, पट्टी coarse cloth; perhaps made of the straw.
वोरव: वोरव m. (-वः) A kind of rice, which is cut in March or April. “वोरोधान्”.
वोरुखान: वोरुखान m. (-नः) A horse, described as of a white and red colour.
वोल: वोल m. (-लः) Gum-myrrh.  E. वा to go, to smell, उलच् aff.
वोलक: वोलक m. (-कः) A scribe. 	 f. (-लिका) A sort of cake or pudding made with flour and sugar.  E. वा to go, and उलच् aff., and कन् added; also ल being changed to र, वोरक ।
वोल्लाह: वोल्लाह m. (-हः) A horse, with white mane and tail.
वोहित्थ: वोहित्थ n. (-त्थं) A vessel, a ship.
वैषट्: वैषट् Ind. An exclamation used on offering an oblation to the gods or manes.  E. वह् to bear, (what is borne by this,) and डौषट् aff.
व्यंशक: व्यंशक m. (-कः) A mountain.  E. वि various, अंश part, कन् added.
व्यंशुक: व्यंशुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Undressed, naked.  E. वि priv., अंशुक a garment.
व्यंसक: व्यंसक m. (-कः) A cheat, a juggler.  E. वि before अंस् to divide, ण्वुल् aff.
व्यंसन: व्यंसन n. (-नं) Cheating, tricking.  E. वि, अंस् to divide, ल्युट् aff.
व्यंसनीय: व्यंसनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be deceived or cheated.  E. वि before अंस to divide, अनीयर् aff.; also व्यंसितव्य and व्यंस्य ।
व्यसित: व्यसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Deceived, tricked, cheated.  E. वि, अंस् to divide, aff. क्त ।
व्यक्त: व्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Wise, learned. 	 2. Evident, manifest, apparent, absolutely and specifically known or understood. 	 2. Individual, specific.  E. वि before अञ्ज् to make clear, aff. क्त ।
व्यक्तत्व: व्यक्तत्व n. (-त्वं) Distinctness, manifestation.  E. त्व added to the last; also व्यक्तता ।
व्यक्तदृष्टार्थ: व्यक्तदृष्टार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Perceiving, understanding, present, an eye-witness.  E. व्यक्त evident, दृष्ट seen, अर्थ meaning or object, (by whom.)
व्यक्तराशि: व्यक्तराशि f. (-शिः) Known or absolute quantity.  E. व्यक्त, राशि quantity.
व्यक्तलक्ष्मन्: व्यक्तलक्ष्मन् mfn. (-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मा-क्ष्म) Evident by certain signs or marks, manifest-ed, characterised.  E. व्यक्त, and लक्ष्मन् a mark.
व्यक्ति: व्यक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Individuality, specific appearance or being. 	 2. Appearance, manifestation. 	 3. Case, inflexion, or the proper form of any inflected word.  E. वि before अञ्ज् to make clear, aff. क्तिन् ।
व्यक्तिता: व्यक्तिता f. (-ता) Individuality.  E. तल् added to व्यक्ति; also with त्व व्यक्तित्वं ।
व्यक्तीकरण: व्यक्तीकरण n. (-णं) Making distinct or manifest.  E. व्यक्ति, करण making च्वि aug.
व्यक्तीकृत: व्यक्तीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made clear or manifest.  E. व्यक्ति, कृत made, च्वि aug.
व्यक्तीभूत: व्यक्तीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distinct, clear.  E. व्यक्ति, भूत become, च्वि aug.
व्यक्तोदित: व्यक्तोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested, displayed.  E. व्यक्त, उदित risen or said.
व्यग्र: व्यग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 	 1. Bewildered, perplexed, distracted. 	 2. Alarmed, agitated, frightened. 	 3. Engaged in, zealous, eager.  E. वि before अग्र chief, principal.
व्यग्रता: व्यग्रता f. (-ता) 	 1. Perplexity, anxiety. 	 2. Zeal.  E. तल् added to the last; with त्व, व्यग्रत्वं ।
व्यङ्ग: व्यङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 	 1. Deformed, lame. 	 2. Bodiless. 	 3. Ill-arranged. m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A frog. 	 2. A cripple. 	 3. Discoloration of the face, dark spots on the cheek.  E. वि depreciative, &c., अङ्ग body.
व्यङ्गार: व्यङ्गार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having no fire alight.  E. वि priv., अङ्गार hot coals.
व्यङ्गुल: व्यङ्गुल n. (-लं) The 60th part of a digit or Angula.  E. वि, अङ्गुल a digit.
व्यङ्ग्य: व्यङ्ग्य m. (-ङ्ग्यः) 	 1. Figurative or poetical speech, elliptical language or that which conveys something more than the simple meaning of the words. 	 2. Sarcasm, the covert but intelligible expression of suspicion or contempt.  E. वि before अञ्ज् to make clear or manifest, aff. ण्यत्, or घञ् aff. and यत् added.
व्यच्: व्यच् r. 6th cl. (विचति) To cheat, to trick, to defraud or deceive.
व्यज: व्यज m. (-जः) A fan.  E. वि before अज् to go, घ aff.
व्यजन: व्यजन n. (-नं) A fan.  E. वि before अज् to go, aff. ल्युट् ।
व्यञ्जक: व्यञ्जक m. (-कः) 	 1. External indication of passion or feeling. 	 2. A sign, a mark, a symbol. 	 3. Figurative or elliptical expression. 	 f. (-ञ्जिका) 1. Showing, making clear. 	 2. Suggesting a meaning, as applied to a word or sense, (opposed to वाचक and लाक्षणिक ।)  E. वि before अञ्ज् to manifest, aff. ण्वुल् ।
व्यञ्जकत्व: व्यञ्जकत्व n. (-त्वं) The nature or existence of figurative or poetical expression.  E. व्यञ्जक, and त्व added.
व्यञ्जन: व्यञ्जन n. (-नं) 	 1. A mark, a spot, a sign, a token. 	 2. Paraphernalia, insignia. 	 3. The beard. 	 4. A privy, part, either male er female. 	 5. Sauce, condiment. 	 6. A consonant. 	 7. Making clear. 	 8. A sign of puberty. 	 9. A limb, a member. 	 nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Figurative express-ion. 	 2. Irony, sarcasm.  E. वि before अञ्ज् to make clear, ल्युट् aff.
व्यञ्जनावृत्ति: व्यञ्जनावृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Rhetorical or elliptical style.  E. व्यञ्जना, and वृत्ति style.
व्यञ्जयत्: व्यञ्जयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Making visible.  E. वि, अञ्ज् to go, शतृ aff.
व्यञ्जित: व्यञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Distinguished, characterised. 	 2. Manifested, visible. 	 3. Suggested.  E. वि before अञ्ज् to go, क्त aff.
व्यञ्जिजिषु: व्यञ्जिजिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing or trying to expose, detect, make manifest, &c.  E. वि before अञ्ज् to go, desid. v., उ aff.
व्यडम्बक: व्यडम्बक m. (-कं) The castor-oil plant, (Ricinus communis.)  E. वि before अड् to strive, aff. अच्, व्यड here said to mean excretion, अवि to go, to cause, ण्वुल् aff., form irr; also with युच् aff. व्यडम्बन m. (-नः) and by another reading, व्यडम्बर; other etymologies are given.
व्यतिकर: व्यतिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Reciprocal, acting on or with one another. 	 2. Pervading, who or what spreads through or over. 	 3. Contiguous to, in contact with (-रः) 	 1. Misfortune, calamity. 	 2. Reciprocity, reciprocal action or relation 3. Reverse. 	 4. Contact, contiguity. 5. Opportunity. 	 6. An occurrence, an incident. 	 7. Mixing together.  E. वि and अति before कृ to make, to do, aff. अप् ।
व्यतिकीर्ण: व्यतिकीर्ण f. (-र्णा) Mixed together, blended together.
व्यतिक्रम: व्यतिक्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Inverted or retrograde order, inversion, reverse. 	 2. Contrariety, opposition in general; as the contrary of what is right or wrong, crime, vice: the contrary of prosperity, adversity, misfortune, &c. 	 3. Retraction, non-performance, (as of contracts.) 4. Passing over or beyond.  E. वि and अति before क्रम् to go, aff. अच् ।
व्यतिक्रान्त: व्यतिक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Reversed, inverted. 	 2. Retracted. 	 3. Passed over. 	 4. Violated.  E. वि and अति before क्रम् to go, क्त aff.
व्यतिरिक्त: व्यतिरिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Different, distinct. 	 2. Excepted. 	 3. With-drawn. 	 4. Surpassing.  E. वि and अति before रिच् to unite, aff. क्त ।

(-रि) A property, or class of properties into which feelings and emotions, as objects of poeti-cal description are classed; or the transitory feeling, (op. to स्थायिन्) which does not pervade a composition but, if properly developed at any stage, strengthens the prevailing sentiment. the BHĀVAS called VYABHICHĀRIS are thirty-two in number, to which two others are sometimes added, making thirty-four, viz:--1. NIRVEDA, humility, self-abasement; 2. GLĀNI, weakness, exhaustion; 3. ŚANKĀ, apprehension; 4. ASŪĀ, calumny; 5. MADA, inebriety; 6. ŚHRAMA, fatigue; 7. ĀLASYA, indolence; 8. DAINYA, indigence, distress. 	 6. CHINTĀ, secret desire; contemplation of the object beloved; 10. MOHA, loss of sense or presence of mind from fear, anxiety, &c.; 11. SMRITĪ, recollection but especially the recollection of an absent or faithless lover exci-ted by present objects; 12. DHRITĪ, the enjoyment or consciousness of amatory woe, resignation or abandonment to despair, &c.; 13. VṚDA, shame; 14. CHAPALATĀ, fickleness, unsteadiness, want of firmness and steadiness; 15. HARSA, delight; 16. ĀBEGA, hurry, flurried haste; 17. JARATĀ, ignorance, imbecility; 18. GARBA, pride, arrogance; 19. BISHĀDA, want of energy or spirits, depress-ion of mind; 20. AUTSUKYA, regret, painful remembrance of some object lost or absent; 21. NIDRĀ, sluggishness, sleepiness; 22. APASMĀRA, epilepsy; 23. ŚUPTA, sleep; 24. BIBODHA, waking; 25. AMARSHA, wrathful impatience; 26. AVAHITTHĀ, dissimulation; 27. UGRATĀ, passion, rage; 28. MATI, intelligence, knowledge; 29. UPĀLAMBHA, reviling; 30. BYĀDHI, sickness, disease; 31. UNMĀDA, madness, delirium; 32. MARAṆA, death; the other two are, 33. TRĀSA, fear; 34. BITARKA, doubt, deliberation. 	 f. (-रिणी) A wanton woman, an unchaste wife.  E. वि and अभि before चर् to go, aff. णिनि.

व्री: व्री r. 4th cl. (व्रीयते) To go. r. 9th cl. (व्रिणाति or व्रीणाति) To choose or select.
व्रीड्: व्रीड् r. 4th cl. (व्रीड्यते) 	 1. To be modest, to be bashful or ashamed. 2. To throw, to direct or send.
व्रीड: व्रीड mf. (-डः-डा) Shame, bashfulness.  E. व्रीड् to be ashamed, aff. अच्; fem. aff. अङ् and टाप् ।
व्रीडन: व्रीडन n. (-नं) Bashfulness, modesty.  E. व्रीड् to be ashamed, ल्युट् aff.
व्रीडानत: व्रीडानत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, hanging down the head with shame. E. व्रीडा, and आनत bowed.
व्रीडान्वित: व्रीडान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest.  E. व्रीडा, and अन्वित possessed of.
व्रीडित: व्रीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, modest.  E. व्रीड्, क्त aff.
व्रीस्: व्रीस् r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रीसति व्रासयति-ते) To hurt or injure, to kill or wound.
व्रीहि: व्रीहि m. (-हिः) 	 1. Rice of various kinds: eight principal sorts are enu-merated by native authorities, but the varieties are more numer-ous. 	 2. Rice ripening in the rainy season.  E. व्री to choose, हि aff.
व्रीहिक: व्रीहिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having or bearing rice.  E. व्रीहि rice, ठन् aff.
व्रीहिकाञ्चन: व्रीहिकाञ्चन m. (-नः) A sort of pulse, (Ervum lens or hirsutum, &c.)
व्रीहिन्: व्रीहिन् mfn. (-हि-हिणी-हि) Having rice, (a field, &c.)  E. व्रीहि rice, इनि aff.
व्रीहिभेद: व्रीहिभेद m. (-दः) A sort of grain, (Panicum miliaceum.)
व्रीहिमय: व्रीहिमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or consisting of rice. 	 m. (-यः) A rice-cake offered with ghee as an oblation.  E. व्रीहि rice, and मयट् aff.
व्रीहिराजिक: व्रीहिराजिक m. (-कः) 	 1. Panic-seed, (Panicum italicum.) 	 2. Another species, (Panicum miliaceum.)  E. व्रीहि rice, राजिक shining, excelling.
व्रीह्यगार: व्रीह्यगार n. (-रं) A granary, a shed where rice or other grain is stored.  E. व्रीहि, अगार a house.
व्रुड्: व्रुड् r. 6th cl. (व्रुडति) 	 1. To cover. 	 2. To heap. 	 3. To sink.
व्रूस्: व्रूस् r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रूसति व्रूसयति-ते) To hurt or kill.
व्रैह: व्रैह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Made of or with rice.  E. व्रीहि rice, and अण् aff.
व्रैहेय: व्रैहेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fit for or sown with rice, (a field, &c.)  E. व्रीहि rice, ढक् aff.
व्ली: व्ली r. 9th cl. (व्लिनाति or व्लीनाति) 	 1. To choose or select. 	 2. To hold, to maintain. 	 3. To go.
